title: Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro tells CNBC parks were 'big surprise' in last quarter, company has 'clarity' and 'stability'
content:
DisneyCEOJosh D'Amarotold CNBC'sJulia Boorstinon Friday that the company's parks division was a "big surprise" last quarter and that he feels confident about the company's trajectory during his first few months at the top of the media giant.

"We're delivering on everything that we said we're going to deliver on," D'Amaro said. "I think there's clarity inside of the organization in terms of where we need to to go next. A lot of stability with the the team. So you know, almost six months in, I'm feeling pretty good about where we are."

D'Amarosteppedinto the role of Disney CEO in March, succeeding Bob Iger after aclosely watchedsuccession race and following a turnaround period at the media giant.

ThelongtimeDisney executive had most recently served as chairman of Disney Experiences, the unit that includes the theme parks, cruise lines and consumer products, and which drives profitability for the company.

His immediate tasks since assuming the top job have been sustaining momentum in Disney's core growth areas, namely its theme parks and streaming divisions. These areas have been a focus for investors, and in recent quarters, Disney has received a mixed reception from Wall Street.

"I'm not happy with where the stock stands right now," D'Amaro said Friday. "Our investors aren't happy with that, but I do believe that we're sitting in a very great space relative to the entertainment industry."

Last week Disneyreported quarterly resultsthat once again showcased the strength of parks and streaming, and Wall Street appeared pleased with growth in Disney's theme park segment despite mounting macroeconomic uncertainty for consumers.

Still, the stock is down more than 8% in the last 12 months.

On Friday, D'Amaro said that while Disney isn't "immune" to some of the headwinds hitting theme parks, the company is positioned to respond if needed. Still, he fell short of disclosing whether further theme park price increases were coming, and instead said to expect further investments in its destinations.

The CEO haspreviously saidthat his focus in leading Disney is on investing in intellectual property.

"This next chapter is about, No. 1, telling great stories. We'll never forget that. We want to move with more speed and urgency than we have before," D'Amaro said. "Embrace technology even more aggressively than we have in the past, and importantly, bring this company together to act like 'One Disney,' which you've heard me say before."

D'Amaro highlighted the company's flagship streaming service, specifically.

"We have tremendous scale, growing scale internationally. So as it is today, I feel very good about where Disney+ is," D'Amaro said. "But there are opportunities, obviously, to keep growing it."

D'Amaro said last week the company isconsideringa free, ad-supported streaming product as a way to beckon more viewers to Disney+. On Friday, he called the option a potential "front porch" to get viewers in for free who could later become subscribers.

D'Amaro also noted the need to have all business units working in tandem and hinted at a consumer experience that could mesh viewership with buying products on the same platform.

"From a streaming perspective, instead of just being a streaming platform, why wouldn't we have all of the elements of Disney come to life right there in front of you," D'Amaro said. "Everyone may not participate in every part of the business. But certainly, if we put the right things in front of the consumer, if it's a seamless fan experience, I think that lifetime value goes up."

In the backdrop of building out streaming, Disney and its media peers have also been contending with the loss of pay-TV bundle customers, which has led to considerable declines in distribution and advertising revenues.

Live sports, however, remain a major driver for both Disney and other major networks. Disney's ESPN and ABC own the rights to live NFL and NBA, in addition to other pro leagues.

At the same time, the cost of sports rights has risen dramatically and could become a potential strain on media companies.

"I've been clear that I'm not interested in spinning off ESPN," D'Amaro said Friday, responding to ongoing rumors and calls from investors to split off the property.

"I think that anybody in the industry would look at our sports rights and the fandom associated with sports right now, and you can't help but be jealous of what we have here. I mean, ratings are through the roof," he said.

Despite the strong momentum for Disney, D'Amaro has also faced some drama in his first few months.

The company's latest round of cost-cutting began weeks after D'Amaro took the helm, withan initial roundof layoffs affecting nearly 1,000 employees. Most recently the companyreportedlycut several hundred employees from its ESPN, Pixar and National Geographic divisions.

The media industry at large has been shapeshifting in recent months, including the proposed merger betweenParamount SkydanceandWarner Bros. Discoveryas well asComcast'splanned spinout of NBCUniversal.

D'Amaro, however, told CNBC on Friday he wasn't considering any such significant moves.

The CEO has also been faced with increasing political pressure and scrutiny, particularly around Disney's ABC. The broadcast network has facedbacklashfrom the Trump administration and Federal Communications Commission Chairman Brendan Carr for its "Jimmy Kimmel Live!" and "The View" programs.

The FCC has also openedan early reviewof Disney's broadcast station licenses following concerns around the company's diversity, equity and inclusion efforts. Disney hasshot backat the FCC throughout the early renewal process, calling it an "unlawful, arbitrary, and unconstitutional order."

"I think you saw in our FCC filings our position on this is clear," D'Amaro said on Friday. "We're very principled on this. We're going to stand up to what we believe is journalistic and integrity, and we're not going to be told how to run that side of our business."

title: 法院规定公司不得从海外进口吉利德药物，这对法新社的健康计划造成打击
content:
法院本周做出的有利于吉利德科学的裁决可能会对美国新兴的一类健康计划产生重大影响，联邦当局称这些计划从海外非法进口药品。

去年，CNBC 的一项调查发现，随着药品成本飙升，这些计划（称为替代资金计划或 AFP）在全国范围内变得越来越普遍。然而，美国当局称 AFP 从国际市场进口这些药物违反了食品和药物管理局的规定。

美国上诉法院周四维持了吉利德针对几家 AFP 和相关企业提起的案件中的初步禁令。患者权益团体表示，这一决定可能会迫使 AFP 大幅缩减规模，甚至停业。

AFP 捍卫自己的做法合法且安全，并表示他们的业务是高处方药价格的解药。

2024 年 12 月，吉利德起诉几家公司，指控其声称非法进口其 HIV 药物 Biktarvy。该诉讼是在一名马里兰州患者收到从土耳其邮寄的带有土耳其语标签说明的药物后提起的。

该诉讼针对的是一家名为 Rx Valet 的法新社和几家附属公司。吉利德还起诉了管理员工健康计划、隶属 CVS Health 旗下 Aetna 的 Meritain Health 和药品福利管理公司 Pro-Act。

“Meritain 长期以来一直坚持一项政策，即不支持来自美国境外的未经 FDA 批准的药物项目，也不与公司签订合同以促进进口来自美国境外的未经 FDA 批准的药物，”Aetna 发言人 Phil Blando 说。在一份声明中。 “尽管有这项政策，Meritain 在吉利德提起的有关国际药品采购的诉讼中被指定为被告。Meritain 对这些指控提出强烈反驳，并正在积极为自己辩护。”

Rx Valet 没有回复 CNBC 的置评请求。

AFP 普遍坚称他们从海外进口的药品与在美国销售的药品相同。

法院本周不同意，认为吉利德的美国药品与被告进口的国际药品之间的差异是“实质性的，而不是理论上的”，被告通过未经授权的外国渠道进口药品，绕过了吉利德的供应链。

裁决称，“吉利德在土耳其销售的药品和在马里兰州销售的药品具有相同的化学配方，但存在重大差异，并通过不同的质量控制系统。”。

在一份声明中，吉利德发言人表示，该裁决有助于保护患者不受 FDA 监管和质量保障的药品。

安全药品合作伙伴关系（非营利组织和制药行业团体联盟）的执行董事 Shabbir Imber Safdar 表示，法院的判决很明确，“你不能进口带有外语标签的无法追踪的药品，将其交给美国患者，并称其相当于 FDA 批准的药品。”

title: 房地产投资者称这是至少三年来最糟糕的市场
content:
本文的一个版本首次出现在 Diana Olick 的 CNBC Property Play 时事通讯中。 《Property Play》涵盖了房地产投资者的新的和不断变化的机会，从个人到风险资本家、私募股权基金、家族办公室、机构投资者和大型上市公司。注册接收未来版本，直接发送到您的收件箱。

单户住房市场的投资者越来越担心利率、不断上涨的保险和住房成本以及与伊朗的持续战争。因此，他们对自己业务的信心低于至少三年来的水平。

根据季度 RCN Capital/CJ Patrick 公司投资者情绪指数 (ISI)，6 月底的投资者情绪连续第二个季度下降至历史最低点。该指数对固定转手和租赁行业的 300 多名投资者进行了调查。

只有 26% 的受访者表示，他们认为市场状况比一年前更好，这是自 2023 年开始调查以来的最低比例，低于第一季度的 35%。整整 45% 的人表示市场变得更糟，这是该调查历史上最高的。

“除了伊朗持续的冲突之外，财务成本上升、库存有限、住房和装修成本不断上升以及租金下降压力都是导致他们悲观情绪加剧的因素，”房地产投资者私人贷款机构 RCN Capital 的首席执行官杰弗里·特施 (Jeffrey Tesch) 在一份新闻稿中表示。

本报告中接受调查的绝大多数投资者都是小企业或小企业。中等大小的。这与最近颁布的《21 世纪住房之路法案》所涵盖的大型机构投资者形成鲜明对比，该法案通常禁止拥有至少 350 套单户住宅的投资者购买更多单户住宅。中小型投资者倾向于使用过桥贷款、出租房产的特殊投资者贷款以及通常为 30 年期和固定利率的传统贷款。在接受调查的人中，有 28% 的人表示他们最近购买时支付了现金。

抵押贷款利率在 2 月底触及近期低点，但在与伊朗的战争开始时急剧上升。目前已达到一年多来的最高水平。

报告称，超过一半的受访者表示，融资成本高是“当今市场最大的问题之一”。其中四分之三的人表示，他们预计短期内不会看到任何利率下调，有些人预计利率会上升。

CNBC 的《戴安娜·奥利克 (Diana Olick) 的房产游戏》每周向您的收件箱发送一次，为房地产投资者提供不断变化的新机会。

订阅此处即可立即访问。

所有这些都影响着投资者的购买活动。

“房地产投资者在第一季度购买的房屋减少了 23% CJ Patrick Company 首席执行官 Rick Sharga 表示：“2026 年的房价将高于上一季度和 2025 年第一季度。调查还显示，32% 的受访者今年根本不打算购买任何房产，只有 9% 的受访者计划比一年前购买更多房产。”CJ Patrick Company 首席执行官 Rick Sharga 表示。

超过 60% 的受访者预计未来六个月房价将上涨，高于之前的略低于 52%调查。较高的价格会提高投资者的购置成本，同时增加他们已拥有的房产的潜在价值。

title: 特朗普下令对外国制造的零部件征收关税后，无人机股票上涨
content:
周五，在唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布征收进口关税以提振美国制造业和保护国家安全后，无人机股票上涨。

Unusual Machine 下跌 15%，Red Cat 上涨约 7%。Aerovironment 和 Kratos 也上涨。

“美国无人机生产需要迅速扩大，以确保美国的国家和经济安全，”白宫在一份新闻稿中写道，并补充说，外包零部件会带来重大安全和网络安全问题。

白宫表示，关税将创造新的就业机会，同时保护美国国家安全和国防工业基础。

该指令对具有热成像等“敏感”军事能力的大型无人机征收 100% 的关税，对缺乏这种能力的小型无人机征收 25% 的关税。特朗普对来自欧盟、日本、列支敦士登、韩国、瑞士和台湾的无人机和零部件征收 15% 的关税，对来自英国的无人机和零部件征收 10% 的关税。

总统的儿子小唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump Jr.) 于 2024 年 11 月加入其顾问委员会，该公司生产无人机和无人机零部件。截至 2024 年 11 月，小特朗普持有该公司 331,580 股股票。 2024 年 11 月 27 日。

美国正在寻求扩大在美国境内的无人机生产规模，并减少对外包零部件的依赖，尤其是对长期主导无人机市场的中国的零部件的依赖。

这些努力是特朗普实现美国军事再工业化和扩大国防能力的更广泛计划的一部分。

今年早些时候，特朗普政府推出了价值超过 10 亿美元的无人机。旨在扩大美国小型低成本无人机制造规模的主导计划。该项目的第二阶段定于本月开始。

国外的地缘政治风险和伊朗战争凸显了对低成本武器进行作战的需求。特朗普政府要求 2027 年国防预算达到创纪录的 1.5 万亿美元。作为该预算的一部分，国防部正在寻求历史性的 750 亿美元用于无人机。

关税将在 21 天内生效。对于不是“特别敏感”的无人机和零部件，关税将在 180 天内生效。该命令还允许商务部启动一项本土计划，以帮助希望在美国投资无人机的公司。

title: 因山火风险临时禁止销售一次性烧烤炉
content: 图片来源，EPA图片标题，一些零售商已经从销售中撤回一次性烤架作者：政治记者理查德·惠勒和汤姆·麦克阿瑟发布时间：2026 年 8 月 14 日，英国夏令时 14:09 更新时间：38 分钟 处置型烧烤炉已被暂时禁止销售，因为担心干旱和热浪天气继续席卷英国，它们对公众构成“重大风险”。英国商业、创新、科学和贸易部 (DBIST) 表示，“夏季，全国范围内发生了多起严重的野火”。本周早些时候，眼镜蛇紧急会议上首次讨论了可能的禁令，讨论了政府对创纪录气温的反应。与此同时，英国首相安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 表示，随着西米德兰兹郡的消防人员继续与多起火灾作斗争，英国就像“易燃物”。米德兰工作人员在第二天处理多起火灾观看：斯托布里奇的“大屠杀”，房屋被大火摧毁。 3小时前发布是什么导致了夏季野火？ 7月25日发布在目前的情况下，一次性烧烤炉“不能被视为安全产品”，并且在英国“目前不得在商店或网上销售”，DBIST发布的建议称，外部。所有零售商都将收到有关这一变化的指导，该指导将继续接受审查，伯纳姆告诉BBC。伯纳姆还表示，全国范围内燃烧的一些野火可能是由一次性烧烤炉引发的。在接受BBC广播5号直播节目的马特·乔利采访时，首相表示：“英格兰和威尔士目前发生了37起火灾，其中四起是重大事件。”他补充道：“我们将进入一个艰难的周末，请想想我们所处的情况。”英国现在就像一个火药桶。在任何类型的户外环境中放火都会对其他人的房屋构成风险，对其他人的生命构成威胁，不要这样做，请不要这样做。”根据消防队长和英国零售联盟于 2023 年达成的框架，许多大型零售商和超市已经自愿停止销售这些设备。它表示，一旦宣布极端高温事件即将发生，或者针对“合理的证据”，零售商应该暂停销售。图片来源，路透社图片说明，伯纳姆表示，英国消防员没有适当的装备来应对野火。伯纳姆还表示，他计划像欧洲和美国使用的那样，委托消防飞机来扑灭野火的蔓延。他说，英国必须“面对”“不断变化的气候”，需要过渡到“更清洁的能源”。他说，正在制定计划，为消防部门提供紧急财政支持，以应对野火的蔓延。他说：“我们全国各地的消防和救援服务没有适当设置来应对这些事件。”周四，由于大火蔓延干草并烧毁房屋，居民逃离家园。西米德兰兹救护车服务中心表示，该地区八起不同的火灾共救治了 54 名伤员。十九人被送往医院接受治疗。相关主题英国热浪热浪更多关于这个故事到目前为止我们对西米德兰兹大火的了解发布于 14 分钟前气候变化如何加剧热浪、干旱、野火和洪水发布于 2025 年 11 月 5 日

title: 数据泄露通知数量已经超过了去年的总数——人工智能正在发挥越来越大的作用
content:
Even as companies devote more resources tocybersecurity, the number of reported data breaches involvingconsumers' personal data is on pace to surpass last year's record.

More than 471 million million victim notices were associated with data compromises in the first half of 2026, according toa new reportfrom the Identity Theft Resource Center, a nonprofit that assists identity-theft victims and tracks publicly reported data breaches. A cyber incident thatoccurred at education tool Canvasaccounted for more than half of those notices, at 275 million.

The half-year tally compares with 297.5 million notices issued in all of 2025, the ITRC report shows. The number of incidents reached 1,803 in the first half of the year, up from 1,732 during the same period in 2025. If the second half of the year is as active, the final tally for 2026 will eclipse the 3,321 security incidents reported for all of last year.

"We continue to see this ever-increasing number of data breaches," said James Lee, president of the ITRC. "That does not appear to be slowing down."

The increase in data breaches comes asartificial intelligence's ever-improving capabilities make it easier to exploit vulnerabilities in company systems. Between March 2025 and February 2026, one in four breaches was AI-enabled, up 56% from a year earlier, according toa new studyfrom IBM.

Cybersecurity ranks among the top three priorities for 93% of audit committees at public companies, according toa 2025 surveyreleased by Deloitte's Center for Board Effectiveness and the Center for Audit Quality, a nonprofit focused on the integrity of financial reporting. Half of the survey's 237 respondents ranked cybersecurity as the leading priority.

Most polled companies around the globe — 78% — indicated they would boost their cybersecurity budgets over the next 12 months,according to a surveyof 3,887 business and technology executives from 72 countries and territories released by accounting firm PwC last October.

Meanwhile, the ITRC report said 21 events in the first half of this year involved "malicious insiders," up from three events for all of 2025. A malicious insider is a person within an organization who uses their access or authority to steal data.

"The raw number doesn't look very big, but when you look at the historical trend line, insiders haven't been big sources of data breaches," Lee said. "We've never seen more than three data breaches in a given year related to a malicious insider, and you get 21 in six months."

Part of the increase is due to disgruntled laid-off employees who "were stealing information on their way out the door," Lee said.

Additionally, the ITRC report notes that some organizations have been targeted by a scam theFBI has flaggedin which North Korea places remote information technology workers in U.S. businesses using stolen identities, deepfake videos during interviews and AI-generated resumes. "This is arguably the most significant structural driver of malicious insider attacks," the report reads.

Lee said that malicious insider attacks probably occur more frequently than reported because only 24% of notices sent to affected consumers in the first half of 2026 included details of the data breach. In 2021, 93% of notices sent out included specifics of the incident.

However, Lee said court cases may have led companies to reduce what they include in their notices to only what is required, which varies from state to state.

"We don't have any uniformity," Lee said. "Where you live determines if you find out [about a breach], and if you do find out, what you're told."

For consumers, the best way to protect your personal information from being used is to protect your credit, experts say.

You can review your credit reports from the credit-reporting firms —Equifax,ExperianandTransUnion— atAnnualCreditReport.comfor free as often as once weekly, said John Ulzheimer, a credit expert and president of The Ulzheimer Group in Atlanta. Doing so does not affect yourcredit score.

You also can sign up for free credit-monitoring services that alert you when something changes on your report that could be indicative of fraud, Ulzheimer said.

Alternatively, you can put a fraud alert on your credit report, which "would compel lenders to contact you if they receive an app in your name to confirm it's authentic," he said.

The most secure way to guard against someone getting a loan in your name is to freeze your credit at each of the credit firms, which means your credit report cannot be checked. This free precaution generally will prevent a bank from approving a new account or loan in your name.

However, if you need to legitimately apply for a loan or credit account, you have to first lift your credit freeze temporarily.

This can be an annoyance to do, Ulzheimer said.

"But it's kind of the Fort Knox of credit protection. If you're meaningfully concerned about your information being out there, I always suggest a credit freeze," he said. "Then just remember to thaw it when you want to apply for credit."

title: 44% 靠工资过活的美国人在等待发薪日期间产生了额外费用。这3张信用卡可以帮助你
content:
If you're struggling to make it paycheck to paycheck, the last thing you need is to be hit with some unexpected bank fees.

According to aCNBC and SurveyMonkey Quarterly Money Survey, of the 63% of Americans living paycheck to paycheck, just under half (44%) have incurred late fees, interest or bank overdraft charges in the last six months while waiting for their next paycheck to arrive. This goes to show that for a significant portion of the population, it's not just having the money; it's having it when you need it.

If you're in a financial pinch, you can't (or shouldn't) skip paying your credit card bill — but you can make sure you aren't getting hit with extra fees. CNBC Select takes a look at some of the most commonly encountered banking fees and thecredit cardsthat can help you avoid them.

Senior reporter Jason Stauffer can answer your questions about how to make the most of your credit cards in his weekly Points Pro column.Submit yours here.

The three most common fees encountered by our survey respondents were:

Each of these is a very different fee, sometimes from different entities. Late fees and interest are charged by your credit card issuer, withoverdraft feescharged by your bank when you try to withdraw more than you have.

There are also credit card annual fees, which are essentially the cost of owning a card, andforeign transaction fees, which are additional costs you’re charged when using your card outside the United States.

If you’re worried about being able to make the minimum payment for your card, or if you’re trying to avoid interest charges, there are a few steps you can take ahead of time.

One of the most important pieces of info is knowing your credit card’s due date. If it falls at an awkward time for you, maybe between paychecks, you can request it be moved to a more convenient date.

Auto pay is also your friend in most situations, at least for making the minimum payments. If you’re signed up, you won’t have to remember to manually make a payment each month. Just be aware of how much you’ve committed to spending. When the time comes to pay your bill, if you don’t have enough funds, you could be hit with an overdraft fee.

If you have a hard time keeping track of specific dates or managing multiple cards, consider consolidating the number you have to manage. A two-card system might be a more effective fit: One card that earnsflat-rate rewards(typically 2%) and another that earns bonus rewards in categories you enjoy spending on.

Lastly, if youmiss a credit card paymentand it’s your first time, there’s a chance your issuer will waive the fee. While this is never guaranteed, some banks might do this as a courtesy for otherwise good or loyal customers; simply reach out and ask.

Part of the reason theChime Card™doesn’t charge an annual fee is that it’s a secured card; the money in your Chime account is your credit limit. While this restricts your credit limit, it can be a great way to make sure you’re not overspending. Plus, you won’t be hit with overdraft charges; Chime offers *SpotMe®, which lets you overdraft up to $200 without fees on debit and credit card transactions that exceed your current balance.

Depending on which *Chime membership you have, you can earn up to 5% cash back on a self-selected category each month when you make qualifying direct deposits. The options are utilities and bills, groceries, gas, travel and more. Since most of the rewards are tied to your Chime membership (the highest requiring $3,000+ in qualifying direct deposits every 34 days), this card is best suited for those who use Chime frequently.

Terms apply.**Review Chime Disclosureshere.

If you’re currently managing debt, theCiti Simplicity® Cardcould be a good fit. It offers a year-and-a-half-long intro APR on both purchases and balance transfers, alongside a lower introductory balance transfer fee.

The card is also a good option for those who struggle to make on-time payments: It doesn’t charge any late fees or apply a penalty APR, regardless of how many you miss. Just know that other negative side effects, like a lower credit score, won’t vanish. One major sacrifice you’ll be making for these flexible terms is rewards, as the card doesn’t earn cash back or points on purchases.

Receive a 0% intro APR for 18 months on balance transfers and purchases from the date of account opening.

See rates and fees. Terms apply. Read ourCiti Simplicity® Card review.

Information about the Citi Simplicity® Cardhas been collected independently by Select and has not been reviewed or provided by the issuer of the card prior to publication.

The Citi Simplicity® Card has amazing intro-APR offers and is particularly valuable for balance transfers due to its lower introductory fee.

There is an intro balance transfer fee of 3% of each transfer (minimum $5) completed within the first 4 months of account opening. After that, your fee will be 5% of each transfer (minimum $5).

If you’ve run into credit issues in the past, theTilt Essentials Carddoesn’t require a security deposit or a detailed credit history. You’ll earn 3% on gas and groceries when you enroll in auto pay, separate from the 1% you earn on all spending. And if your initial credit line is a little lower than you’d like, at just four months, you could be eligible for an increase.

There are certain issuers, like Discover, that waive the fee the first time you pay late (up to $41 thereafter). This can serve as a first-time cushion, but it doesn’t offer any permanent solution if this happens to you frequently.

The Tilt Essentials Card could be a good fit for those worried about their current credit score, as the card is available with no security deposit or credit history required.

The Tilt Essentials Card charges very few fees and allows you to earn rewards with a card that doesn't require an extensive credit history.

title: 由于美国威胁对伊朗实施更多经济制裁，美国国债收益率几乎没有变化
content:
美国在美国表示对伊朗港口的海上封锁可能“无限期”持续后，周五美国国债收益率相对持平。

作为美国政府借贷的关键基准的 10 年期美国国债收益率上涨不到 1 个基点，至 4.645%。

更密切跟踪美联储短期利率政策的 2 年期国债收益率下跌超过 1 个基点至 4.129%。较长期30年期国债收益率上涨2个基点至5.231%。

1个基点等于0.01%，收益率和价格走势相反。

周五跟随美国股市上涨。财政部长斯科特·贝森特在接受 Newsmax 采访时发表上述言论，他在采访中警告称，旨在“经济孤立”伊朗的新措施“前所未见”。部队可能会维持对伊朗港口的无限期封锁。

生产者价格指数（衡量批发商购买原材料的价格）7 月份环比持平。道琼斯调查的经济学家预计增幅为 0.2%。

周四公布的消费者通胀数据温和，消费者物价指数符合经济学家的预期。

“本周美国通胀数据得到遏制，对国债来说非常受欢迎，”ING 策略师周五在一份报告中写道。 “这绝对缓解了利率上升的压力。但这种压力还远未消失。实际收益率更高，而且很可能保持不变。”

——CNBC 的休·莱斯克 (Hugh Leask) 也为本报告做出了贡献。

title: 北约飞机在拉脱维亚上空击落无人机，拉脱维亚指责“俄罗斯电磁战”
content:
该国武装部队表示，周五，北约战斗机在拉脱维亚东部上空击落了一架无人机，当局称这起事件与“俄罗斯电磁战”有关。

这架无人机在巴尔维地区上空被参加北约波罗的海空中巡逻任务的飞机摧毁。拉脱维亚表示，东部和南部几个地区发布了空域警报，并于当地时间凌晨 4:50 解除。

拉脱维亚表示根据翻译后的声明，这架被击落的无人机是“一架外国无人机”，“由于俄罗斯电磁战而飞入拉脱维亚”。该国武装部队没有立即回应 CNBC 要求提供事件进一步细节的请求。

事件发生后，芬兰于周五早些时候临时限制了芬兰湾东部的领空和海域，以防万一。芬兰国防军表示，没有无人机进入该国，当地时间上午7点后不久就解除了限制。

拉脱维亚总理安德里斯·库尔伯格斯于X日表示：“这证实了拉脱维亚领空受到保护。”

同时，此类事件提醒我们必须继续加强拉脱维亚东部边境的监视和反无人机能力，以便能够发现、识别和压制

库尔伯格斯于 5 月上任，此前拉脱维亚前政府因应对无人机入侵的政治争议而垮台。

俄罗斯对乌克兰的全面入侵加剧了波罗的海国家和芬兰的焦虑。芬兰在数十年的军事不结盟后于 2023 年 4 月加入北约，以加强对俄罗斯的防御，因为两国有着共同的共同利益拉脱维亚是与俄罗斯接壤的欧盟和北约成员国，因乌克兰战争而多次面临无人机进入其领空的情况。

其中一些是乌克兰无人机被俄罗斯电子战击落，例如干扰导航信号，这可能使它们的飞行路径变得不可预测，并使关于是否以及在哪里击落它们的决策变得复杂。

北约盟国最迟于 6 月在上空击落了另一架无人机。拉脱维亚领土，其武装部队也称这是“俄罗斯电磁战的结果”。

拉脱维亚国防部周五在一份声明中表示，“只要俄罗斯继续对乌克兰进行侵略，涉及外国无人机进入或接近拉脱维亚领空的类似事件就可能发生。”

俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫周五表示，俄罗斯将“进一步加强我们摧毁西方提供的一切物品的方法”据俄罗斯通讯社国际文传电讯社报道，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基本周早些时候警告称，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京正准备让战争升级，他呼吁盟国加大对莫斯科的制裁压力，并向基辅提供进一步的防空支持。

俄罗斯军队加大了对乌克兰城市的导弹袭击力度，可能是想利用这一机会基辅的弹道导弹拦截器供应有限。

但乌克兰最近在针对俄罗斯能源基础设施和主要物流中心的远程导弹方面取得了成功。

- CNBC 的萨姆·梅雷迪思 (Sam Meredith) 对本报告作出了贡献

title: 《Pokémon Pokopia》销量突破 500 万份后任天堂股价上涨 7%
content:
任天堂股价周五在日本收盘上涨 7%，此前该公司透露其旗舰 Switch 2 游戏机上的《精灵宝可梦 Pokopia》销量突破 500 万台。

任天堂周四表示，该里程碑是在 3 月 5 日推出后四个多月后达到的。这将使其成为 Switch 2 上第二畅销的游戏，领先于《大金刚 Bananza》和《马里奥赛车世界》。

这款游戏于去年 9 月首次发布，但由于它是《神奇宝贝》主要系列的衍生作品，因此并没有被视为一款大作。它的游戏玩法具有《动物森友会》的元素，这是任天堂在初代 Switch 上最受欢迎的游戏之一。

投资者密切关注游戏销售的更新，因为热门游戏往往可以推动任天堂游戏机的出货量，而任天堂游戏机却面临着一些阻力。

不断上涨的内存价格迫使该公司提高了一年多前上市的 Switch 2 的价格。

在 6 月份的季度，任天堂售出了 382 万台 Switch 2游戏机同比下降34.4%。该公司预计，截至 2027 年 3 月 31 日的财年，Switch 2 游戏机的销量将达到 1,650 万台，也将低于上年同期。

任天堂周四还宣布了《Pokémon Pokopia》的扩展包和更新，因为它希望吸引新玩家并保持现有玩家的参与度。

任天堂的股价今年仍下跌超过 16%。但在过去一个月里，由于投资者押注前景改善，并希望即将推出的大作游戏能够刺激主机销量，该股上涨了 26% 以上。

任天堂计划在 Switch 2 上推出《塞尔达传说：时之笛》，这是 1990 年代首次在任天堂 64 上发布的经典游戏的翻拍版。

两款新的神奇宝贝游戏也计划在 Switch 2 上推出。明年。 《神奇宝贝》和《塞尔达》是任天堂最受欢迎的两款系列游戏之一。

title: 人工智能的基础设施热潮正变得越来越杠杆化——而且更难追踪
content:
AsNvidiapartners with Wall Street firms to mobilize more than $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure, the increasingly complex financing underpinning the boom is coming under closer scrutiny.

Hyperscalers and their financial backers are turning to bond markets, joint ventures, leases and other structures to fund an unprecedented infrastructure buildout. At the same time, leverage is increasing investors' AI exposure, as hedge funds and other investors use prime brokerage borrowing and derivatives to amplify returns on their bets on the boom.

But the unravelling of AI-focused hedge fundSituational Awareness, after losses on its leveraged equity bets, is heightening concerns over how much is being borrowed, where it sits, how visible it is, and how quickly it could unwind, as market watchers debate whether revenues justify the scale of spending.

Nvidia's plan to develop platforms for AI infrastructure in partnership withApollo,Blackstone,BlackRock,Brookfield,KKRandGoldman Sachscould involve private asset-like structures and asset-based financing. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC Monday that Nvidia's chips are now an "investable infrastructure asset."

Some tech giants are using joint ventures and other leasing vehicles to borrow money for AI data center spending — without the debt appearing on their balance sheets until the leases begin.

Goldman Sachs analysts estimated that hyperscalers have combined lease commitments for data centers, R&D facilities, offices and equipment of $1.5 trillion, up from about $200 billion five years ago. This includes about $1 trillion of "uncommenced" lease commitments, which are not yet shown in financial statements but will result in future payments.

This "can understate leverage and future liquidity needs as these obligations are eventually recognized and contractual payments come due," Goldman analysts said in the Aug. 6 note.

This surge in debt issuance — including less-visible forms of leverage — is sharpening the focus on whether the eventual returns from AI infrastructure can justify the vast sums being spent.

Lotfi Karoui, multi-asset credit strategist at PIMCO, said the AI capex cycle is, adjusted for inflation, on track to be the largest investment cycle since the 19th-century railway construction.

But the ultimate scale of the buildout remains "deeply uncertain," he said in PIMCO commentary dated Aug. 11, highlighting consensus forecasts that hyperscaler capital spending alone will surpass $1 trillion per year from 2027 onward, "with no clear signs of moderation."

Karoui said that the scale of hyperscalers' borrowing is such that they are diversifying their debt issuance beyond dollar-denominated paper, with issuers tapping euro, sterling, yen, Swiss franc and Canadian dollar markets.

He added that the relative outperformance of euro-denominated bond spreads issued byAmazonandAlphabet, compared with their U.S. counterparts, potentially hints at "demand fatigue" in the dollar market relative to euro-denominated paper.

He warned that the wave of AI-related issuance in the U.S. could see spreads drift higher because of the underperformance of a handful of larger AI-exposed issuers.

Situational Awareness' collapse showed how vulnerable crowded, leveraged AI trades can be to the sharp sell-offs and rallies the sector has seen recently.

The fund was unable to meet a series of margin calls from lenders after its heavily concentrated portfolio — which included names such asSK HynixandCoreWeave— suffered during a recent tech sell-off and its assets fell from $45 billion to about $10 billion.

Ken Griffin's larger, multi-strategy hedge fund Citadel later stepped in to buy Situational Awareness' publicly listed positions at a discount. SK Hynix and CoreWeave have since rallied.

JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimonrecently told CNBC'sLeslie Pickerthat margin debt is "pretty high," adding that it increases the risk of amplified volatility.

Sahil Mahtani, director of the investment institute at Ninety One, told CNBC that elevated earnings expectations were a more immediate concern than leverage

He said expectations "of high and rising earnings in the years ahead" were "the main risk" the AI trade posed to markets. "That is primarily an expectations problem rather than a leverage problem," Mahtani said via email.

He said equity concentration is "historically high" in tech-heavy markets, especially the U.S. While that may not be financial leverage, he said the concentration can act like leverage by amplifying market moves when heavily weighted stocks fall.

"The big equity indices are extremely concentrated, and no one thinks anything could possibly derail them," Mahtani added, but warned that a shift from companies buying back shares to issuing more stock could remove a source of support for equity prices just as AI-related valuations are already under pressure.

Mahtani said the Situational Awareness debacle reflected poor risk management, but that its broader impact had been largely contained.

"Its bull run coincided with the unwind of leveraged ETF structures, primarily in East Asia. Many of these structures, particularly the single-stock structures, were only launched in H1 of this year. In that sense, it is a relatively contained case study."

A spokesperson for the Alternative Investment Management Association, the global trade body for the hedge fund and alternatives industry, said leverage was a "core tool" used by hedge funds to boost returns and provide market liquidity.

"The key question is not whether hedge funds use leverage, but whether its use poses a material threat to financial stability. The available evidence does not support treating hedge fund leverage as an inherent systemic risk," the spokesperson told CNBC.

They said that two previous leverage-related ruptures — the collapse of Archegos Capital Management in 2021 and the 2022 U.K. Liability-Driven Investment gilt market stress — involved different structures and investors.

"It is important not to lump very different market events together. Archegos was a family office, not a hedge fund, while the 2022 gilt episode centred on leveraged LDI strategies used by pension funds. We have seen no reason to expect the Situational Awareness episode, in itself, to trigger a fresh review of the rules governing hedge fund leverage."

title: 特朗普盟友奈杰尔·法拉奇赢得特别选举返回英国议会
content:
英国右翼改革英国党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇 (Nigel Farage) 在上个月因财务争议辞职而引发的投票中赢得了议会连任。

法拉奇此前曾受到美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)的赞扬，也是英国脱欧运动的名义领袖，他因未能申报来自英国脱欧派的 500 万英镑（670 万美元）捐款而面临议会调查。总部位于泰国的加密货币投资者在 2024 年大选前夕。

他于 7 月 7 日辞职后，调查被暂停，并在周五选举结果公布后重新被列为活跃调查。法拉奇表示，这份礼物是个人礼物，旨在增加他的安全费用。

据英国广播公司报道，英国改革党正面临警方有关“不允许的”政党捐款的调查。

法拉奇试图将补选定位为反对“当权派”斗争的公投后，主流政党表示将抵制参加补选。这意味着他的主要对手是穿着盛装的系列候选人“宾菲斯伯爵”，他位居第二。

法拉奇没有在一夜之间参加计票，而是在选区其他地方的一次活动中与支持者发表讲话。

埃塞克斯郡的克拉克顿拥有支持法拉奇政党的记录。 2014 年，法拉奇领导的英国独立党在英国赢得了第一次选举。

“如果我赢得了一场压倒性的胜利，为我努力奋斗的一切赢得了强烈支持……却站在舞台上，却被无名之辈贬低和羞辱，那我就该死了。”将于 2024 年首次进入议会。英国改革党于 2021 年从法拉奇之前的脱欧党中脱颖而出，将其纲领扩展到对移民和签证规则采取更强硬立场、取消气候目标并削减一些税收。

在英国两大政党工党和保守党在民意调查中陷入困境之际，该党取得了进展，为包括绿党在内的另类政党提供了动力。

执政党工党该党在 5 月份的地方选举中取得了糟糕的结果，尽管民意调查显示，自安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 7 月凯尔·斯塔默 (Keir Starmer) 下台后就任总理以来，该党变得更受欢迎。

title: “绝对不可接受”：日本首相高市谴责普京访问有争议的千岛群岛
content:
日本首相高市早苗批评俄罗斯总统普京首次访问有争议的千岛群岛，称它们“本来就是日本领土”。

高市早苗周四表示，东京“一再要求俄罗斯方面确保总统不会访问北方四岛”。北方四岛指的是千岛群岛。

她补充说，普京的访问“绝对不可接受”。

千岛群岛位于俄罗斯堪察加半岛南端和日本北海道东北角之间。人口稀少的火山群岛将鄂霍次克海与太平洋分开。二战末期，苏联入侵日本领土时，该岛链最南端的四个岛屿被苏联吞并。

在访问期间，普京访问了伊图鲁普岛，俄罗斯在那里设有一个具有重要战略意义的军事基地。俄罗斯总统参观了一个鱼类加工厂、一家医院和一所学校，然后与萨哈林州州长瓦列里·利马连科举行会晤。

这次访问也遭到了日本外务大臣茂木敏充的批评，他在 Facebook 上发帖称“日本强烈抗议这次访问。”

日本放弃了 1951 年旧金山条约中的“对千岛群岛的权利、所有权和主张”，但不承认苏联主权

自战争结束以来，岛屿争端使东京和莫斯科无法签署和平条约，尽管1956年的联合声明结束了两国之间的战争状态。

华盛顿智库战争研究所的分析人士表示，普京的访问很可能是克里姆林宫对日本最新防卫白皮书的回应的一部分，旨在破坏高市改善日本实力的努力。防御能力。

日本本月早些时候发布了防卫白皮书，引发了普京以及俄罗斯盟友朝鲜的强烈抗议。俄罗斯总统批评白皮书将莫斯科视为东京的关键威胁之一。

“俄罗斯正在非法占领的北方领土上继续积极的军事活动，这些领土是日本的固有领土，”白皮书称。

title: 塔塔董事长令人震惊的退出举措使捷豹路虎所有者对芯片、iPhone和印度航空的押注面临风险
content:
The future of India's first semiconductor plant and the country's ambition to replace China as a major supplier toAppleface growing uncertainty after Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran said he would no longer seek another term.

Tata Group has made some of the "largest capital commitments" under Chandrasekaran's leadership, which in the latest letter to shareholders he described as the building blocks for India's road to becoming a developed country by 2047.

Tata Sons, the holding company of Tata Group, also acquired beleaguered national carrier Air India in 2022, started iPhone production after buying Wistron and Pegatron, reportedly overtaking Taiwanese companyFoxconn's India unitto become the country's largest Apple supplier.

In 2024, it unveiled plans to set upIndia's first semiconductorplant worth $11 billion in partnership with Taiwan's Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corp.

All these initiatives by the slat-to-steel conglomerate that also owns luxury automaker JLR are in the early investment cycles and are not churning profits.

The decision to take bold bets, risking losses at a time when the group's top money-spinning company,Tata Consultancy Services, grapples with theimpact of artificial intelligenceon the information technology sector has led to a rift between Tata Sons and its key shareholder, Tata Trusts, experts said.

The current "struggle" between Tata Trusts and Tata Sons arises from capital allocation to loss-making businesses, Ruchir Khare, chief investment officer at portfolio management firm Two X Capital, told CNBC, adding that the chairman's impending departure raises questions over the group's commitment to making large, long-term investments.

Chandrasekaran is seen as the "professional successor" to the late Ratan Tata, who had appointed him, said Khare, adding that the lack of continuity implies there is a difference of opinion among the two power centers on the future direction of Tata Sons.

On Thursday, a day after Chandrasekaran gave up on another term as chairman,expressing displeasure at the delayin finalizing his reappointment for another five years, the process has formally begun to look for the 63-year-old's replacement.

Sir Dorabji Tata Trust, part of the key trusts that together hold a 66% stake in Tata Sons, said in a statement that it "respects Mr. Chandrasekaran's decision not to offer himself for re-appointment" and extends "full support to Tata Sons in ensuring a smooth, timely and orderly transition of leadership."

Chandrasekaran, in his resignation letter on Wednesday, said the proposal to extend his term had been pending for six months and "was not carried through because one of the Board Members did not support it." As per local media reports, he had disagreements with Noel Tata, the chairman of Tata Trust, over the weakening profitability and capital allocation to loss-making businesses.

During the financial year ended March 2026, Tata Sons' consolidated net profit slipped 35% to 266 billion rupees (about $2.78 billion) as losses from Air India, Tata Digital and Tata Electronics piled up, as perTata Sons' latest annual report.

While all these loss-incurring businesses are unlisted, the market capitalization of Tata Group's listed companies dropped 12% during the same period, as shares of its IT service companyTCS correctedon concerns over long-term growth outlook.

Tata Sons did not respond to CNBC's request for comments, while Tata Trusts did not reply to questions around capital allocation concerns.

Tata Trusts, which relies on the income generated by Tata Sons, wants to be conservative with capital allocation at a time when its key cash-generating IT services business is under pressure, said Anil K. Sood, professor and co-founder of Mumbai-based Institute of Advanced Studies in Complex Choices.

Air India acquisition, for example, is not only draining capital, but also "damaging" the Tata brand due to its frequent operational issues, he said. Meanwhile, a cash-rich, high-margin IT services business is being disrupted by AI, and investments are being made in "commoditized" businesses, Sood said.

Experts point out that in this power struggle,Tata Trustshas the upper hand as it plays the role of a kingmaker by deciding the leadership at Tata Sons.

This dual power center led to the unceremonious exit of another Tata Sons Chairman, Cyrus Mistry, a decade ago. Mistry was ousted from his role in 2016 following public spats with Ratan Tata, who at the time was heading the Tata Trust.

"I look at the current situation with a lot of irony," Ramesh Vaidyanathan, managing director at BTG Advaya, an Indian law firm specializing in corporate dispute and transactional law, told CNBC.

Mistry was focusing on "maximizing return on equity" and being "clinical" in cutting back investments, while it was Ratan Tata who wanted the business to take bolder bets, said Vaidyanathan, adding that in the current boardroom battle, roles have reversed.

While the Tata group has lived long with this dichotomy of two power centers, experts said that the current tussle between Tata Trusts and Tata Sons is particularly pressing as it comes at a time when the business is in the middle of a serious investment cycle.

They added that Chandrasekharan's successor will have an unenviable role of managing a course correction that the Tata Trusts want while delivering a message to the markets that the group is prepared to face the next wave of global challenges.

Tata Sons has convened its annual shareholder meet on Aug. 18, where the board is likely to discuss succession, as Chandrasekaran's term ends in February next year.

title: 中国制造了可以后空翻的机器人——但它们能赚钱吗？
content:
As retail excitement around the listing of China's best-known humanoid maker, Unitree Robotics, reaches fever pitch, skeptics are questioning how long it will take before these robots can move beyond running and acrobatics to perform genuinely useful work.

The Hangzhou-based startup priced its IPO at 150.8 yuan ($22.4) a share, raising $900 million and valuing the company at 61 billion yuan, or about $9 billion.

Investors expect a big first-day pop from Unitree, when its shares start trading on Shanghai's STAR market later this month, making it the first humanoid robot firm to list on the mainland.

Unitree's offering saw record retail demand in Shanghai's STAR market, with the online tranche oversubscribed more than 5,000 times, translating toa historically lowlot-winning rate of 0.018%. Its IPO also attracted strategic investors including AI startup DeepSeek.

AUnitree-linked pre-IPO perpetual contract on Hyperliquidwas trading at roughly four times its IPO price as of Friday, as investors turn to crypto-derivative exchanges to bet on stocks before trading begins.

Celebrated for throwing kung fu kicks and bouncing back from knockdowns, Unitree's robots still face questions over whether the technology can scale commercially, with AI and software constraints unresolved.

"For these humanoid robots, to be honest, they're fascinating. They can dance and all that – but never seen them doing any real housework," said Hao Hong, managing partner of Lotus Asset Management.

In itsprospectus, Unitree said that progress for large-scale commercial adoption may be slower than expected, as robotic hands are still not precise or durable enough for sustainable use.

Hong noted that retail investors are piling in partly because there are so few humanoid robotics companies to invest in.

Dominik Pross, equity analyst at VP Bank, says even advanced humanoid robots can typically handle only a small number of tasks – and for just a few hours before having to recharge their batteries. Most humanoid modelsrun for up to four hourswhile sitting idle.

"Robots have to be specifically trained for each and every task entrusted to them, even the simplest," he said, adding that complex everyday activities are not yet within reach.

More robotics listings are set to follow. Unitree rival AgiBot and Leju Robotics are seeking to go public in Hong Kong and Shenzhen, respectively. LimX Dynamics founder Will Zhang told CNBC last month that"listing is a must."

Lower-cost manufacturing has helped China pull ahead of global rivals in robotics.

Wood Mackenzie expects the global humanoid robot fleet to grow more than 90% annually through 2035 to surpass 10 million units. Annual shipments are projected to top 4 million by then. China is already the dominant player, accounting for more than 70% of global industrial robot installations and nearly 90% of all humanoids deployed last year, according to the research firm.

Average humanoid robot prices have plunged 93% between 2020 and 2025 to $58,000, according to Wood Mackenzie. The firm projects that Unitree's $16,000 flagship G1 model costs just $82 a year in electricity to run for eight hours a day, but says wider adoption could add pressure to electricity systems already stretched by AI data centers.

SemiAnalysis estimates that Unitree has cut the pre-tax price of its G1 EDU model – a customizable one built for research – by more than 45% since last year to $27,300, while maintaining a 67% gross margin.

Falling robot prices and Chinese government support – including investing in domestic manufacturers' shift from labor-intensive work to automation – are helping fuel interest and attracting funds into the emerging sector, said Linda Sui, founder of research firm Smart Analytics Global. While higher production volumes helped bring down costs, it will take time to test the robots' return on investment, Sui said.

Analysts say Unitree's edge lies in its manufacturing scale and cost structure. Unitree's revenue more than quadrupled last year, but first-quarter adjusted profit fell more than 52% as spending on R&D and marketing rose.

Skeptics say much of Unitree's current demand is still concentrated in research and demonstrations. Nearly three-quarters of its humanoid revenue came from research and education in the first nine months of 2025, while corporate tours made up more than half of its still-small industrial business, a company filing showed.

"Unlike many early-stage robotics companies, the Unitree story is backed by real revenue growth," said Jeff Ko, chief analyst at CoinEx. Still, he said, Unitree's lofty $9 billion valuation – over 200 times last year's earnings – was pushed even higher in crypto markets, pointing to a speculative element.

The IPO frenzy held up even after the U.S. moved to ban imports of foreign-made humanoid and four-legged robots last month, a move seen as targeting Chinese technology products.

Unitree may be "particularly exposed," deriving 13% of its revenue last year from the U.S., according to SAG.

Unitree's lower-cost robots have become a go-to choice for research humanoids at U.S. universities, but some researchers are unfazed about new restrictions because small-batch imports for testing and development remain exempt. Unitree's four-legged robots were also used inU.S. state correctional systemsand military settings, according to the House Select Committee on China, raising national security concerns.

Another major geopolitical risk is the possibility that Chinese robotics companies could lose access to Nvidia's hardware and software stack, said SAG's Sui. China's industry leaders are among the early users of Nvidia's platforms for powering robots.

"Chinese robot producers are not yet in a position to do without Western components completely," said VP Bank's Pross.

But China's dominance in rare earths, used in the actuators and motors of humanoid robots, gives the country's players significant leverage over global peers, said Dien Wang, an analyst at Bernstein.

While the humanoid robotics industry has a long way to go, the potential market opportunity has led to Tesla CEO Elon Musk doubling down on robotics, converting EV production lines at the company's Fremont factory to make Optimus humanoid robots. Production is expected to start later this year.

Some researchers argue Unitree isn't just a humanoid bet. Humanoids are Unitree's largest business, but quadruped robots still account for a sizable share. Purpose-built robots can be cheaper and more reliable in repetitive industrial settings, while humanoids are best-suited for unpredictable and less structured environments, they say.

title: 利基铜贸易如何成为特朗普下一步关税举措的实时衡量标准
content:
金属商品的一项专业套利交易正在演变为美国关税风险的实时衡量指标。

铜被视为更广泛的经济晴雨表，工业金属是建筑、电子和运输的关键组成部分，一年多来一直在飙升，上周期货达到每磅近 6.90 美元的历史新高。

美国 COMEX 期货和伦敦金属之间的价差历史上，实物交易商、银行、对冲基金、生产商和消费者一直利用汇率价格从暂时的价格差异中获利，并对冲两个市场之间的价格风险。

套利历史上是由中国需求冲击或南美供应中断等因素驱动的。

不过现在，法国兴业银行分析师表示，在白宫调查之前，对精炼铜征收新的第 232 条关税的前景已经颠覆了这一交易，投资者越来越多地利用 COMEX 溢价作为进一步关税的衡量标准。

美国已对半成品铜产品和某些其他铜制成的产品征收 50% 的进口税。美国商务部建议从 2027 年 1 月 1 日起对精炼铜分阶段征收 15% 的普遍关税，并于 2028 年 1 月 1 日升至 30%。

“COMEX-LME 价差已日益成为衡量美国关税预期的指标，较高的溢价表明感知到的关税风险更大，并将继续将金属拉入美国，”ING 大宗商品策略师 Ewa Manthey 通过 CNBC 向 CNBC 表示。电子邮件。

美国 7 月份进口了超过 20 万公吨铜，这是 12 年来的最高水平。

以 FIC 和大宗商品研究主管 Mike Haigh 为首的法国兴业银行分析师表示，随着人工智能基础设施、电网现代化和国防支出大幅增加全球需求，美国政策制定者越来越担心该国对进口精炼铜的依赖。

其部分232 调查反映了“确保获得对经济增长和国家安全都至关重要的材料”的更广泛目标。

为了将价差转化为关税赔率，法国兴业银行对将 LME 级铜从欧洲仓库运至美国东海岸的成本进行了建模，并将总交割价格与 COMEX 期货价格进行了比较。分析师表示，目前 COMEX 相对于完全交付的 LME 金属的溢价意味着商务部长建议的到 2027 年 1 月分阶段征收 15% 关税的可能性为 14.6%。

到 2028 年 1 月征收 30% 关税的可能性为 37%。

StoneX 的高级金属需求策略师 Natalie Scott-Gray 表示，逾期美国部门232关于精炼铜的决定现在是铜市场面临的“单一最大催化剂”。 Scott-Gray 在最近的市场评论中表示，全面关税将挤压美国以外的供应。相比之下，任何关税都不会解除 COMEX-LME 套利。

Manthey 表示，短期内更广泛的溢价仍对铜价构成支撑，“特别是在矿山供应依然紧张且中美之间对可用金属的竞争加剧的情况下。”

“我们对铜仍持建设性态度，尽管关税不确定性意味着波动性可能会继续升高。”她补充道。

title: 标准普尔 500 指数创下 7,800 点以上纪录后，股票期货几乎没有变化，即将迎来胜利周：实时更新
content:
Stock futures were little changed early Friday after a record-setting session, with two of the three major benchmarks on pace for their third consecutive weekly advance.

S&P 500 futurestraded around the flatline, whileNasdaq-100 futuresinched lower.Dow Jones Industrial Average futuresrose just 37 points.

TheS&P 500on Thursday hit an intraday all-time high of 7,816.70. The benchmark also closed at a record.

The tech and communication services sectors were among the big winners in the index, rising roughly 1% each.

In Asia, Japan'sNikkei 225added 0.44% while the Topix rose 0.49%. South Korea'sKospiadvanced 1.14%, and the small-cap Kosdaq lost 0.57%. Hong Kong'sHang Seng indexwas down 0.93%, while mainland China's CSI 300 inched 0.12% lower. Australia's benchmarkS&P/ASX 200was 0.92% lower.

"The market is appropriately bullish right now," Anastasia Amoroso, chief investment strategist at Partners Group, told CNBC's "Closing Bell" in an interview, noting the strength in U.S. corporate earnings.

With more than 90% of S&P 500 companies having posted second-quarter results, earnings growth from the year-earlier period is tracking around 50%, according to FactSet.

Amoroso also noted that software has "rallied and rebounded … I think the market came to the realization that maybe we did not appropriately price in those risks." Indeed, theiShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (IGV)is up around 28% over the past six months after tumbling more than 24% in the first quarter. IGV climbed more than 3% on Thursday.

Thursday's gain put the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite on pace for their third straight weekly advances. Heading into Friday's session, the former is up 0.5%, while the latter has advanced 0.4%. The Dow, meanwhile, is down 0.4% week to date.

There are no major earnings due Friday, but investors will have a look at July retail sales figures at 8:30 a.m. ET. Economists on average expect sales grew by 0.1% month over month, according to Dow Jones.

Oil prices were little changed Friday as investors weighed renewed U.S. threats against Iran and the prospect of a prolonged naval blockade against concerns over weakening global demand.

Brent crudefutures, the international benchmark, held steady at $86.99 per barrel.U.S. West Texas Intermediate crudewas similarly flat at $81.26 per barrel.

The U.S. will be applying economic measures "that have never been seen on Iran," according to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.

His statements come as U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegsethreportedly saidlate Thursday stateside that the U.S. military can keep a naval blockade of Iran going "indefinitely." The Navy will rotate ships in and out "as we have, and we'll continue to," Hegseth told reporters.

Mainland China and Hong Kong indexes were mixed Friday, bucking broad gains in other Asia markets.

Hong Kong'sHang Seng indexwas down 0.93%, while mainland China's CSI 300 was flat.

The declines in Hang Seng were led by healthcare and academic services sectors, down 1.11% and 1.06%, respectively.

Asian technology stocks rose Friday, tracking broad gains in U.S. tech amid lower oil prices and a flat producer price inflation reading, which supported risk-on sentiment.

In Japan,SoftBank Groupadvanced 5.08%, while chip equipment makerTokyo Electronadded 2.13%.Advantestadded 4.02%, and Japanese memory chipmakerKioxiarose 3.87%.

In South Korea, SK Hynix gained over 6%, while Samsung Electronics was 2.05% higher.

Tech stocks have been seeing heightenedvolatility, with South Korea's semiconductor-heavy market whipsawing between record gains and steep losses.

Asia-Pacific markets opened broadly higher early Friday, tracking Wall Street gains overnight.

Japan'sNikkei 225added over 0.75% while the Topix rose 0.23%.

South Korea'sKospiadvanced 2.54% at open, while the small-cap Kosdaq gained 1.10%.

Australia's benchmarkS&P/ASX 200was 0.63% lower.

Japan'sNikkei 225was poised to rise at open, with the Chicago futures contract at 69,350 and its Osaka counterpart last trading at 69,140, compared with the index's previous close of 68,308.59.

Hong Kong'sHang Seng indexfutures were at 25,214, lower than the index's last close of 25,396.51.

Futures for Australia'sS&P/ASX 200last traded at 9,091, while the index closed at 9,188.50.

TheS&P 500hit a new all-time intraday high Thursday as oil prices fell and investors assessed inflation data.

Meanwhile, tensions between the U.S. and Iran continue to simmer. The U.S. Central Command said in aposton X that it has launched "the first-ever multi-domain, multinational attack drone task force," nine months after its first dedicated one-way attack drone squadron in the Middle East.

Social media forumRedditwill join the S&P 500 starting on Aug. 18.

Shares surged 10% in after-hours trading.

Reddit has been having a rocky year, off 31% year to date.

The company will replaceAvalonBay Communities, a real estate investment trust with a portfolio of apartments.

Equity Residential is set to acquire AvalonBay, and the combined company will continue to trade on the S&P 500, though under its new name Vivmark Residential.

The percentage of mom-and-pop investors who are bullish about the outlook for stocks over the next six months narrowed to 34.7% from 37.0% in the latest weekly survey by the American Association of Individual Investors, below the historical average of 37.5%.

Bearish investors were little changed at 37.9% this week vs. 38.0% last week, still far above the long-term historical average of 31.5%.

Those investors who count themselves as neutral about the outlook for stocks widened to 27.4% from 25.0% last week, below the historic average of 31.0%.

The survey is regarded as a contrarian indicator, with extreme bullish readings signaling that investors may have mostly finished buying and have little cash left in reserve, and extreme bearish readings interpreted as meaning most selling is done and there's plenty of cash available to put to work in stocks.

TheDowhad its first positive day in four on Thursday. TheS&P 500andNasdaqposted back-to-back daily gains for the first time since Aug. 4. The S&P 500 also had its best day since Aug. 4.

Seven of the 11 S&P sectors gained during the day, with communication services leading, up 1.6%. Materials lagged, losing 0.7%.

Week to date, the Dow is lower, on track for its first negative week in three. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq are higher, on track for their third straight positive week. This would be the first three-week win streak for the S&P 500 since May 29 and for the Nasdaq since May 8.

So far this week, eight of the 11 S&P sectors are higher, with energy outperforming, up 5.9%. Consumer discretionary is lagging week to date, down 1.6%.

S&P 500 futurestraded just above the flatline along withNasdaq-100 futures.Dow Jones Industrial Average futuresrose just 25 points.

title: 美国称数十个国家帮助中国规避特朗普关税
content: 图片来源，法新社图片来源：盖蒂图片社 作者：Osmond Chia 商业记者 2小时前发布 白宫周四在一份报告中表示，超过40个国家通过美国进口关税较低的国家进行出口，帮助中国规避美国关税。这些国家包括加拿大、印度、墨西哥、日本和韩国，白宫称这些国家帮助中国规避了数百亿美元的关税。白宫贸易顾问彼得·纳瓦罗表示，这已经损失了“美国的就业机会”中国驻华盛顿大使馆发言人在回应BBC询问时表示，“贸易战没有赢家”，反对美国采取关税措施，反对利用国家力量针对中国企业。发言人补充说，“任何涉及转运货物的单方面行动或协议，不得针对或损害第三方利益。”该报告是在美国和中国之间一波制裁浪潮之后发布的，几周后唐纳德·特朗普总统将在华盛顿会见中国领导人习近平。根据白宫引用的政府和私营部门的估计，价值 300 亿美元（222 亿英镑）到大约 3000 亿美元的货物已从关税较高的国家通过关税较低的国家转移。这一过程被称为转运，指的是在前往最终目的地的途中通过另一个国家转运货物的做法。美国指责中国“白宫在报告中称，中国利用第三国作为中转站，并重新包装货物以隐藏其真实来源，以获取较低关税，并将这一过程描述为“披着文书工作的欺诈”。“今天的大转运骗局所改变的不仅仅是这种现代走私形式的速度和规模，而是全球影子转运网络的广度、深度和复杂性。白宫写道：“中国的逃税行为现在有所行动。”白宫写道，美国已部署人工智能（AI）工具来捕获转运活动。随着特朗普和习近平准备于 9 月在美国会面，该报告预计将加剧双方之间的关键症结。尽管 2025 年 5 月会谈后暂停了大部分关税，但华盛顿和北京仍在继续相互实施制裁，包括限制运往美国的人形机器人以及中国对无人机出口实施更严格的限制。 2025年，特朗普基于长期以来的信念，即关税将有助于提振美国就业和经济，宣布对数十个美国贸易伙伴征收全面关税。这些制裁后来被美国最高法院驳回，但特朗普多次利用替代性法律手段征收新关税，以继续其标志性政策。相关话题国际商务中国特朗普关税全球贸易更多关于这个故事特朗普征收了哪些关税以及为什么？8月5日发布特朗普政府偿还了1000亿美元对企业的“解放日”关税发布于 8 月 5 日

title: 美国将对伊朗使用“前所未见”的经济策略；海军致力于缓解陷入困境的亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰
content:
美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 表示，美国将对伊朗采取“前所未见”的经济措施。

“这将是世界前所未见的经济孤立，以及霍尔木兹海峡的持续封锁，阻止任何东西进出伊朗港口，”贝森特在接受 Newsmax 采访，但没有进一步详细说明。

据报道，美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯塞斯 (Pete Hegseth) 周四晚间在美国国内表示，美国军方可以“无限期”地维持对伊朗的海上封锁。

他发表上述言论之际。赫格塞斯告诉记者，海军将“像我们一样轮流进出，我们将继续这样做”。

媒体报道称，美国“乔治·华盛顿”号航空母舰将取代“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航空母舰，后者已在中东部署了 250 多天。其部署原定于 5 月结束。

美国海军在一份声明中表示，乔治·华盛顿打击群已于 8 月 12 日离开越南。

赫格斯还告诉记者，有关林肯号上恶劣条件的报道，包括食品短缺、士气低落，甚至水手试图跳海，这些报道“完全被歪曲”。

在赫格斯发表评论后，众议员迈克·莱文 (Mike Levin) 表示：加利福尼亚州民主党人 X 表示，他已致信赫格斯和代理海军部长曹洪，表达对林肯号舰上状况的严重关切。信中称，“来自军人家属和亲人的有关林肯号舰上状况的报告简直令人无法接受。报告内容包括淋浴发霉、厕所损坏、缺乏热水、无法获得新鲜农产品以及供应短缺等问题。”信中称。据称，他们的工作量“难以承受”，导致“极度疲劳和倦怠”。

在 X,U.S. 上的一篇帖子中。中央司令部表示，有关航母上发生斗殴的报道是虚假的，并且没有军人死亡。

此前伊朗媒体周二声称，林肯号上的“暴力冲突”已导致七名美国海军人员死亡，数人受伤。

title: Uber 与中国小马智行合作在欧洲提供 2,000 辆机器人出租车
content:
北京——美国网约车巨头优步 (Uberis) 与运营商小马智行 (Pony.ai) 合作，扩大其全球机器人出租车覆盖范围。

两家公司周五宣布，计划在欧洲部署 2,000 辆小马智行 (Pony.ai) 自动驾驶出租车，并将机器人出租车合作伙伴关系扩大到中东。

3 月底，优步 (Uber) 和小马智行 (Pony.ai) 在克罗地亚首都推出了商业机器人出租车服务萨格勒布——他们声称这是欧洲第一个。

周五宣布的合作伙伴关系将向其他四个欧洲城市推出机器人出租车。这些公司没有透露具体城市名称或确切的时间表。

拥有足够大的车队对于商业化至关重要。可用的汽车越多，可以收集的数据就越多，以便向监管机构证明安全性并提高运营效率。更高的可用性鼓励更多的人使用该服务。

Alphabet 支持的机器人出租车运营商 Waymo 是全球领先者，拥有约 5,000 辆汽车，主要在美国。该公司正在伦敦测试乘车服务，据报道，6 月份在欧盟四个主要经济体设立了新实体。

Waymo 还在东京制定计划，并正在与世界各地的官员合作，“为全球运营奠定基础”。

中国竞争对手百度 Apollo Go 和文远知行正在加紧在欧洲运营自动驾驶的计划和测试。

Uber 是他们许多计划的一部分。

文远知行和 Uber 在 6 月宣布计划于今年晚些时候在马德里推出西班牙首个机器人出租车驾驶员。两家公司还在阿布扎比和迪拜开展合作。

优步周四宣布，其日本子公司与当地一家出租车运营商签署了一项协议，负责管理日常车队运营，以便今年晚些时候在东京测试部署机器人出租车。

根据 FactSet 财报电话记录，优步首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西 (Dara Khosrowshahi) 本月早些时候表示，优步的目标是“成为世界领先的自动驾驶汽车商业化平台”。

该战略的一部分是收集“超级他说，“我们可以与合作伙伴共享一组数据，以加速自动驾驶汽车的开发。”

小马智行计划于周二发布季度财报。

——CNBC 的 Lora Kolodny 对本报告作出了贡献。

title: 从苹果到福特：中国技术如何变得越来越难以让跨国公司忽视
content:
Washington has been stepping up efforts to curb Beijing's technological ambitions, but from artificial intelligence to electric vehicle batteries, Chinese technology is becoming increasingly embedded in the businesses of some of the world's biggest companies.

Apple has tapped Alibaba and Baidu for AI in China, while Ford has turned to CATL for battery technology. Volkswagen has teamed up with Xpeng to develop smart EVs in China, while Stellantis is expanding its partnership with Leapmotor on EV production and joint purchasing.

Analysts say a broad shift is underway, with Chinese companies becoming sources of technology and innovation that global businesses cannot easily sidestep.

"Five years ago, China was primarily where global companies went to sell. Today, in certain sectors, it is where they go to source capability," Kitty Fok, managing director at market research firm IDC China, told CNBC.

That development comes even as Washington has expanded efforts to restrain Chinese technology.

Since blacklisting Huawei in 2019, it has imposed sweeping curbs on advanced chips and chipmaking equipment,restrictingcertain U.S. investments in Chinese semiconductors, quantum technology and AI, and proscribing firms including contract chipmaker Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation, or SMIC.

China has built formidable positions across a growing number of technology industries.

Automakers including BYD, Changan and Chery accounted for nearly 63% of the global electric vehicle market in 2025, while battery makers including CATL, BYD, CALB and Gotion held close to 70%, according to Soumen Mandal, principal analyst at Counterpoint Research.

Mandal pointed to cost, scale, manufacturing depth, supply-chain integration and the speed of innovation as powerful reasons for global companies to continue engaging with Chinese firms.

"China's technological rise is shifting from low-cost manufacturing to scale, supply-chain depth, and speed of innovation," Mandal said, adding that global companies are maintaining a balance between geopolitical risk and commercial realities.

That shift is particularly advanced in electric vehicle batteries.

CATL has become deeply integrated into the global automotive industry. Ford, for example, isworkingwith CATL to use its lithium-iron phosphate battery technology at a $3.5 billion battery plant in Michigan.

Fok said the integration of Chinese EV battery technology into global supply chains can be difficult to unwind.

"In EV batteries, the structural shift is already complete," she said. "Switching suppliers is not a procurement decision you make in a quarter. It takes years of engineering, testing, and recertification."

For some companies, however, working with Chinese technology firms remains primarily about competing inside China.

Multinational companies that need AI services or cloud infrastructure for their China operations have to work with local providers because of restrictions on foreign providers, according to Fok.

"Inside China, a lot of this isn't a choice," she said, pointing to Apple's work with Alibaba and Baidu.

Lian Jye Su, chief analyst at Omdia, said access to the Chinese market remains the primary driver for many such partnerships, particularly as global automakers increasingly turn to Chinese vendors for software, AI and other systems to sell in China.

But that is not the only driver. Su said a "slow yet persistent structural shift" was taking place in supply chains and innovation flows in areas including batteries, electric vehicles, energy storage and applied AI.

The trend is also beginning to play out in artificial intelligence, where increasingly capable Chinese models are challenging the idea that companies turn to Chinese technology mainly because it is cheaper.

An IDC survey of European companies earlier this year found security and compliance requirements and superior performance, not costs, were the top two reasons for extensive adoption of Chinese AI models.

"So the popular narrative that Western companies are rushing to Chinese AI because it's cheap gets this backwards," Fok said. "The decision is performance-led and compliance-gated."

Unlike U.S.-based Anthropic and OpenAI, Chinese firms including Alibaba and DeepSeek have focused on open-source models, making them more accessible to developers globally.

The Chinese AI advance comes even as U.S. restrictions have constrained Beijing in areas such as cutting-edge semiconductors, according to Su, while also accelerating domestic innovation.

"The key impact of the U.S. restriction is that it has become a catalyst for Chinese domestic innovation and efficiency," Su said, adding that Chinese vendors remain competitive in AI, batteries and automotive software.

Geopolitical considerations continue to shape how and where Chinese technology is adopted.

Su expects the resistance to Chinese technology to be strongest in areas including advanced semiconductors, services linked to cybersecurity, defense, and national security.

Rather than a straightforward technological boycott or embrace, analysts say Chinese technology adoption will vary by sector.

Counterpoint's Mandal expects Chinese technology adoption to expand globally across areas including EVs, batteries, consumer electronics, robotics, drones and selected areas of AI and semiconductors, leading to what he described as "a more fragmented but pragmatic global technology ecosystem."

Fok said the shift is already structural in batteries and electronics manufacturing, while AI is in transition and automotive software remains at an early stage.

title: 报道称，瑞安航空发动机部件砸碎窗户，男子头被吸出
content: 图标题，观看：瑞安航空飞机飞行时窗户脱落的内部 作者雅罗斯拉夫·卢基夫 (Jaroslav Lukiv) 于 2026 年 8 月 13 日发布 美国调查人员表示，上个月，破碎的发动机碎片击碎了瑞安航空一架飞机的机舱窗户，导致一名男子的头部和右肩被吸进洞里。国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 在一份初步报告中写道，这起事故是在 7 月 10 日从该航班起飞后不久，发动机风扇叶片断裂后发生的。希腊飞往德国。塞尔维亚国民柳比萨·卡罗维 (Ljubisa Karoviä) 的头部和右肩被吸出飞机窗外，使他“受了重伤，处于休克状态”。他的妻子斯韦特兰娜·格科维 (Svetlana Grkovi) 马克西莫维 (Svetlana Grkoviä) 后来告诉 BBC 塞尔维亚广播公司，她和另外两名乘客按住了他的腿几分钟。国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 表示，从塞萨洛尼基飞往梅明根的航班“遇到了 2 号（右侧）发动机” “爬升过程中风扇叶片故障（FBO）故障”。“机组人员选择返回SKG（塞萨洛尼基国际机场），在那里他们平安着陆。”事件发生后几天，希腊当局“委托全面调查”。它还详细列出了机组人员提供的事件时间表，机组人员表示，他们在爬升过程中收到了“高振动”发动机警报。作为回应，他们降低了发动机功率并进行了一系列检查。报告称，当振动停止后，机组人员继续在自动驾驶仪上爬升。但随后发动机振动加剧，机组人员听到一声巨响，促使他们宣布紧急情况并开始下降。空乘人员报告称，在氧气面罩打开之前听到并感觉到了振动，并看到少量烟雾。一名空乘人员表示，随后他们注意到一名乘客“部分卡在受损的客舱窗户中”，整个窗户都不见了，然后乘客呼救。发动机已接受超声波检查报告称，今年 5 月没有发现任何故障。瑞安航空老板迈克尔·奥利里 (Michael O'Leary) 早些时候表示，这起事件可能是由发动机“异物损坏”造成的。这架飞机由瑞安航空子公司马耳他航空运营。“如果我们死了，我们会一起死”：差点被瑞安航空飞机吸出的男子的妻子谈到了磨难。7 月 14 日发布 获取我们的旗舰时事通讯，其中包含您开始新的一天所需的所有头条新闻。在此注册。相关主题希腊航空旅行航空事故和事故瑞安航空欧洲

title: Mamdani 的纽约市临时住所税可以在法庭上诉期间继续推出
content:
一位上诉法官周四裁定，纽约市的“间谍之地税”可以继续按计划推出，但面临法律挑战。

该裁决是在史坦顿岛法官韦恩·奥齐周一发布临时限制令，暂时停止对超过一定价值的第二套房征税之后作出的。该税收已成为纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 的标志性政策。

马姆达尼 (Mamdani) 政府提出了一项寻求上诉的动议，从而触发了自动中止。周四早些时候，纽约市要求上诉法院确认自动暂停，认为奥齐的裁决“可能会破坏该市对新附加费的时间敏感的实施。”

该诉讼由三名城市居民提起，质疑推出的合法性，而不是税收政策本身。他们的诉讼凸显了该市分发了一份包含数千名房主信息的名单，并邮寄了通知，通知该名单上的 17,000 人可能需要缴纳新税。

根据最近的民意调查，民主社会主义者马姆达尼引起了保守派和富人的愤怒，但在其他方面仍然在该市广受欢迎。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 是皇后区人，曾住在曼哈顿的特朗普大厦，但特朗普于 2019 年将主要住所搬到了佛罗里达州，周二在《真相社会》帖子中宣布，“现在必须停止对第二套住房征收附加费！”

“我正在寻找联邦政府是否有任何合法权利来避免这场灾难，以免为时已晚。”特朗普写道。

目前尚不清楚特朗普或他的直系亲属是否需要缴纳纽约市税。周三，司法部长托德·布兰奇拒绝透露司法部是否正在探索针对该税收的法律选择。

title: 苹果公司蒂姆·库克与霍华德·卢特尼克共同开设休斯敦制造工厂
content:
周四，苹果公司首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 与包括商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 在内的政府官员一起，在德克萨斯州休斯顿开设了一家新制造工厂，为企业提供免费培训和教育课程。

该公司表示，该工厂也是苹果公司今年晚些时候将生产 Mac Mini 台式电脑的地方。苹果的人工智能服务器也在该工厂的一部分组装。

库克表示：“我们建立了一家工厂，开始生产，并将第一批先进的人工智能服务器下线，Mac Mini 的生产定于今年晚些时候开始。”他补充说，苹果在该设施上花费了数亿美元。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多年来一直敦促苹果在美国生产 iPhone。尽管该公司试图安抚政府，但它也担心特朗普提议的关税可能会扰乱其业务。

苹果公司选择强调其在美国生产的产品，例如零部件、芯片和玻璃盖板。库克周四表示，苹果去年从美国采购了超过 200 亿颗芯片，从台积电位于亚利桑那州的工厂采购了 1 亿颗芯片。

“几十年来，美国一直是世界技术的伟大发明者，我们看到世界其他地方都在开发这种技术，”卢特尼克在剪彩时说道。 “特朗普总统说，‘看，这必须改变。’”

“我们需要苹果公司致力于在美国发展，因为他们可能能够以独特的方式引领先进制造业进入美国，”卢特尼克继续说道。

此次联合亮相是在库克担任苹果公司首席执行官的最后几周内进行的。 9 月 1 日，他将成为执行董事长，长期担任苹果硬件高管的约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 将担任首席执行官。

库克与官员的会面可能是他未来发展的早期迹象，因为苹果表示库克将“协助公司的某些方面，包括与世界各地的政策制定者接触。”

虽然苹果从未表示将在美国生产 iPhone，但该公司在与特朗普政府会面时表示，其许多产品都将在美国生产。零部件均在美国制造，并且其供应链不再完全在中国生产，而是在印度和越南生产部分销往美国的 iPhone 和 Mac。

去年 8 月，苹果推出了一项 6000 亿美元的支出承诺，称为“美国制造计划”。苹果表示，通过订单、采购承诺以及与多家半导体公司扩大产能的努力，它正在支持美国制造业。它还在密歇根州开设了一个制造中心，提供课程和培训。休斯顿工厂的课程将包括使用机器学习进行质量控制等主题。

苹果领导人此前曾与特朗普官员一起出现，宣布 Mac Pro 在美国制造和服务器制造，但 Mac Mini 是一款面向消费者的产品，销量更高。

2019 年，库克与特朗普一起出现在德克萨斯州奥斯汀工厂，这里组装了 6,000 美元的 Mac Pro。去年，库克在白宫露面时表示，苹果将在休斯顿以外的地方为 Apple Intelligence 制造服务器。

Mac Mini 从来都不是苹果最受欢迎的 PC，但它找到了第二个用途，并在今年春天在一些商店中售空，因为一款名为 OpenClaw 的免费程序在人工智能爱好者中广受欢迎，他们发现苹果最小、最便宜的台式机非常适合运行人工智能代理。

“当我想到 Mac Mini 时，我想，好吧，这就像电脑上的电脑一样。你的办公桌，”卢特尼克说。 “然后我看到蒂姆。他说：‘不，不，不。’”

卢特尼克说库克告诉他你可以在计算机上运行先进的人工智能模型，“这些东西太棒了，对吧？”

更正：这个故事的早期版本包括了错误的活动日期。

title: 康涅狄格大学女子教练 Geno Auriemma 表示 WNBA 应该将焦点从跨性别辩论上转移开
content:
康涅狄格大学女篮教练吉诺·奥瑞玛 (Geno Auriemma) 表示，WNBA 专员凯西·恩格尔伯特 (Cathy Engelbert) 应该尝试将联盟的对话从跨性别问题上转移开，因为球迷不想观看“另一场抗议运动”。

“没有人会来看另一场政治声明。他们不会。他们是来看一场篮球比赛，”奥瑞玛在接受 CNBC 体育频道采访时说道。

随着联盟越来越受到关注，WNBA 已成为种族、性别和性取向争论的焦点。最近，印第安纳狂热队后卫索菲·坎宁安发表评论后，在印第安纳狂热队比赛中，出现了支持和反对变性人参与女子体育运动的集会，她说她想“保护更衣室里的年轻女孩，或者运动中的年轻女孩，她们不应该与生性男性对抗。”

本月早些时候，在印第安纳狂热队的一场比赛中，明尼苏达山猫队主教练谢丽尔·里夫穿着一件印有“跨性别儿童”的衬衫。属于。”

Auriemma 告诉 CNBC，他认为 WNBA 球员应该停止谈论跨性别问题——至少在联盟中没有跨性别运动员的情况下。 Layshia Clarendon 是联盟第一位公开变性和非二元性别的球员，在效力 12 个赛季后于 2024 年退役。克拉伦登出生时就被指定为女性。

“据我所知，没有哪个跨性别球员曾试图在联盟中打球，但却被拒绝参加联盟。这是一个已经被视为非问题的问题。它不存在。我不知道还有什么其他方式可以表达它，”奥瑞玛说。 “这是假设。就像那些抱怨《奥德赛》不真实的人一样。你怎么知道？这是神话。”

WNBA 发言人向 CNBC 证实，由球队总裁和总经理组成的 WNBA 特别工作组周三开会，部分讨论了跨性别运动员的问题。联盟指出，目前不存在涉及性别认同的资格问题。

“我们将根据我们联盟的价值观，深思熟虑地处理这些重要的对话，”发言人在一份声明中表示。 “目前没有影响 WNBA 的资格问题，我们强烈谴责利用这些话题贬低或边缘化他人的恶意行为。”

这并不是职业体育联盟第一次为如何处理政治或文化接触点而争论。 2016年，时任旧金山49人队四分卫科林·卡佩尼克和几名队友在奏美国国歌时单膝下跪，抗议警察的暴行和种族不公正。两年后，美国国家橄榄球联盟禁止了这种做法，要求球员在奏国歌时起立或留在更衣室“或在场外的类似位置”直到国歌结束。

全国女子足球联盟采取了不同的做法，允许球员跪下、站立或留在更衣室。

“我们将继续奏国歌，但会更加灵活，并支持每个球员表达自己观点的权利。时任 NWSL 专员丽莎·贝尔德 (Lisa Baird) 在 2020 年声明中说道。

亚历克斯·谢尔曼 (Alex Sherman) 主持的 CNBC 体育通讯为您带来体育商业和媒体领域的重大新闻和独家采访，每周发送到您的收件箱。

立即订阅即可获取访问权限。

虽然联盟专员通常很难控制个别球员的言行，奥瑞玛表示，他会建议 WNBA 的恩格尔伯特向球员传达有关联盟品牌的信息。

“我认为你能做的就是不断地向球员和所有利益相关者重申，我们希望被如何看待？我们希望给人留下怎样的印象？”奥瑞玛说。

他说他今年注意到了一个转变，称 WNBA 过去“迫切需要关注”，但现在“得到了他们想要的所有关注。”

“人们已经劫持了它，它已经变成了无论你观看哪个电视台，无论你想采取什么观点，你都会对 WNBA 正在发生的事情有自己的看法，”奥瑞玛说。 “哇，这不是很棒吗？好吧，如果你不谈论比赛本身，那就不会了。如果你不谈论球员个人的才华，以及打出令人难以置信的篮球的球队，那就不会了。

“WNBA 受到的关注 - 不，这不是你想要的女子运动的关注，”他说。

Auriemma 一直是康涅狄格大学女子篮球队的主教练。 40 多年来，他一直保持着由主教练夺得 NCAA 第一级篮球冠军次数最多的记录，共获得 12 次全国冠军。

Apple TV 将于 8 月 21 日发布一部关于 Auriemma 在康涅狄格大学时光的三集纪录片系列，名为“王朝：康涅狄格大学哈士奇队”。

title: 银湖收购报告显示 Workday 股价创 10 年来最佳表现
content:
有报道称，私募股权公司 Silver Lake 正在洽谈收购这家人力资源软件制造商，Workday 股价大涨近 18%，创 2016 年以来最佳单日涨幅。

路透社报道后，该公司股价在午后交易中多次停牌，该公司市值收于近 510 亿美元。

据路透社援引知情人士消息称，近几个月来，讨论一直在持续进行。

Workday 和 Silver Lake 没有立即回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

近几个月来，对人工智能工具将颠覆软件商业模式的担忧令 Workday 股价承压。尽管存在这些担忧，但对该领域的收购可能会暗示软件需求的复苏。

该股已从最近的抛售中反弹，但股价同比下跌 7%。

3 月，联合创始人 Aneel Bhusri 在 Carl Eschenbach 下台后改名为首席执行官。 Bhusri 在公司担任过各种领导职务，包括担任首席执行官和联合首席执行官。

“首席执行官 Aneel Bhusri 和来自银湖的 Egon [Durban] 通过许多关系相互了解。因此，我们认为这当然是有道理的，而且我认为这可以追溯到软件受到的严重打击，”分析师 Brent Thill 告诉 CNBC 的“Power Lunch”。

5 月，该公司公布了好于预期的业绩，并上调了对人工智能有利因素的预测。

title: OpenAI 失去营收主管丹尼斯·德莱瑟 (Denise Dresser)，这是几天内第二位主要高管离职
content:
OpenAI 周四表示，首席营收官丹尼斯·德莱瑟里斯 (Denise Dresseris) 在加入人工智能实验室不到一年后就离职了，对于一家正在为预计将进行重磅 IPO 做准备的公司来说，这是一个令人震惊的退出。

根据一份新闻稿，该公司表示，德莱瑟将离开“以寻求其他机会”。 OpenAI 聘请了曾担任网络安全公司 Wiz 总裁兼首席运营官的 Dali Rajic 来接替她。

德莱瑟周四在 LinkedIn 上的一篇帖子中写道：“亲身体验世界上最具变革性的技术的机会简直令人难以置信。” “我对我们所取得的成就感到非常自豪，更对这个团队为我们的客户和彼此所表现出的表现感到自豪。”

德莱瑟的离职标志着几天内 OpenAI 的第二位高管离职。长期担任 OpenAI 高管的布拉德·莱特卡 (Brad Lightcap) 于周二宣布了离开公司的决定，他在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道，他将“开始一些新的事情”。

Lightcap 已在 OpenAI 工作了八年，是该公司首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 的老朋友和同事。相比之下，德莱瑟在 Salesforce 担任高管十多年后，于 12 月被聘用。她的退出给 OpenAI 带来了一个特殊的难题，很大程度上是因为她为公司带来了公司急需的企业专业知识，以应对其主要竞争对手 Anthropic。

Dresser 在 4 月份还被任命接手 Lightcap 的许多职责，当时 OpenAI 表示 Lightcap 正在过渡到专注于“特殊项目”的新角色。

除了 Lightcap 和 Dresser 之外，Fidji Simo 也曾是 OpenAI 的产品兼业务主管，上个月宣布她在“慢性病严重恶化”后辞去公司职务，专注于康复。另外三名 OpenAI 高管于 4 月份离开了公司。

此次退出正值 OpenAI 的关键时刻，因为它正在为潜在的大规模公开市场亮相做好准备。该公司于 6 月份向美国证券交易委员会秘密提交了 IPO 招股说明书，就在 Anthropic 提交招股说明书的几天后。

OpenAI 在 3 月份以惊人的 8520 亿美元估值完成了一轮融资，它将面临在 IPO 之前向投资者证明这一数字合理性的压力。该公司一直在竞相拓展企业业务并在竞争激烈的市场中赢得客户，这是德莱赛的主要优先事项之一。

一月份，OpenAI 首席财务官萨拉·弗里亚特 (Sarah Friart) 向 CNBC 表示，截至 1 月份，企业客户约占 OpenAI 业务的 40%，但她预计到年底这一数字将增长到接近 50%。 德莱瑟 4 月份向 CNBC 表示，OpenAI 的企业业务正在“步入正轨”实现这一目标。

德莱瑟将在 OpenAI 短暂停留，“与业务团队密切合作，为我们的客户提供支持”，OpenAI 表示。她在 LinkedIn 帖子中写道，她一直在与 OpenAI 总裁格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman) 合作，以确保“平稳过渡”。

“没有人比这个团队更努力，”德莱瑟写道。 “我非常感谢你们每一个人。”

title: 消息人士称，Anthropic 首席财务官 Krishna Rao 正在主持与投资者的早期 IPO 会议，尚未讨论估值问题
content:
消息人士告诉 CNBC 的 David Faber，Anthropic 在其可能具有历史意义的 IPO 之前与潜在投资者的早期会议都是高层会议，没有包括有关具体财务或估值的讨论。

这家人工智能公司于 6 月份向美国证券交易委员会 (Securities and Exchange Commission) 秘密提交了招股说明书，为其备受期待的公开市场首次亮相奠定了基础。该公司尚未透露计划首次公开募股的正式时间表，但最近几周一直在举行初步会议，与一些投资者试水。

知情人士称，Anthropic 首席财务官 Krishna Rao 正在主持这些会议。

在这些会议中，Anthropic 讨论了一些宏观主题，例如 Claude AI 模型系列、该公司如何开发广受欢迎的编码助手 Claude Code、其在企业市场的地位、其管理和运营情况。知情人士称，Anthropic 的代表没有立即回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

Anthropic 于 2021 年由一群从 OpenAI 叛逃的研究人员和高管创立，他们现在是该公司的主要竞争对手。 5 月下旬，Anthropic 以 9650 亿美元的估值完成了一轮融资，超过了 OpenAI，后者在 3 月下旬的估值为 8520 亿美元。

该公司以其尖端的 Claude 模型而闻名，并且成功地将其技术出售给大型企业——对于人工智能开发人员来说这是一个竞争激烈的市场。 Anthropic 今年 5 月表示，其运行率收入超过 470 亿美元，高于 2025 年全年约 100 亿美元的收入。

据两位知情人士透露，由于其预期的运行率，一些 Anthropic 投资者预计该公司可能会寻求 2 万亿美元或更高的估值。但消息人士称，这个数字是基于他们自己的分析，而不是来自 Anthropic 的数字。

《金融时报》最先报道投资者浮动了 2 万亿美元的预期。

OpenAI 也正在为潜在的大规模 IPO 做准备。该公司在 Anthropic 提交后不久就向监管机构秘密提交了招股说明书，但截至 6 月下旬，该公司尚未举行 IPO 前会议，也没有如 CNBC 之前报道的那样概述正式的上市时间表。

埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 旗下的 SpaceX 公司于今年早些时候收购了他的人工智能初创公司 xAI，并于 6 月份在纳斯达克首次亮相，创下了创纪录的纪录。该股在前两个月的交易中波动较大，较盘中高点下跌了约 38%。

—CNBC 的凯特·鲁尼 (Kate Rooney) 对本报告做出了贡献

title: 尽管盈利好于预期且指引强于预期，思科股价仍下跌 9%
content:
思科股价周四下跌 9%，因为这家网络设备供应商好于预期的盈利报告和强有力的指引未能给华尔街留下深刻印象。

该公司表示，本季度收入将在 180 亿美元至 182 亿美元之间，高于 LSEG 的平均预期 168 亿美元。第四财季收入增长 18%，达到 17 美元。 30 亿美元，而分析师的预期为 168 亿美元。

Piper Sandler 的分析师在报告后的一份报告中写道，思科在本季度的业绩表现不错，但他们的指导“鉴于当前的需求环境，显得保守”。分析师写道，一些投资者“可能会开始挑剔我们正在看到增长峰值”，他们建议持有该股票。

进入盈利阶段，思科股价今年上涨了 60% 以上，因为该公司终于开始表明它正在从人工智能热潮中受益。尽管今年的预测很稳健，思科预计收入增长约 15%，但分析师预计下一财年的销售增长将回落至个位数。

尽管如此，思科首席执行官查克·罗宾斯 (Chuck Robbins) 仍将重点放在全面的增长上。

罗宾斯周四对 CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示：“我们创造了创纪录的一年，也创造了创纪录的季度。”在发布了好于分析师预期的指引后，他们说，“你们为什么这么保守，”罗宾斯补充道。

“我们正在开始一个新的财政年度。我们在令人难以置信的市场中运营，”罗宾斯说。 “但这也是我们在新年伊始要谨慎一点的时候。”

KeyBanc Capital Markets 的分析师仍然看好该股，给予相当于买入的评级。他们在报告后的一份报告中写道，随着超大规模企业增加资本支出以及所谓的新云和其他公司加大支出，思科可能会看到市场份额的增长。

思科表示，超大规模企业或推动大部分人工智能支出的互联网巨头在本季度下了 40 亿美元的基础设施订单，使本财年的总额达到 93 亿美元。该集团在上一财年的收入约为 40 亿美元，思科预计该数字在 2027 财年几乎翻倍，达到 75 亿美元。

截至周四中午，该股交易价格约为 113 美元。 6 月份的收盘新高为 130 美元。

title: 政府警告后，与特朗普有关的石油企业推迟了格陵兰钻探计划
content:
A Texas-based company with links to PresidentDonald Trumphas delayed plans to drill for oil in Greenland, after the Arctic island's government issued a "strong warning" to its joint venture partner for bringing equipment ashore without permission.

Greenland Energy Co., a Nasdaq-listed oil and gas exploration firm,saidWednesday that it was now working toward a targeted permit timeline for winter 2027, delaying its plans to try to unlock the hydrocarbon potential of the Jameson Land Basin on Greenland's east coast.

London-listed80 Mile, the joint venture partner of Greenland Energy for the project, alsoconfirmedthe delay to drilling plans following talks with Greenlandic authorities.

"Operating in the Arctic requires patience, flexibility and a long-term perspective. We will use this time to refine our plans and deepen relationships with local communities, strategic partners and relevant authorities," Greenland Energy Co. CEO Robert Price said in a statement.

80 Mile holds the licenses and runs the permitting through its wholly owned subsidiary, White Flame Energy. The exploration licenses were granted before Greenlandstoppedissuing new licenses in 2021, citing the worseningclimate crisis.

The project delay comes two weeks after Greenland's government issued a sharp rebuke to White Flame Energy for failing to get permission from local authorities to bring drilling equipment to the island's east coast.

Greenland Energy Co. and 80 Mile both confirmed to CNBC that the companies received a formal warning from Greenland's government.

The notice from Greenland's government to 80 Mile concerned the landing of drilling equipment near the strategically important Nerlerit Inaat Airport, a transport hub regarded as the gateway to northeast Greenland.

Ahead of the landing of equipment, Greenland Energy and 80 Mile said they had permission from and entered into a contract to lease storage space within an existing Greenland Airports storage area near the port but were unaware that this arrangement required a separate permit from the mineral resources authority.

Greenland's government said late last month that White Flame Energy did not have the necessary approvals before initiating this operation.

Greenland Energy and 80 Mile said in a joint statement that they "take the warning very seriously and note it in full." They added that they intend to "work closely" with Greenlandic authorities going forward.

80 Mile holds three licenses for exploration and possible exploitation of oil in the Jameson Land Basin. Greenland Energy is funding the costs associated with managing two exploration wells.

Shares of Greenland Energy closed more than 44% lower on Wednesday, while 80 Mile shares were down more than 20%.

The push to explore the oil potential of the Jameson Land Basin comes as Trump hasrenewed his push to acquire Greenland.

Greenland Energy has links to several people and businesses associated with the Trump administration.

Board member Carol Craig founded a defense-tech company involved in a Pentagon contracting program supporting Trump's Golden Dome missile-defense initiative.

The company also has a documentary deal with Envoy Media, founded by "Dr. Phil" McGraw, who spoke at a Trump rally in 2024 and serves on the president's Religious Liberty Commission.

Larry Swets, an entrepreneur and the chairman of Greenland Energy, has been reported to be close to the Trump administration.According to the Guardian, Price was asked during a meeting on the Jameson Land Basin in June whether Swets had links to Trump and replied: "Not that I know of."

Greenland Energy, which was formed through a SPAC merger in March, says its primary mission is to unlock the frontier oil potential of the Jameson Land Basin, a roughly 2-million-acre onshore licensed area.

Itdescribesthe area as one of, if not the last, highly prospective yet completely undrilled basins in the world, with clear genetic links to the North Sea and a scale comparable to many of the world's major producing regions.

Lewis Lawrence, senior research analyst of Europe upstream at Wood Mackenzie, said there is clearly potential associated with the area, noting the geology appears to be genetically similar to the mid-Norwegian shelf, "which obviously is one of the hotbeds of oil and gas activity."

But past attempts to drill in promising spots in Greenland have failed, he added.

"There has been exploration in Greenland in the past [and] that's all been unsuccessful. So, 21 wells, most of them offshore, and they have all been unsuccessful wells. There's been hundreds of millions of dollars wasted, particularly on offshore drilling, which is significantly more expensive," Lawrence told CNBC in a phone interview.

"So, companies have had a look. They've come, they've drilled, they've not found anything and they've left."

Lawrence also said there would be logistical challenges on the basin, which he called one of the most remote drilling sites in the world.

title: “大空头”投资者史蒂夫·艾斯曼（Steve Eisman）看到了人工智能热潮的致命弱点
content:
史蒂夫·艾斯曼 (Steve Eisman) 警告说，人工智能的繁荣已经越来越依赖于两家公司的命运：OpenAI 和 Anthropic。

这位因在全球金融危机前做空房地产市场而闻名的投资者表示，这两家人工智能初创公司约占微软、亚马逊、Alphabet 旗下谷歌和甲骨文人工智能相关收入的 70%，以及其云业务的 25% 至 35%。周二晚间，艾斯曼在 CNBC 的“快钱”节目中表示：“从某种意义上说，这些大型公司的未来是 OpenAI、Anthropic 将取得成功的赌注。”

“The Real Eisman Playbook”播客主持人、前 Neuberger Berman 高级投资组合经理认为，最大的收入威胁可能来自中国，因为中国的开源人工智能模型成本明显更低，而且似乎正在赢得市场

“整个故事的致命弱点...是，如果 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 发生不好的事情...中国的开放式模型、开放权重模型要便宜得多。如果他们真的开始占据大量市场份额，而且据我所知，他们可能会开始一场大价格战。然后我们就会遇到问题，”他说。

艾斯曼的警告为日益激烈的争论增添了另一个突出的声音：人工智能繁荣背后的非凡支出可以产生足够的回报。

另一位在《大空头》中对房地产泡沫进行押注的投资者迈克尔·伯里(Michael Burry)采取了更加悲观的观点。伯里质疑当前和未来的人工智能需求是否大部分最终来自最终客户，他认为很大一部分是通过他所描述的循环安排筹集资金的。

伯里正在言出必行，对一些人工智能热潮的最大受益者，包括英伟达以及其他针对更广泛的半导体行业的公司。

title: Databricks 完成 50 亿美元融资，估值 1900 亿美元
content:
Databricks 周四表示，它以 1900 亿美元的估值完成了 50 亿美元的融资。

该公司表示，第二季度的收入运行率已突破 70 亿美元，同比增长超过 80%。

首席执行官 Ali Ghodsi 周四告诉 CNBC 的 Jon Fortt，“需求是疯狂的。”

“发生的事情基本上是每个人的事情Ghodsi 在 CNBC 的“Squawk on the Street”节目中表示：“使用这些代理、AI 代理，整个世界都在聚焦于代理、AI，你知道它的核心部分。”

Ghodsi 强调了人工智能软件公司 Lakebase 数据库部门、Genie coworker 代理及其 AI 网关工具的实力，这有助于控制模型的使用和成本。

Databricks 表示将利用这笔资金支持企业 AI 功能，包括Databricks 表示，该公司最近推出的基于 Lake 的数据库使其与 Oracle 和 SAP 等现有企业展开竞争，并且收入运行率已经超过 1 亿美元。该公司表示，其 Lakehouse 数据仓库工具的运行率已超过 15 亿美元。

今年 3 月，Databricks 凭借其 Lakewatch 软件涉足网络安全领域。

这家私营数据分析软件公司以 1340 亿美元的估值筹集了 50 亿美元资金和 20 亿美元新债务能力，六个月后完成了这轮融资。

Databricks 是越来越多推迟上市的公司之一。考虑到私募市场中出现的无数融资机会。

SpaceX 的重磅 IPO 为 IPO 活动潜在的大年奠定了基础，但自首次亮相以来，股价一直波动较大。前沿模型制造商 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 都已秘密提交上市申请，准备最快在今年首次亮相。

Databricks 成立于 2013 年，帮助公司使用专有数据构建人工智能代理和应用程序。

该公司在 CNBC 2026 年 Disruptor 50 榜单上排名第三，其市值已超过公开市场竞争对手 Snowflake，并且正在扩展其更新的产品

Coatue、Blackstone、MGX、T. Rowe Price 和 Sixth Street Growth 领投此轮融资。

— CNBC 的 Jordan Novet 贡献了报道

title: Harvey Nichols 被 Sports Direct 所有者收购
content: 图片来源，Getty Images作者：Yasmin Rufo商业记者发布2026年8月13日英国夏令时13:40更新1小时前豪华百货公司Harvey Nichols已被Sports Direct的所有者收购，该公司警告称需要进行“重大重组”以确保这家拥有200年历史的业务保持可持续发展。Mike Ashley的Frasers Group将接管Harvey Nichols商店，包括位于骑士桥的旗舰店以及国际特许经营店。这家百货商店在 BBC 情景喜剧《绝对精彩》中永垂不朽，但近年来面临挑战。该公司已于 6 月任命了管理人员。星狮集团首席执行官、阿什利的女婿迈克尔·默里 (Michael Murray) 称这家商店是“具有巨大潜力的英国机构”，但他补充说，“需要进行明确且有意义的变革”。他表示：“转型将需要艰难的选择，我们准备做出这些决定，即使这意味着短期内业务规模会缩小，但从长远来看，我们将打造一个更强大、更可持续的哈维·尼科尔斯 (Harvey Nichols)。” 800 个高端和奢侈品牌，拥有 1,000 多名员工。其其他门店位于曼彻斯特、伯明翰、布里斯托尔、利兹和爱丁堡。星狮集团也将收购在线业务，商店将继续在其现有许可下运营。本周早些时候，Harvey Nichols 在其最新账目中警告称，如果未能获得新投资，将需要在一年内“停止交易”。该公司最近面临“持续的交易和运营挑战”，星狮集团表示将需要对该商店的经营状况进行审查投资组合、结构和成本基础。在最近的一次商店拍卖中，辉盛集团与零售竞争对手 Next 争夺公司的控制权。 Harvey Nichols 于 1991 年被香港商人潘迪生爵士 (Sir Dickson Poon) 收购，但他在今年早些时候将该集团挂牌出售。 图片说明，Absolutely Fabulous 的 Edina 和 Patsy 经常到“Harvey Nicks”进行购物治疗。在 20 世纪 90 年代的鼎盛时期，两人经常找借口溜进百货商店购物，享用一顿丰盛的午餐。但零售专家兼 Savvy Marketing 老板凯瑟琳·沙特尔沃思 (Catherine Shuttleworth) 表示：“如果你走进一家 Harvey Nicks 商店——我上周就去了——它们看起来很糟糕，看起来真的很疲惫，基本上都是因为缺乏投资而遭受损失。”她告诉 BBC Wake Up to Money，百货商店“是现金饥渴的怪物， Harvey Nichols 首席执行官 Julia Goddard 表示，这笔交易标志着公司“一个重要的里程碑”，并“为业务下一阶段的发展提供了一个强大的平台”。“在过去的一年里，我们在重新定位这一标志性业务、投资我们的旗舰店、扩大我们的客户主张以及强化品牌 DNA 方面取得了重大进展。”多年来，星狮集团通过 Sports Direct 收购了大量零售商及其品牌。其中包括高档时尚连锁店 Flannels、萨维尔街 (Savile Row) 裁缝店 Gieves & Hawkes 和豪华内衣公司 Agent Provocateur。它还拥有 Jack Wills 和 House of Fraser。Shuttleworth 表示，Frasers 的老板 Murray “准确把握了那些[年轻]购物者购物的脉搏”。“如果你看看该集团对 Flannels 所做的事情，[Harvey Nichols] 将比 Flannels 更具法兰绒风格。”星狮集团收购 Harvey Nichols 是其在奢侈品领域扩大影响力的战略的一部分。该集团最近对已经入股的德国品牌 Hugo Boss 发起了收购。“确保工作岗位”哈维·尼科尔斯 (Harvey Nichols) 位于伦敦 Oxo 塔的餐厅正在单独出售，不包括在交易中。相关主题购物零售迈克·阿什利

title: 随着与美国的战争拖延，伊朗寻求加强与金砖国家的经济联盟
content:
伊朗央行行长周四表示，伊朗将加入金砖国家新开发银行，因为德黑兰在与美国和以色列开战近六个月后寻求加强其经济联盟。

金砖国家联盟于 2006 年由创始成员巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国成立，南非于 2010 年加入。

此后，该联盟已扩大到包括以下国家：伊朗、埃及、埃塞俄比亚、沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋和印度尼西亚，以及白俄罗斯、古巴和尼日利亚等其他国家作为伙伴国加入。

伊朗官方媒体周四报道称，伊朗中央银行行长阿卜杜勒纳赛尔·赫马蒂 (Abdolnasser Hemmati) 宣布伊朗很快将成为金砖国家银行的成员。据伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社报道，赫马蒂目前正在印度准备下个月的金砖国家峰会。

根据塔斯尼姆通讯社的报道，赫马蒂表示，“我们正在寻求与成员国建立双边和三边货币合作。”

新开发银行由巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非建立，旨在帮助为新兴市场和发展中国家的基础设施和可持续发展项目调动资源。

新开发银行告诉 CNBC，该银行无法确认有关伊朗会员资格的信息。

“新开发银行会员资格向联合国成员国开放。该银行的会员资格向借款和非借款成员国开放，”他们表示。 “新开发银行最近欢迎乌兹别克斯坦成为其第十个成员国，乌兹别克斯坦于 2026 年 6 月 5 日正式加入该银行。”

伊朗必须先完成新开发银行的加入程序，然后才能成为正式成员国。目前的潜在成员包括乌拉圭、哥伦比亚、埃塞俄比亚、安哥拉和津巴布韦。

加入该银行将使伊朗有资格为交通、卫生、数字基础设施和城市发展等领域的项目寻求融资。

对伊朗的长期制裁严重限制了其获得国际资本的机会，特别是来自西方金融机构和市场的资本。与美国和以色列的战争进一步加大了伊朗经济的压力，通胀飙升，经济增长大幅下滑，货币大幅贬值。

美国此前曾将金砖国家政策贴上“反美”标签的唐纳德·特朗普总统威胁要对任何直接或间接从伊朗购买商品或服务的国家进口到美国的商品征收 25% 的关税。

CNBC 联系白宫，请其就伊朗加入金砖国家银行发表评论。

根据世界银行的最新数据，中国是伊朗最大的贸易伙伴。 Kplerdata 的数据显示，2025 年，中国购买了伊朗 80% 以上的石油运输量。

自美伊战争开始以来，尚不清楚这种贸易关系是否发生了变化。

title: 华尔街等​​待批发通胀数据，国债收益率下跌
content:
美国周四，美国国债收益率下跌，华尔街消化了 7 月份的通胀数据，并展望了盘中稍后公布的进一步数据。

美国政府借款的关键基准 10 年期美国国债收益率下跌 2 个基点，至 4.672%。

更密切地跟踪美联储短期利率政策的 2 年期国债收益率下跌超过 2 个基点，至 4.672%。 4.178%。较长期的 30 年期国债收益率下跌不到 1 个基点，至 5.238%。

1 个基点等于 0.01%，收益率和价格走势相反。

美国生产者价格指数 7 月读数定于美国东部时间周四上午 8:30 发布，该指数衡量批发商购买原材料的价格。道琼斯调查的经济学家预计较上月增长 0.2%。

高盛在周四的一份报告中写道：“我们认为，大多数 FOMC 选民会认为我们预期的 7 月份通胀数据是可以接受的，并希望在决定是否在 9 月份会议上加息之前先看看 8 月份的 CPI 和 PPI。”

PPI 报告是在消费者价格指数在线解读的第二天发布的。

CPI 7 月份环比增长 0.1%，符合预期。作为回应，交易员减少了对美联储 9 月加息的押注。

德意志银行的吉姆·里德 (Jim Reid) 在周四的一份报告中写道：“这一切都符合共识，但这仍然使其成为连续两份相对令人鼓舞的核心通胀报告，再加上上周疲软的就业数据，美联储在 9 月立即采取行动的压力较小。”。

——CNBC 的弗雷德·伊伯特 (Fred Imbert) 也对这份报告做出了贡献。
