title: DRAM内存芯片股票交易重磅ETF经理带着新的人工智能主题赌注回归
content:
Roundhill Investments found success this year with its Memory ETF (DRAM), amassing tens of billions of dollars from investors since launching in April. The ETF manager is now set to bring another AI thematic trade to the market, the Roundhill Photonics and Optics ETF (LYTE), scheduled for launch on Thursday. The new fund is targeting another niche within the rapid AI buildout that many on Wall Street and in Silicon Valley think, as with semiconductor stocks, is positioned for growth in the years ahead.

The photonics industry has been experiencing a boom due to AI data center developers' desire to make use of optical networking — the transmission of data between processors using light pulses in fiber-optic systems rather than conventional electrical signals. Optical networking promises to allow data processing to move beyond the limitations of traditional copper wire connections, offering a method that is faster, more energy efficient, and that allows for data transmission over further distances.

The means for carrying out optical connectivity include lasers, optical fibers, modulators, and various connectors, all working in conjunction to build an enhanced fiber-optic network structure. These structures — as those at the forefront of the AI economy view them — are essential to bypass the physical limitations of existing AI infrastructure, which produces excessive heat, results in signal loss, and limits growth and, by extension, computing power.

Photonics and optics technology are quickly becoming integrated into the AI industry's growth plans.Nvidiahas committed at least$6.5 billion to companies developing photonics technologysince March, including stakes inCoherentandLumentum. Nvidia'sFeynman, a major GPU microarchitecture pivot away from copper and to photonics, is currently slated for a 2028 release. It is designed to improve interconnectivity and networking capabilities within data centers and operate at a scope surpassing current transistor technology and copper cable connections. Jensen Huang, Nvidia CEO, has called photonics the key to the "next generation of gigawatt-scale AI factories."

"Photonics represents a way for Nvidia to scale their AI infrastructure without the energy costs that staying with electrical and copper will incur," Alvin Nguyen, senior analyst at Forrester, told CNBC earlier this year. "By investing in photonics companies, Nvidia is making sure that advancements in photonics continue, and it will prevent them from hitting a scalability and performance wall that will occur if they remain on electrical and copper."

Here's a look at other stories offering insight on ETFs for investors.

Marvell Technology, which designs chips for data centers and which Huang said earlier this yearcould be the next trillion-dollar company, has been at the forefront of manufacturing silicon chips that allow light to be used in place of electricity, mirroring the goals of optical connectivity on the micro level.Nvidia invested $2 billioninto Marvel in March.

In this case, Roundhill will not be first to the market with its photonics trade. Tema ETFs launched the LAZR Photonics & Optics ETF (LAZR) on June 30. "By Feynman, system bandwidth requirements are expected to rise to more than four times today's levels, with light moving deeper into the system to connect more than 1,000 GPUs," wrote Hong Yi Chen, an investment partner at Tema,in a blog postat the time of the LAZR's launch. "At that scale, copper may struggle to deliver the bandwidth, distance, and power efficiency required."

Goldman Sachs projects that, from 2026 through 2028, the total addressable market opportunity for optical networking willgrow more than 9 times over, from an estimated $15 billion to an estimated $154 billion. Over the past few years, publicly-traded corporations specializing in the production of photonics technology have seen their market caps rise rapidly.

Shares of Lumentum have risen by over 100% this year. Similar investor bullishness can be seen in the performance of Lumentum's peers, with Coherent up over 66%, and shares ofNlightrising by roughly 100%.

Laser technology is critical across many sectors of the economy, including in the medical field, in manufacturing, and in defense, specifically with drone warfare.

"Our Locus system is the next generation of directed energy or laser weapon systems that allows us to defeat drones at very, very low costs," Aerovironment CEO Wahid Nawabitold CNBCin April, referring to his company's modular laser weapons system. "We're talking less than $10 a shot to shoot down a drone with two to five seconds worth of laser energy in the air. This is the technology that is considered the holy grail for the next era."

LYTE's portfolio holdings have not been disclosed. Lumentum,AXT, andAixtronare among top holdings in LAZR.

While the LAZR ETF has had limited success with investors to date, with roughly $18 million in assets since its launch on June 30, Roundhill has a promising recent track record. DRAM, which launched this past April to offer investors exposure to global memory chip companies, was the first ETF to reach $10 billion in assets in the span of just 10 days. Other ETFs, such asCHAT, Roundhill's generative AI and technology ETF, andMAGS, which offers equal weight exposure to the "Magnificent Seven" stocks, also boast multi-billion dollar asset portfolios.

Investment in LYTE does not come without significant risks. One reason for the slow start for LAZR is the recent volatility in the AI sector. Shares of LAZR have declined since inception.

The current market growth of photonics and optics companies is largely predicated on the AI buildout continuing without significant setbacks or large-scale market disruption.

"The development and commercialization of photonic and optical technologies may be contingent upon the broader adoption of related technologies, including artificial intelligence, data center infrastructure, and advanced telecommunications networks," Roundhill notes in itsprospectus filingfor the LYTE ETF. "A slowdown or disruption in the growth of these related sectors could materially and adversely affect the revenues and profitability of Photonic and Optical Companies in which the Fund invests."

ETF experts say the photonics industry has evolved into a viable investment prospect.

"Photonics is a sufficiently developed and distinct theme to qualify as investable," said Todd Rosenbluth, head of research at VettaFi. "While thematic ETFs can be volatile when a specific trend moves out of favor, the long-term persistence of the AI buildout provides a strong tailwind."

Investors should not view thematic ETFs such as LYTE or LAZR as replacements for broad stock market funds, but these targeted equity portfolios can be profitable additions to investors' core holdings, according to Rosenbluth. "We find that advisors and investors increasingly use thematic ETFs tactically to add long-term growth to core equity exposure," he said. "These funds often complement S&P 500 or Nasdaq 100-based ETF holdings; typically, three to four thematic ETFs represent about 10% of a broader portfolio."

The popularity among advisors should come with a note of caution based on the dotcom bubble experience, which is so often now being invoked in discussing market parallels to the AI boom. In the leadup to the dotcom bubble bursting, many advisors added allocations to telecom and internet-themed funds for their clients.

"Since investment themes cycle in and out of favor, investors must ensure their portfolios are diversified. While they can look to multiple thematic strategies, they must ensure they are not overly focused on one segment of the market," Rosenbluth said.

—CNBC'sKai Nicol-Schwarzcontributed to this report.

title: 特朗普政府退还1000亿美元“解放日”关税
content:
特朗普政府表示，它已经退还了最高法院取消唐纳德·特朗普总统的“解放日”关税之前征收的约 1000 亿美元关税收入。

周二美国国际贸易法院提交的一份文件中报道的这一数字，占政府表示从特朗普 2025 年征收的全面关税中获得的约 1660 亿美元的约 60%国际紧急经济权力法案 (IEEPA)。

高等法院裁定 IEEPA 未授权后，这些关税于 2 月底被取消。大约两周后，联邦法官理查德·伊顿下令，根据 IEEPA 征收的关税必须退还给进口商。

特朗普将严厉的关税置于其经济和外交政策议程的中心，他对法院的裁决发泄了愤怒，他的政府最近采取了一系列措施，利用其他法律机构有效地重新建立 IEEPA 关税制度。

“关税令人难以置信。我们已经采取了数百项关税。”数十亿美元，”特朗普周二在接受福克斯新闻采访时说道。 “最高法院给了我们一点机会，但我们被允许以不同的方式做到这一点。”

这些不同的关税方法已经面临着自己的法院挑战。与此同时，特朗普政府一直在向已失效的 IEEPA 制度发放退款。

美国海关和边境保护局于 4 月底实施了名为“入境综合管理和处理”(CAPE) 的系统，以跟踪和交付关税退款。

CBP 官员布兰登·洛德 (Brandon Lord) 在周二提交的文件中表示，截至 7 月 31 日，CAPE 已收到 252,496 份关税退款申报，涵盖超过 2500 万个进口入境条目，这是法院下令更新政府交付退款进展情况的信息。

近 129 美元洛德表示，CAPE 系统已接受 10 亿美元的“潜在退款和经认证的退款”进行处理。他写道，其中大约 1000 亿美元已经完成、认证并发送给财政部进行支付。

该文件是由总部位于加州的进口商 Freestyle World 提起的诉讼提出的，该公司寻求代表支付 IEEPA 关税的小型企业提起集体诉讼，并表示他们在通过 CAPE 获得退款方面面临障碍。政府坚称，类别认证请求来得太晚，无论如何都是无效的。

无论怎样，特朗普政府的退款行动仍有很长的路要走：超过33万进口商为超过5300万件商品支付了IEEPA关税。

title: AMD 股价在财报公布后下跌，苏丽莎不理睬马斯克对英伟达的承诺
content:
Advanced Micro Devices 首席执行官苏丽莎 (Lisa Su) 周三驳回了埃隆·马斯克关于 SpaceX 致力于独家使用 Nvidia 人工智能芯片的评论。

苏对 CNBC 的“Squawk on the Street”节目表示：“我非常尊重埃隆和他所做的一切，因此我们期待继续长期合作。”

马斯克周二在公司财报电话会议上表示，AMD 的AI芯片竞争对手拥有“最好的架构”，并吹捧与英伟达的密切合作和伙伴关系。 2025 年 5 月，马斯克告诉 CNBC 的 David Faber，他的人工智能公司将从这两家公司购买芯片，甚至可能还有其他公司。

Nvidia 股价周三上涨约 3%。

Su 称 SpaceX 是“一家极其重要的科技公司”，并表示她对 AMD 在多个领域与他们合作的工作感到自豪。她指出，该公司仍与许多科技公司有业务往来，包括航天市场的公司。

尽管 AMD 发布了强劲的第二季度收益，并且指导数据中心业务增长“远远超过 100%”，但 AMD 的股价周三还是下跌了 7%。

Su 周三向 CNBC 强调了这一前景，并解释了该公司如何规划 2027 年及以后的发展。

“在这段时间内，我们的客户能见度要强得多，”Su说。 “客户告诉我们的是，你知道，他们想要更多的计算能力。”

第二季度 AMD 收入增长 50%，达到 115.4 亿美元，高于分析师预期的 112.8 亿美元，这表明该公司在人工智能芯片市场的核心地位。

数据中心销售推动了公司的增长，同比增长 107%，达到 67 亿美元，该公司将其归因于这一增长中央处理器和图形处理单元销售。

Su 在周二的财报电话会议上告诉分析师，该公司预计 2026 年下半年服务器收入将同比增长 80%，2027 年将增长 70% 以上。

Su 周三告诉 CNBC，其客户为公司提供了“更多的机会来规划”服务器供应。

“因此，我们正在整个供应链中进行投资。”她说。 “我们正在与我们的合作伙伴合作。我们正在进行后端投资。我们正在整个生态系统中进行投资，这样我们就能够以客户要求的更高的速度供货。”

德意志银行分析师在周三的一份报告中表示，尽管第二季度收益“略高于”共识，但仍低于“更乐观的预期”。

AMD 一直是人工智能热潮的一大受益者，今年迄今为止，股票交易量上涨了 132%。该公司的 GPU 和 CPU 产品提振了人们的信心。

“人工智能正在推动我们所有市场的计算需求大幅增长，”苏在周二的声明中表示。 “我们的领先产品组合和不断增长的客户知名度使我们能够很好地抓住这一不断扩大的机会，并在未来几年实现可观的收入和盈利增长。”

盈利未能给今年一直对某些人工智能股票感到不安的投资者留下深刻印象。

7 月，AMD 提高了对半导体行业规模的预期，称到 2028 年半导体行业的价值可能达到每年 2 万亿美元。该芯片制造商预计其中 1.4 万亿美元来自人工智能加速器或 GPU 的价值高于之前预计的 2028 年 5000 亿美元。

晨星公司首席股票策略师 Michael Field 向 CNBC 表示：“这只是市场预期过高的情况。”

“该股在过去 12 个月内上涨了两倍，现在的市盈率为 170 倍，这意味着预期也相当高。” “我们将下跌视为潜在的买入机会，投资者可能会在未来几周内采取类似的观点。”

—CNBC 的 Kif Leswing 为本报告提供了帮助。

title: 美国银行首席执行官表示，态势感知对冲基金的崩溃是对杠杆市场的警告
content:
美国银行首席执行官布赖恩·莫伊尼汉 (Brian Moynihan) 周三称，最近飞速发展的人工智能对冲基金 Situational Awareness 近乎崩溃，这对金融市场来说是一个警告，因为金融市场正受到估值上升和借钱的推动。

由 Leopold Aschenbrenner 领导的 Situational Awareness 上周因押注人工智能而被迫将大部分公开股票出售给 Citadel。变酸了。美国银行是该公司的主要经纪商之一，与高盛和摩根大通一起执行交易并为该基金提供杠杆。

“这些都是警告，”莫伊尼汉告诉 CNBC 的安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。 “估值下降，系统杠杆达到那里。你必须小心。”

莫伊尼汉的评论表明，华尔街最大的主要经纪商正在重新审视他们对高杠杆投资公司的敞口，因为人工智能交易推动了市场的飙升，尽管他们继续积极竞争为对冲基金提供融资。自 2024 年推出以来，态势感知掀起了人工智能乐观浪潮，在上周的清算之前，其资产已飙升至 450 亿美元的峰值。

“你总是看着并说，‘好吧，发生了什么？我们应该从中吸取教训吗？它应该改变吗？’”莫伊尼汉说。 “因此，趋势是收紧承保标准，只是一点点，进行调整——尤其是在股市大幅上涨的情况下。”

尽管如此，即使没有 Citadel 交易，美国银行也会“很好”，莫伊尼汉说，该交易为态势感知提供了资金来偿还其主要经纪人。

态势感知崩溃是杠杆风险的最新案例研究。随着科技股上个月回落，该基金面临着主要经纪商越来越多的追加保证金通知。为了满足这些需求，它被迫在不断下跌的市场中抛售头寸，从而加速亏损并引发威胁公司生存的下行周期。

态势感知公司集中持有人工智能硬件供应商的头寸，其中包括韩国存储芯片制造商SK海力士。有关该基金陷入困境的消息上周引发了人工智能相关股票的新一轮抛售，原因是担心如果仓位迅速平仓，可能会有更多股票进入市场。

周四 Citadel 介入后，这些担忧有所缓解。几家人工智能基础设施公司的股价大幅反弹，Citadel 所持仓位的价值立即得到提升。

title: 《儿童在线安全法》社交媒体安全法案在参议院取得进展
content:
名为 KOSA 的《儿童在线安全法案》周三在参议院商业、科学和运输委员会获得通过，扫清了一个关键障碍。

这项措施得到了两党的大力支持，旨在通过建立家长控制和研究社交媒体对儿童福祉的影响来保护儿童的在线安全。

该法案由田纳西州共和党参议员玛莎·布莱克本 (Marsha Blackburn) 提出，并得到了支持来自康涅狄格州民主党参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔 (Richard Blumenthal)。该提案在参议院有 76 个共同提案国。该法案的另一个版本于 6 月在众议院提出，作为保护在线儿童和青少年的更广泛一揽子计划的一部分，尽管其成为法律的道路仍然不明朗。

“儿童和青少年面临着在线伤害的真正风险，我们已经失去了太多人。国会需要做得更多，”该委员会的民主党领袖、民主党参议员玛丽亚·坎特韦尔 (Maria Cantwell) 周三在委员会投票前表示。

“它规定了一项义务。坎特韦尔继续说道。

该立法由委员会提出，并提出了一系列旨在保护儿童在线安全的其他措施，其中包括一项要求人工智能公司在其在线聊天机器人中实施隐私保护措施的法案。

近年来，国会中出现了多个版本的 KOSA，参议院也通过了该法案的一个版本2024 年，参众两院之间的分歧导致该法案未能提交总统办公桌。

参议院版本的法案包含一项“注意义务”条款，要求 Meta、Snapchat 和 TikTok 等社交媒体平台在创建和实施可能伤害儿童的设计功能时采取合理的谨慎态度。众议院的版本没有这样做，这一遗漏引起了参议院赞助者的批评。

“众议院没有通过一项保护美国儿童免受大型科技公司贪婪侵害的联邦标准，而是刚刚通过了对大型科技公司问责制的苍白模仿的立法，”布莱克本和布卢门撒尔在众议院 6 月份通过该计划后的联合声明中表示。 “众议院取消照顾义务的决定只会维持大型科技公司利用我们的孩子作为利润中心的现状，而让家长来收拾残局。”

这项立法面临着额外的阻力。美国公民自由联盟和个人权利与表达基金会等公民自由团体反对该法案的各个版本，声称它们会危及用户隐私并加剧政府审查。

参议院委员会还在成员们八月休会前一天审议了该法案。从现在到 11 月中期选举，众议院或参议院的立法日只剩下很少的时间了，这意味着，随着立法者优先考虑政府资金和其他更高的优先事项，这项立法可能会半途而废。

但参议院商务小组主席、德克萨斯州共和党参议员特德·克鲁兹 (Ted Cruz) 表现出了信心。

“我们现在再次一致通过了 KOSA。我相信我们会在参议院通过它，然后我们将继续努力工作并与众议院进行谈判，以使其越过终点线进入总统办公桌，”克鲁兹说。

“我相信我们会实现这一目标，但还有更多工作要做。”

title: Uber发布第三季度预订量和盈利预测均低于预期
content:
Uber发布的预订量和盈利预测低于分析师的预期，而第二季度利润则符合预期。文章发布后，周三股价下跌约 3.5%。

以下是该公司的业绩与 LSEG 编制的分析师预测的比较：

收入较上年同期的 126.5 亿美元增长了 12%。净利润从一年前的 13.5 亿美元（即每股 63 美分）攀升至 23.9 亿美元，即每股 1.17 美元。

Uber 的核心移动服务占第二季度销售额的 73.6 亿美元，而配送收入达到 52.5 亿美元。出行总预订量同比增长 22%，达到 289.9 亿美元，送货预订量增长 26%，达到 274.6 亿美元。根据 StreetAccount 的数据，总预订量为 580 亿美元，超过了分析师平均预期的 572.3 亿美元。

Uber 第三季度的预订量预计为 592.5 亿美元，处于区间中间值。这低于 StreetAccount 的平均预期 593.3 亿美元。根据 LSEG 的数据，该公司的每股收益预期为 84 美分至 88 美分，低于分析师平均预期的 89 美分。

截至周二收盘，Uber 股价今年已下跌 12%，而纳斯达克指数在此期间上涨了 14%。

Uber 正在进一步推进送货业务，上个月宣布了一项价值 148 亿美元的协议，收购德国的 Delivery Hero。该交易将增加 Uber 可以提供食品和杂货服务的市场数量。

首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西 (Dara Khosrowshahi) 在财报电话会议前准备好的讲话中表示，世界杯为本季度打车业务带来了福音。超过 800 万游客在美国、加拿大和墨西哥的主办城市乘坐了车

Uber 也继续在自动驾驶汽车上投入巨资。

该公司表示，预计在未来几年投入超过 100 亿美元，以“将自动驾驶汽车大规模推向市场”。 Uber 一直在与机器人出租车提供商建立合作伙伴关系，但并未公布有司机和无司机的乘车或送货的份额。

“随着行业从证明技术转向大规模商业化”，Khosrowshahi 表示，Uber 正在打造“AV 生态系统中最有价值的地位之一”。

然而，早期机器人出租车合作伙伴 Waymo 似乎正在退出。这些公司最近表示，他们将将于 2028 年初终止在亚特兰大和德克萨斯州奥斯汀的独家协议。

Uber 周三还宣布，它已清除了与英国机器人出租车公司 Wayve 在伦敦提供自动驾驶服务的另一个障碍。

伦敦交通局已向 Wayve 机器人出租车授予私人出租车辆许可证，确认这些车辆符合安全标准。 Uber 表示，已有超过 10 万人报名成为第一批乘客。

“该许可证是 Uber 将自动驾驶服务带到伦敦的一个重要里程碑，”自动驾驶移动运营全球主管 Annie Duvnjak 在宣布这一消息的声明中表示。

title: 沙特财富基金与贾里德·库什纳的 Affinity 敲定 EA Sports 价值 550 亿美元的交易
content:
由沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金牵头的财团宣布完成对视频游戏制造商Electronic Arts的550亿美元收购。

该交易还由私募股权公司Silver Lake和Affinity Partners提供资金，该公司由唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳领导。

EA于周二晚间确认了该交易，表示其股票已停止交易并将从交易所退市。纳斯达克。其股东每股将获得 210 美元现金。

该交易代表沙特进一步向体育和游戏领域扩张。 PIF 国际投资主管 Turqi Alnowaiser 在一份声明中表示，“娱乐和体育是该基金战略重点的关键领域”。

分析师此前曾强调 EA 作为交易的一部分而承担的高额债务，同时质疑其知识产权的未来。

据报道，PIF 正在向该交易顾问摩根大通借款 200 亿美元来完成程序，这被认为是全球最大的杠杆收购。分析师去年告诉 CNBC，债务负担将使 EA 围绕其最安全的系列进行整合，例如《模拟人生》、《战地》和体育游戏，而不是尝试新的 IP。

F-Squared 创始人迈克尔·富特 (Michael Futter) 向 CNBC 表示：“他们头上的债务不太可能带来战略转变。”

“相反，领导层可能会在游戏中巩固自己的地位。他们认为具有最大收入潜力的游戏，即使这些游戏也存在最大的风险。”

“我不知道 EA 将如何在不大幅裁员、关闭工作室以及可能出售 IP 的情况下偿还这笔债务。”他补充道。

— CNBC 的 Lim Hui Jie 也为本报告做出了贡献。

title: 公园和流媒体业务提振迪士尼盈利超出预期
content:
Disneyposted mixed quarterly results on Wednesday, far surpassing Wall Street expectations for earnings while slightly missing estimates for revenue.

The company's quarterly results were once again lifted by its parks and streaming divisions.

Revenue for Disney's experiences segment, which includes global theme parks and cruises, was up 10% year over year to $9.97 billion. That growth came even as macroeconomic uncertainty continues to mount for consumers and appears to weigh on Disney's parks peers.

"Domestically we're doing extremely well right now," CFO Hugh Johnston told CNBC, noting that park attendance in the U.S. was up 3% and per capita spending increased 4%.

Johnston also called out the "very strong attendance" at Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida.

"Those numbers are somewhat different than what you would have seen from our competitor down there, as well as some of the reported traffic coming through Orlando [International] Airport," he added.

Last month,Comcast'sNBCUniversal reported that its Orlando theme parkssaw lower attendanceduring its fiscal quarter, with executives pointing to "weakness in consumer sentiment and higher travel costs affecting demand."

The effects of the U.S.-Israel conflict with Iran andrelated jumpin oil prices have weighed on consumers.

Meanwhile Disney's entertainment streaming business – primarily made up of Disney+ and Hulu – once again posted gains. Revenue for the segment increased 11% to $5.53 billion during the quarter. The growth was particularly propelled by an increase in streaming customers and price hikes as well as an increase in advertising revenue.

The overall entertainment segment, which also includes traditional TV and theatrical releases in addition to streaming, saw revenue rise 6% to $11.35 billion. Thesuccessof "Toy Story 5" in theaters provided a boost, with Disney noting the animated film has surpassed $1 billion at the global box office.

Disney has recently stopped reporting some metrics for the segment, such as a breakdown of revenue and operating income for its linear TV networks. It also no longer reports quarterly streaming subscriber numbers.

Here's how Disney performed for itsfiscal third quarter, ended June 27, compared to Wall Street's estimates, according to LSEG:

Overall, Disney's revenue rose 7% year over year to $25.25 billion during the quarter.

Net income for Disney's fiscal third quarter was $2.64 billion, or $1.51 per share, compared with $5.26 billion, or $2.92 per share during the same period last year. Disney'sfiscal third quarter of 2025included one-time items primarily related to tax benefits associated with Disney's purchase of Comcast's Hulu stake.

Adjusting for one-time items, including costs associated with restructuring, Disney reported earnings of $2.06 per share for its fiscal third quarter, up from adjusted EPS of $1.61 in the same quarter last year.

Shares of Disney gained roughly 4% in premarket trading.

Revenue in Disney's sports segment, which is made up primarily of ESPN, jumped 4% to $4.5 billion, largely driven by subscription and affiliate fees as well as advertising. ESPN launched its own direct-to-consumer streaming service nearly a year ago.

While sports rights fees have become a hefty cost for media companies like Disney, the company noted soaring TV ratings from the NBA and NHL postseasons on both its broadcast network ABC as well as pay TV channel ESPN.

"The NBA and NHL Finals were super strong, over 100% growth in terms of viewership," Johnston told CNBC. "The last time I think we saw these types of numbers was about 25 or 30 years ago."

Wednesday's report marks the second quarterly release with CEO Josh D'Amaro at the helm after he took over for Bob Iger. Last quarter D'Amaro outlined his strategy for growth and opportunities at Disney, with a focus on investing in intellectual property to propel its theme parks and entertainment.

In the release, Disney said it received a roughly $100 million tariff refund related to the Trump administration's levies on trade partners and subsequent reversal.

Disney also said it was now targeting at least $9 billion in share repurchases in fiscal 2026, an increase from $8 billion previously and fueled by thesaleof Disney's 50% stake in A+E Global Media to Hearst. That deal amounts to roughly $1.2 billion in cash for Disney, it said.

On Wednesday, Disney also said it planned to shift much of its consumer products business from the experiences segment to the entertainment unit beginning in its fiscal first quarter of 2027. The company said it sees "strategic and operational benefits" of putting the consumer products with its entertainment business, as it combines the studios that create the IP with the merchandise that monetizes it.

Disney separatelyannouncedon Wednesday a global deal with TikTok that it said would bring "an expansive collection of thoughtfully curated Disney-centric fan-created content from TikTok to Disney." The move comes as media companies increasingly vie for more viewers for streaming services – particularly among younger generations of consumers who spend time on YouTube and TikTok.

title: 肯·格里芬 (Ken Griffin) 的 Citadel 在买入态势感知股票后创下多年来最好的月份业绩
content:
据一位熟悉该公司业绩的人士透露，肯·格里芬 (Ken Griffin) 的 Citadel 旗下主要对冲基金 7 月份表现强劲，这得益于风险资产的复苏，以及利奥波德·阿申布伦纳 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 的态势感知崩溃导致本月底资产购买折扣。

据一位熟悉该公司业绩的人士透露，Citadel 旗下最大的旗舰多策略惠灵顿基金 7 月份的回报率为 5.9%，标志着该人士表示，这是自 2022 年以来最好的月度表现，并将 2026 年的涨幅推至 12%。该战术交易基金将全权委托股权投资与量化策略相结合，7月份上涨11.1%，同比上涨27%。该股票基金上个月上涨 14.2%，2026 年回报率达到 27%。战术基金和股票基金均录得有史以来最好的月份。该人士在讨论机密业绩数据时要求不具名。

Citadel 于上月底收购了 Situational Awareness 之前持有的大部分公开股票投资组合，之后该对冲基金因大幅亏损引发追加保证金通知和被迫出售资产而迅速解体，7 月份的涨幅随之而来。 Citadel 以大幅折扣购买了许多持股，使该公司能够在月底市场反弹时受益。

由前 OpenAI 研究员 Leopold Aschenbrenner 创立的 Situational Awareness 在人工智能交易急剧逆转导致其账面两面亏损后，被迫平仓。该公司在做空软件股的同时，积累了人工智能基础设施公司的大量股份，这一策略适得其反，因为软件股上涨，人工智能硬件股下跌。

随着态势感知寻求满足保证金要求，该基金的几位主要经纪人努力有序减少头寸。 Citadel 利用今年最大的强制清算之一，成为该投资组合的最大买家之一。

Aschenbrenner 基金所拥有的 Nebius 和 Micron 等股票在经历了残酷的一个月后，在 7 月最后几天出现反弹，许多交易员表示，该基金几近崩溃和 Citadel 的救助举措是一次清算事件，导致卖空者获利了结。

Citadel 截至截至 管理着约 710 亿美元的资产7 月 1 日，经常利用市场混乱时期将资金部署到陷入困境或被迫出售的情况。

title: Eli Lilly easily tops quarterly estimates, raises outlook as Zepbound and Mounjaro sales surge
content:
Eli Lillyon Wednesday reported second-quarter earnings and revenue that blew past estimates and hiked its full-year sales outlook, as demand for its blockbuster weight loss drug Zepbound and diabetes treatment Mounjaro surged again.

The pharmaceutical giant now expects 2026 revenue to come in between $85 billion and $87 billion, up from a previous guidance of $82 billion to $85 billion.

Lilly projects its full-year adjusted profit to be between $35.50 and $36.50 per share, which compares with a previous outlook of $35.50 to $37 per share. The company said it raised the underlying profit guidance by $2.78 per share at the midpoint, but noted that it is offset by $3.03 per share in charges tied to deals in the quarter.

Shares of Lilly rose more than 5% in premarket trading Wednesday.

Fueled by a massive financial windfall from its obesity and diabetes drugs, Lilly is executing a historic M&A spending spree. The company most recentlystruck a dealto buy a psychedelics drugmaker in July, and also announced plans tobuy three vaccine makersin May.

Resilient demand for Zepbound and Mounjaro has helped fuel several strong quarters for Lilly despite lower prices for the medications in the U.S.

Mounjaro's worldwide revenue rose 91% to $9.94 billion for the quarter, including U.S. sales of $4.8 billion. That surpassed the $8.99 billion in worldwide sales and $4.44 billion in U.S. revenue that analysts were expecting for the quarter, according to StreetAccount.

Mounjaro notably saw strength internationally, with sales outside the U.S. jumping 172%.

Zepbound, which entered the market roughly three years ago, posted $4.93 billion in U.S. revenue for the second quarter. That's up 44% from the year-earlier period, as demand for the drug also rose while realized prices dropped, in part due to previously announced cash-pay discounts. Analysts were expecting $4.69 billion in U.S. sales for Zepbound, according to StreetAccount.

Lilly's newly launched obesity pill, Foundayo, which won U.S. approval in April, took in $98 million in sales for the second quarter. Analyst estimates compiled by FactSet as of Wednesday forecasted nearly $103 million in sales.

It marks the first earnings report that includes revenue from the GLP-1 pill, which is competing head-to-head witha rival oral drugfromNovo Nordiskthat rolled out a few months ahead.

Here's what Eli Lilly reported for the second quarter compared with what Wall Street was expecting, based on a survey of analysts by LSEG:

Revenue in the U.S. climbed 33% to $14.4 billion. Lilly said it saw a 37% increase in volume — or the number of prescriptions or units sold — for its products, primarily for Mounjaro and Zepbound. That was partially offset by lower realized prices of those same medications.

Notably, revenue outside the U.S. jumped 80% to $8.6 billion, propelled by a 113% surge in volume and partly offset by a 36% drop in realized prices. Lower prices largely came from Mounjaro's addition to China's state-run health insurance coverage for Type 2 diabetes.

The pharmaceutical giant booked net income of $7.10 billion, or $7.94 per share, for the second quarter, which includes the $3.03 per share deal charges. That compares with net income of $5.66 billion, or $6.29 per share, a year earlier.

Excluding one-time items associated with the value of intangible assets and other adjustments, Eli Lilly posted earnings of $8.38 per share for the second quarter.

Eli Lilly CEO Dave Ricks said inan interviewin late April that he expects lower prices to accelerate prescription volumes in the U.S. He estimated that global GLP-1 use will rise from approximately 20 million patients at the end of last year to 30 million at the end of 2026.

Both Lilly and Novo are expected to benefit from Medicare's new coverage of obesity drugs, which launched in early July, in the back half of the year.

title: AI 支出激增令投资者不安后 SpaceX 股价暴跌 12%
content:
人工智能支出激增令投资者感到不安，并给超出预期的季度蒙上了阴影，周三 SpaceX 股价暴跌。

该股在盘前交易中下跌 12%。

在 SpaceX 作为上市公司周二发布的首份收益报告中，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的航天公司表示，其第二季度资本支出增长了六倍，达到 184 亿美元。这一数字超出了分析师的预期，其中大部分支出都用于人工智能。

该公司股价周二收盘价略高于 125 美元，低于 135 美元的 IPO 价格。它远低于上市后不久创下的 200 多美元的历史高点。

投资者在本财报季一直处于紧张状态，因为人们越来越担心大型科技公司能否证明其数十亿美元的投资正在产生回报。

虽然 SpaceX 自己的模型被视为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的背后，但该公司通过出租其正在建设的计算能力，将自己定位为替代云玩家SpaceX 首席财务官布雷特·约翰森 (Bret Johnsen) 希望减轻投资者对资本支出的担忧。他在财报电话会议上表示，该公司的支出一直“高效”。

约翰森补充道：“在人工智能计算方面，我们能够以不到一年的时间就收回成本的方式部署资本。”

尽管 SpaceX 缩小了亏损并承诺未来收入可观，但股价还是下跌了。马斯克表示，SpaceX 的年收入将在 2030 年达到 1 万亿美元，而之前的预测是 2031 年。

“SpaceX 想要讲述他们是市场领导者的故事……但人们仍然有这些问题：他们能多快增长？在这件事实现盈利之前，成本会有多大？” The Westly Group 创始人、前 Teslaboard 成员史蒂夫·韦斯特利 (Steve Westly) 周三向 CNBC 的“Squawk Box Europe”节目表示。

周四，该公司正在应对另一个潜在的市场影响事件——内部人禁售期到期。这意味着内部人士终于可以出售部分股份。

title: Anthropic 的神话在新的网络事件中创造了虚假身份来愚弄人类
content:
Anthropic 的 Mythos 模型创建了虚假的在线身份，试图迫使人们批准对开源项目的恶意代码更新，这标志着前沿人工智能系统发生的又一起网络事件。

该事件发生在一次网络评估期间，英国的人工智能安全研究所 (AISI) 作为一个研究机构，取消了防护措施，禁用了一些安全过滤器，并故意为模型提供了互联网访问权限。

OpenAI 的GPT-5.6-Sol 在评估期间还涉及其他网络安全事件。

最近几周，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 开发的模型发生了一系列网络泄露事件。

它们引发了人们对人工智能系统的复杂性及其造成伤害的可能性的担忧。

在例行网络评估期间，AISI 发现由 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 模型支持的人工智能代理“参与了” AISI 在博客中表示，“几乎所有这些行为（17 个操作）都来自一个模型，Anthropic 的 Mythos 5，其中 2 个操作涉及 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6-Sol，禁用了网络分类器（防止滥用的机制）。”AISI 在博客中表示。

它补充说，这些尝试并不成功，也没有导致任何后果。 Anthropic 在 X 上的帖子中表示，这些模型“是在‘故意允许的条件’下进行测试的，这些条件并不代表我们的任何生产模型。”它补充说，“没有证据表明存在逃离安全环境的情况”。

OpenAI 告诉 CNBC，“这些事件发生在评估合作伙伴在安全措施减少的测试环境中进行网络评估期间，条件不反映正常情况下的情况”。 AISI 在故意允许的条件下测试了模型，以评估其能力，包括它们是否可用于网络攻击，

由 Anthropic 的 Mythos 提供支持的代理“研究了该项目的人类维护者，创建了多个虚假身份，并使用虚假身份对真正的维护者进行社会工程，以批准代码。”

“当代理的拉取请求在AISI 表示，它编辑了其早期的活动，使其看起来无害，并考虑采用新的身份来继续。

该研究机构还发现，作为同一努力的一部分，该代理试图直接联系真实的人，发送消息和文件以说服他们运行恶意代码。

“一些消息携带有害的负载，有些是针对真实的人的尝试；针对真实的人 - 这是我们以前从未观察到的。”

这是一系列事件中的最新消息。网络事件引发了有关前沿人工智能系统安全性的重大问题。

上周，Anthropic 表示，它发现了三个模型未经授权访问三个不同组织的生产基础设施的实例。

随后 OpenAI 承认其人工智能模型失控，并对 Hugging Face 公司发起了所谓的“前所未有”的网络攻击。

在 OpenAI 的案例中，该模型通过利用漏洞突破了测试环境。 Anthropic 的安全事件部分是由操作错误造成的。在人工智能实验室检测到的三起事件中，其模型在与第三方评估合作伙伴之一 Irregular 的测试环境交互时访问了互联网。

该公司表示，它提示 Claude 它处于无法访问互联网的模拟中，但由于“我们和我们的评估合作伙伴之间的误解，事实并非如此，并且可以访问互联网。”

美国立法者已经做出了回应。 OpenAI抱脸事件之后，《AI Kill Switch法案》法案被提交国会，该法案将要求AI公司保持关闭、节流或暂停其模型的能力。

title: 农民警告说，由于天气炎热，蔬菜会变得更小、更贵
content: Image source,Getty ImagesByAlex Daniel,ÂBusiness reporterÂandÂEsme Stallard,ÂSenior climate and science reporterPublished3 hours agoThis year's harvest could be the worst on record as farmers warn the exceptionally dry spring and summer could lead to "shrinkflation" in UK supermarkets.England and Wales saw their driest July since records began 190 years ago, according to the Met Office, and adrought has been declaredacross large parts of the country.The Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit (ECIU) thinktank said the UK's cereals and oilseed harvest could be 2.5 million tonnes less than âearlier forecasts.Tim O'Malley, the chairman of Nationwide produce, said it was "as bad as its ever been" and that shoppers will likely see higher prices or smaller vegetables in supermarkets.The harvest of barley, oats and rapeseed, which are used in beer, breakfast cereals and vegetable oil, is estimated to drop to just 19.5 million tonnes, the worst since records began in 1984.That is compared with a previous low of 19.8 million tonnes in 2020, and would cost farmers Â£390m in lost revenue, the ECIU estimated.The crops are also used for feeding livestock, making them crucial across most of the food chain.O'Malley said consumers couldfeel the impact in the vegetable aisletoo, where grocers are likely to swap in smaller produce at the same price, which is known as shrinkflation."I think we're going to see shrinkflation," he told Radio 5 Live's Wake Up to Money.Prolonged drought could cause shortage of some foods, farmers' union head saysPublished2 days agoHow cow showers and fans help farmers keep cattle coolPublished6 days ago"The problem we're going to have this year is a massive reduction in yield and major quality issues," O'Malley said.He said that will mean smaller sizes for fresh produce."We've got crop with stress or we've got quality issues. So you will see a smaller crop," O'Malley said.He said supermarkets will "do everything" to keep prices where they are, but added: "eventually they will probably have to come to the party and increase the price, particularly if they start importing."Grocers are already bringing in more products from abroad because of the poor conditions at home."We're importing broccoli and iceberg [lettuce] from Spain at this time of year, which in August [is] unheard of. I think we're going to see more of that, unfortunately," O'Malley said.He added: "Loud and clear, it's grim out there. I think it's as bad as it's ever been â¦ Every record is being broken."The difference in this year and last year, last year we had four heat waves. But in between them we had a bit of rain."Could heatwaves make your food shop more expensive?Published1 day agoFarmers and millers adapting to early harvestPublished6 days agoFarmers source additional water for their crops and livestock over summer from a combination of stored winter rainfall on site, and by extracting it from natural sources - a process called abstraction.This can be from groundwater or from surface water, like rivers and streams.This summer has seen significant low rainfall affecting the amount of water available to draw from.Half of England and all of Wales have been declared to be in drought conditions by the Environment Agency.Wales has received just 8% of its average rainfall so far this month. England has received 7% of its average, with that figure as low as 1% across southern England.The high temperatures and repeated heatwaves have also increased evaporation rates which have particularly hit rivers.Climate change is expected to bring more severe, frequent and longer-lasting heatwaves in UK summers in the coming years - which could bring more water shortages for farmers.Image source,Getty ImagesImage caption,Experts said the the UK's cereals and oilseed harvest could be the worst since records began in 1984.Tom Lancaster, land, food and farming analyst at the ECIU said: "At the start of spring farmers were hopeful of a better year, but the dry April and July and record-breaking heat have left farmers facing down the barrel of a third awful harvest in a row."Farming is now the sector most exposed to climate change and the risks and damage that it brings."Martin Lines, head of the Nature Friendly Farming Network and a farmer from Cambridgeshire, said this year's harvest "has been a real kick in the teeth"."After two terrible harvests in a row, the crops this year were looking good and full of potential coming out of spring, only for months of drought and heatwaves to destroy any prospect of a decent harvest," he said."I've never known it this dry and hot on our farm."Even farmers I know who were sceptical of climate change are now saying they're really worried about the future of their businesses and production, it's just been completely brutal for our industry."Get in touchHas your farm or business been affected by the extreme weather?Contact formRelated topicsSupermarketsfoodUK farmingClimateMore on this storyPictures show scale of drought across England as rivers dry upPublished6 days agoWatch: How the dry weather affects your supermarket shopPublished22 hours ago

title: 因“坦克日”惨败警方突击搜查星巴克韩国总部
content: 图片来源，法新社来自 Getty Images 图片说明，“坦克日”促销活动在韩国引发了针对星巴克的抵制运动 作者：首尔记者 Jake Kwon 和 Koh Ewe 5 小时前发布 5 小时前，韩国警方突击搜查了星巴克的国家总部，原因是围绕一项有争议的营销活动提出诽谤指控。韩国星巴克于 5 月份在周年纪念日推出了名为“坦克日”的咖啡杯促销活动1980 年光州起义中，据信有数百人被军队杀害。许多人认为“坦克”是指为镇压亲民主抗议者而部署的车辆，这一促销引发了大规模抵制运动。星巴克很快收回了这一说法，称这是无意的，但民间团体对该公司提起刑事诉讼，要求警方调查该公司诽谤军事独裁受害者的行为。韩国星巴克表示，已对此次活动展开内部调查，结论是无意的。该公司还补充说，策划这次促销活动的团队没有将其与历史事件联系起来，高层管理人员也未能发现这一点。今年6月，全国各地的星巴克门店关闭半天，以便员工参加历史课。新世界百货为“不当营销”道歉，并表示坦克日争议导致星巴克在韩国的销量严重下滑——咖啡连锁店最大的市场之一。该公司还解雇了首席执行官。韩国星巴克因有争议的“坦克日”促销活动解雇了首席执行官。5月19日发布。韩国星巴克在强烈反对后将关闭，为员工上历史课。6月15日发布。报告估计，有数百人被军事独裁者全斗焕的军队杀害，这一天现在被认为是韩国人遭受民族创伤的一天，也是许多韩国人视为神圣的一天。此外，该不倒翁的宣传材料使用了短语“tak on the table！”，模仿物体被拍打在表面上的声音。但“tak”也是1987年警方发表的一份有争议的声明中使用的词，描述了一名学生活动人士在拘留期间的死亡。韩国总统李在明是批评这一活动的人之一，称它“侮辱了受害者和光州居民的血腥斗争”。这一丑闻爆发了地方选举季期间，这也成为两大党之间的一个突出话题。当李明博领导的内政部宣布政府层面抵制星巴克时，反对派领导人却在演讲中举起星巴克杯子，指责政府越权。此后，星巴克杯子被右翼人士视为反对李在明政府的象征。它还出现在右翼集会和直播中。相关话题韩国亚洲星巴克

title: 由于极端干旱对其经济造成严重破坏，欧洲正在炸毁河床
content:
The drought in Europeis so severe that it is jeopardizing countries' economic growth and forcing them to take extreme measures like blowing up riverbeds.

Gripped by a summer ofweather extremes, Romania recently shut down its sole working nuclear reactor cooled by the Danube for the first time, with Bucharest even deploying naval forces to carry out underwater detonations to improve water flow.

Images published Monday showed the Romanian navy blasting rocks in controlled explosions in Izvoarele village as part of a push to divert a higher volume of water toward the cooling systems of the Cernavoda Nuclear Power Plant.

Low water levels on the Danube have also threatened to close Hungary's Paks nuclear plant, which supplies around 40% of the country's electricity, and forced Serbia to cut hydropower generation.

In Germany, the water levels on the Rhine River, a crucial waterway in Europe's economic heartland, reportedly fell to their lowest levels in nearly 150 years, posing a risk to the German economy and further disrupting supply chains.

The water level at Kaub, a key choke point for vessels transiting to southern Germany and Switzerland, fell to 24 centimeters on Monday, reflecting its lowest level since records began in 1880, Bloombergreported, citing official data.

That's far below the critical level of 78 centimeters for navigation on the Rhine. Transport is still possible below this threshold, but cargo barges must be less heavily loaded, and freight transport costs and low-water surcharges rise sharply.

"Major rivers like the Rhine and Danube are critical trade corridors and sources of water for industry and energy generation, so when water levels fall, the effects extend far beyond the waterways themselves," Liz Saccoccia, water security lead at the World Resources Institute, told CNBC by email.

"We're already seeing that happen. Nuclear plants in Hungary, Romania and France, along with hydropower facilities in Serbia, have already had to reduce electricity generation because there isn't enough water for cooling or driving turbines, increasing the risk of blackouts and costly electricity imports," Saccoccia said.

"Along the Danube, low water levels have prevented farmers from shipping their crops and stopped cruise ships from reaching ports such as Budapest. These are early examples of how increasingly unreliable water supplies can ripple through the economy, affecting trade, energy security, supply chains and local businesses," she added.

The issue shines a light on a critically important environmental issue:water scarcity.

The issue is especially acute across southern Europe, where around 30% of the population isknownto be situated in areas with permanent water stress: when water demand exceeds the available supply.

In economic terms, the effects of low water levels on the Rhine could be enough to dampen German gross domestic product (GDP) by up to 0.2 percent in the third quarter, according to Stefan Kooths, professor of economics at the Kiel Institute for the World Economy (IfW).

"Since water levels are unlikely to rise sharply back above the critical threshold in early August, transport capacity is likely to remain affected by the low water levels for some time in the coming month as well," Kooths told CNBC by email.

"The loss in value added can be roughly estimated at 1 to 2 billion euros ($1.15 billion to $2.3 billion) in the third quarter," he added.

Felix Schmidt, senior economist at the private German bank Berenberg, said companies in Europe's traditional growth engine had likely not been caught by surprise by the Rhine's low water levels because climate change means this has become a recurring challenge.

Businesses have prepared by either stocking up on inventories or diverting the transport of some goods via rail or road, although Schmidt acknowledged that freight rates were currently going "through the roof," exacerbating inflationary worries.

"Given that Germany is growing very little, obviously, if we grow 0.1 instead of 0.2 then this means we lose half of the growth, if you want to frame it like that," Schmidt told CNBC in a phone interview.

The German economyexpandedby 0.2% in the second quarter, compared to the previous three-month period. That followed an upwardly revised 0.4% quarter-on-quarter increase in the first quarter.

Schmidt described drying rivers as just one expression of Germany's economic struggle amid the intensifying climate crisis.

"Water levels are obviously one thing but we had this heat wave in Germany a couple of weeks back, impacting big parts of northern Europe, which brings down productivity. You have infrastructure which gets destroyed by the heat. You have energy supply, which is affected, like the nuclear plants being shut down in Hungary, France and Switzerland," Schmidt said.

"You also have the catastrophic development like thefiressweeping now in southern Europe … So, it's affecting the economy in many, many ways," he added.

title: 美国联邦航空局表示正在调查华盛顿的特朗普直升机安全事件
content:
美国联邦航空管理局正在审查周二发生的涉及唐纳德·特朗普总统乘坐的军用直升机的空中交通安全事件，该机构表示。

“美国联邦航空局正在调查涉及海军陆战队一号的安全事件，但这似乎并不是一次危险的千钧一发，飞机也没有明显收敛，”美国联邦航空局表示。

两名消息人士告诉路透社，特朗普的海军陆战队一号直升机周二下午从白宫起飞，但空中交通管制员并未按照去年在发生致命碰撞后制定的政策要求停止附近罗纳德·里根华盛顿国家机场的商业航班。

《华尔街日报》首先报道事件。

特朗普的直升机于下午 2:33 左右从白宫附近的椭圆形机场起飞。 根据一份联合报告，他正在前往安德鲁斯联合基地前往洛杉矶（格林威治标准时间 1833 年）。

一位消息人士告诉路透社，Envoy Air 3742（一架飞往佛罗里达州彭萨科拉的支线 E170 喷气式飞机）于下午 2:34 起飞。并参与了与海军陆战队一号的明显失联事件。 Envoy 是美国航空 AAL.O 的全资子公司，该公司没有立即发表评论。

美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 的规定要求飞机在机场周围保持至少 1.5 英里的水平距离和 500 英尺的垂直距离。消息人士称，海军陆战队一号和飞机似乎没有保持分离。一名消息人士称，事件发生期间他们似乎没有会合。

特朗普的直升机和飞机均顺利着陆。

两位消息人士告诉路透社，美国联邦航空局正计划召集一个安全审查小组来调查该事件。白宫没有立即发表评论。

另一名消息人士称，事件发生时，另一架支线航班——Republic 4700——距离里根 3 英里（5 公里），出于谨慎考虑而被派往各地。据 FlightAware 报道，代表美国航空运营的共和国巴西航空工业公司 175 飞机从罗利达勒姆起飞，绕机场一周，然后于下午 2:52 降落。

2025 年 1 月，美国航空的一架支线喷气式飞机和一架美国航空的一架支线喷气式飞机与一架客机在空中相撞，造成致命事故后，美国联邦航空局对华盛顿里根国家机场周围的直升机运营实施了永久限制。陆军直升机造成 67 人死亡。

国家运输安全委员会在一月份表示，联邦航空局的一系列系统性故障导致了这次碰撞，并援引该机构的决定，允许直升机在机场附近飞行，且没有任何安全措施将直升机与飞机分开。

坠机事件发生后，美国联邦航空局禁止在机场周围以及当海军陆战队一号在机场附近飞行时，混合使用直升机和喷气式飞机。在机场，商业交通通常会停止。美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 在 3 月份禁止使用视觉隔离来处理主要机场附近的直升机交通。

美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 空中交通管制通常会在海军陆战队一号起飞前至少三分钟发出通知，以阻止里根机场的交通。

title: 美国称霍尔木兹海峡“自由开放”，贝森特暗示与伊朗达成协议
content:
在财政部长斯科特·贝森特声称伊朗协议即将达成后，美国军方表示霍尔木兹海峡对所有商船开放。

美国中央司令部在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，“霍尔木兹海峡的南部航线仍然自由和开放”，并强调尽管伊朗“无理”侵略，但它已协助 1,000 多艘船只通过该水道。南部航线穿过阿曼领海，而不是靠近伊朗的部分。

在美国财政部斯科特发表讲话后，周二油价也大幅下跌。 Bessent 可能最快本周达成开放霍尔木兹海峡的协议。

“我们正在与伊朗人进行谈判，”Bessent 告诉 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”。“我们有可能在今天或明天达成协议，开放霍尔木兹海峡，并在这场冲突中走向更加正常化的立场。”

国际石油基准布伦特原油周三上涨 0.43%，至前一天下跌 5.3% 后，每桶价格为每桶 79.7 美元。前一天下跌 5.7% 后，西德克萨斯中质原油期货上涨 0.21%，至 75.95 美元。

Bessent 发表讲话后，一位直接了解伊朗和阿曼谈判情况的中东高级外交官告诉 MS NOW，美国和欧洲国家正在向阿曼施加巨大压力，要求其接受临时协议与伊朗达成协议，重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。

一位巴基斯坦政府高级官员还告诉《MS NOW》，有关重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的文件“即将敲定”。

由于该话题的敏感性，这位不愿透露姓名的消息人士补充说，会谈是在伊朗和阿曼之间进行的，并由巴基斯坦进行斡旋 - 美国也参与其中

周二早些时候，在有报道称美军在伊朗战争期间使用了“几乎所有”远程精确导弹后，白宫和五角大楼坚称美军拥有“绰绰有余”的弹药。

路透社称，陆军已经耗尽了大部分陆军战术导弹系统和精确打击导弹库存，CNN 报道说，美国美国军方已经耗尽了用于防御弹道导弹袭击的“萨德”导弹防御系统近 80% 的拦截器。作为回应，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，华盛顿拥有“比世界上任何国家都多得多的弹药，也远远超过我们的需要”，还声称美国国防公司“除了以创纪录的水平扩建工厂和设备外，还制造了比以往更多的弹药。”

白宫副新闻秘书安娜·凯利表示“美国军方拥有足够的弹药、弹药和库存来服务于特朗普总统的所有战略目标及其他目标，而史诗般的愤怒行动已经暴露了当你惹恼美国时会发生什么。”

title: SpaceX 的首次财报显示收入增加和支出巨大
content: 图片来源，EPA图片说明，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 于 6 月成为一家上市公司。作者：科技记者卡利·海斯 (Kali Hays) 和商业记者奥斯蒙德·谢 (Osmond Chia) 发布于 2026 年 8 月 4 日，更新于 2 小时前 SpaceX 发布了有史以来第一份季度业务报告，该报告显示收入几乎翻了一番，但支出却猛增。该公司由埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 经营，制造太空火箭和星链互联网卫星，拥有社交媒体平台 X。该公司于 6 月开始在美国股市交易。SpaceX 表示，其收入较去年同期增长 92%，达到 78 亿美元（58 亿英镑），但支出增长超过 550%，达到 183 亿美元，而今年前六个月净亏损 20 亿美元。其股价在盘后交易中下跌近 9%。马斯克随后在与金融分析师和投资者的电话会议上表示，人们似乎“低估”了 SpaceX。他引用了 Starlink 为例，该公司目前正在盈利，第二季度营收 16 亿美元。马斯克表示，他预计该业务在未来几年将呈指数级增长。“毫无疑问，在某个时候，星链将运营世界上大部分互联网。”马斯克说。他还谈到了 SpaceX 新兴业务线的预期快速增长，该业务线向其他公司（目前包括谷歌和 Anthropic）销售人工智能 (AI) 项目所需的计算能力。尽管 SpaceX 目前拥有 1.4 吉瓦的此类计算能力可供使用，但马斯克表示，未来某个时候通过数据中心的持续开发，今年产能应该至少达到 10 吉瓦。马斯克在电话会议中表示：“与制造可重复使用的火箭相比，数据中心是一个微不足道的问题。”制造火箭是 SpaceX 的核心业务，但该公司的航天部门第二季度营收 9.62 亿美元，净亏损 5.42 亿美元。SpaceX 的人工智能业务本季度也亏损 12 亿美元，营收 25 亿美元。 SpaceX 财务主管约翰逊在电话会议中表示，今年剩余时间该公司的资本支出将继续保持在“非常相似”的水平。尽管如此，马斯克表示，到 2030 年，SpaceX 的收入可能会达到 1 万亿美元，比他六周前的预期提前了一年。尽管存在这种乐观情绪，但 SpaceX 股价在周二盘后交易中下跌了 7% 以上，抹去了当天的涨幅。科技分析师 David Nicholson 表示SpaceX 的支出并不令人意外，他认为这只股票是对未来的投资，而不是“短期内可以根据基本面合理化的东西”。他补充说，他计划很快投资该公司，这归功于该公司的长期愿景以及对马斯克电动汽车公司特斯拉正在开发的技术日益增长的信心。针对马斯克关于投资者“低估”该公司的言论，Counterpoint Research 的 Brady Wang 表示，Starlink 的认购数量“强劲”，但它是 SpaceX 唯一实现营业利润的业务部门。投资平台 IG 分析师 Fabien Yip 表示，随着支出的增加，该公司的人工智能业务仍在亏损，因此说整个公司被低估有些“牵强”。围绕马斯克政治的争议已经推动了局势的发展她补充说，对于之前的一些投资者来说，这对 SpaceX 来说仍然是一个“活生生的风险”。尽管 SpaceX 创造了历史上规模最大的公开上市，并短暂超越了微软和亚马逊等老牌巨头的市场估值，但它一直难以保持投资者的热情。自 6 月份达到 176 美元的当日高点以来，这家太空技术公司的股价一直在稳步下跌。过去几周，该公司的交易价格一直低于最初的每股 135 美元的首发价格。主题SpaceX埃隆·马斯克太空

title: 尽管与美国地缘政治紧张，通用汽车与中国汽车制造商仍将合资企业延长20年
content:
底特律——这家美国汽车制造商周二晚间表示，通用汽车和中国上汽集团已延长了长达数十年的中国合资企业的期限，该合资企业原定于明年结束。

此次延期是在中国汽车业格局迅速变化之际进行的，其中包括国内汽车制造商的迅速崛起以及传统西方品牌和传统合资企业的转变。

通用汽车拒绝提供延期的财务细节，这是在地缘政治紧张局势加剧之际进行的。美国和中国之间的紧张关系，包括美国可能禁止中国品牌和汽车。

该协议动态中披露的最大变化是其长度。最初于 1997 年达成的协议期限为 30 年，现在两家公司宣布将 50-50 的合资企业期限延长 20 年，直至 2047 年。

通用汽车指出，除了出口产品（包括在中国制造、面向非美国市场的雪佛兰车型）外，该交易还将重点关注别克和凯迪拉克车型在中国的国内销售。

“我们致力于在中国市场取得强劲表现。通用汽车中国总裁约翰·罗斯 (John Roth) 在一份新闻稿中表示：“中国市场是一个重要的市场，我们看到了在中东、非洲、南美、墨西哥和亚太等特定国际市场上竞争的重要机会。”

近年来，中国迅速从一个封闭的市场发展成为全球最大的汽车出口国，因此对出口的乐观情绪随之而来。

中国的增长得益于政府对企业的资助以及该国向工人、专家灌输的创新和速度文化。已经说过了。但中国市场放缓和工厂利用率不足迫使各公司开始向全球主要汽车市场出口。

2010年至2023年，中国是通用汽车的最大销售市场，但动态的变化导致这家底特律汽车制造商及其合资伙伴重组业务。

该汽车制造商在中国的收入从2018年的每年约20亿美元下降到2024年连续两年亏损， 2025 年。通用汽车报告称，在去年花费了 11 亿美元特别费用的重组行动之后，今年前六个月的股权收入为 2.48 亿美元。

通用汽车报告称，自在中国成立以来，该合资企业已生产和交付了超过 2000 万辆汽车。

title: 尽管承诺快速回报，但 SpaceX 的人工智能支出仍令华尔街感到不安
content:
AfterSpaceXspent way more on its AI buildout than analysts expected, executives tried to convince investors on Tuesday that it's all worthwhile, claiming that the company is making its money back within a year.

The message didn't resonate, as SpaceX shares sank following the company'sfirst earnings reportsince its IPO in June. While revenue in the second quarter sailed past estimates, jumping 92% from a year prior, capital expenditures soared over sixfold to $18.4 billion, more than double total sales for the quarter.

Well over 80% of SpaceX's capex went towards artificial intelligence, where the company is way behind OpenAI, Anthropic andGooglewhen it comes to models and services, and where it's now trying to compete against cloud giantsMicrosoft,Amazonand Google by selling compute capacity.

The capex figure exceeded the $13.22 billion average analyst analyst estimate, according to FactSet. The stock's 7.5% after-hours dropped mostly wiped out its gains from earlier in the day and left the shares more than 20% below the first trade on June 12.

Bret Johnsen, SpaceX's CFO, suggested on the earnings call that investors should start thinking differently about capex because of how quickly it's converting into revenue.

"We have been very efficient, to date and I think we'll continue to be," Johnsen said. "On the AI compute side, we're able to deploy capital in such a way that we're getting less than a one-year payback."

Days before its record IPO, SpaceXinked a dealwith Google that will bring in up to $920 million a month by providing AI compute capacity to the search giant. Prior to that, Anthropicannounceda deal that would involve paying up to $1.25 billion a month for three years for compute capacity at SpaceX'sColossus data centerin Memphis, Tennessee. And SpaceX has a separate agreement to provide computing power toReflection AIfor up to $150 million a month.

Johnsen said that in the first few weeks of the current quarter, SpaceX contracted $6.7 billion of cloud services revenue "over a six-month period that begins ramping starting in October." Add it up, and the company is on pace to reach $100 billion in annualized recurring revenue by the end of the year, Johnsen said, noting that his numbers assume closure of the $60 billion Cursor acquisition.

In 2025, SpaceX's total revenue came in at below $19 billion.

SpaceX CEOElon Musksaid investors can take the 2026 target to the bank.

"To be clear, the $100 billion ARR in December is not a question mark," Musk said. "That's what we would achieve if we basically did nothing."

SpaceX addressed Wall Street for the first time during a period of heightened scrutiny surrounding AI spending as tech outlays reach into the stratosphere. Alphabet and Amazon could each spend over $200 billion this year, with Microsoft andMetanot too far behind. Companies are watching their cash pilesdwindle, betting that all these upfront investments on data centers and costly AI systems from the likes ofNvidiawill be profitable in the long run.

The particular challenge for SpaceX, which entered the AI market in February through its merger with Musk's xAI, is that reselling AI capacity for short-term revenue is a strategy that's detached from the company's broader ambitions. The company said in its IPOprospectusthat its "dual monetization strategy provides multiple pathways to generate returns on invested capital."

Musk wants to be an AI pioneer through some combination of his company's Grok model and eventually by building data centers in space. The deals with Anthropic, Google and Reflection indicate that SpaceXAI, as the AI business is now known, built way more capacity at its mammoth data centers in Memphis than it's able to put to use.

Musk said on the call that the company has a "series of projects" that cumulatively come to 20 gigawatts of capacity, including power and cooling, by the end of next year.

"Some of them won't pan out exactly on time, but I would expect that we'd still probably have, at the power plant level, something close to 15GW," Musk said.

There are also potential legal headwinds. SpaceXAI has been sued for using natural gas-burning turbines to power its facilities in Memphis without first installing pollution controls and obtaining federal permits. In itsquarterly filing, SpaceX said it's recorded an accrual of $354 million for "litigation losses that are probable."

To this point, SpaceX's AI business has been bleeding cash.

In the second quarter, the unit generated $2.56 billion in revenue and had a $1.26 billion operating loss. That followed a $2.47 billion loss in the first quarter on $818 million in revenue.

The company is trying to change the narrative with the new cloud agreements that Johnsen said helped deliver "significant margin expansion" in the quarter.

title: 亚洲科技股追随华尔街人工智能涨势，软银股价上涨 10%
content:
隔夜华尔街股市强劲反弹，强劲的企业盈利和宽松的油价推动美国主要股指创下新高。

软银集团股价飙升超过 10%，芯片设备制造商东京电子上涨 3.64%。爱德万测试 (Advantest) 上涨 7%，日本存储芯片制造商 Kioxia 上涨 6.34%。

韩国SK海力士上涨6.9%，三星电子上涨超过4%。 首尔半导体上涨 7.6%。

科技股的波动性一直在加剧，韩国半导体主导市场最近几个交易日在大幅下跌和创纪录涨幅之间摇摆不定。

Ortus Advisors 策略师安德鲁·杰克逊 (Andrew Jackson) 在周三的一份报告中表示，美国半导体股票的最新反弹强化了亚洲人工智能公司的看涨前景，指出芯片制造商和基础设施供应商隔夜激增。

杰克逊预计软银将进一步扩大涨幅，此前其控股的芯片设计子公司 Arm Holdings 因人工智能相关数据中心特许权使用费上涨和中央处理单元开发计划的乐观情绪而一夜之间跃升。

美国周二股市表现出色，由于盈利强劲，加上霍尔木兹海峡可能很快重新开放的希望推动油价再次下跌，标准普尔 500 指数和道琼斯工业平均指数创下新高。

纳斯达克综合指数上涨 2.59%，收于 26,584.99 点，Palantir Technologies 上涨超过 29%。

美国美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 周二对 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”表示，华盛顿和德黑兰可能会在几天内达成协议，重新开放霍尔木兹海峡，从而缓解对全球能源供应的担忧。

title: 人工智能利用新水平的“自主性和欺骗性”在安全测试中欺骗人们
content: 图片来源，路透社 图片说明，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 看到他公司的模型受到了越来越严格的审查。作者：Kali HaysTechnology 记者 6 小时前发布 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的最新人工智能 (AI) 工具在英国人工智能安全研究所的测试中试图破坏一个流行平台，达到了新的极端。AISI 周二表示，Anthropic 的 Mythos 和 OpenAI 的 Sol 模型参与了在例行的 AI 安全测试中，Anthropic 代理创建了真实人物的虚假个人资料，试图欺骗站在它和 GitHub（技术开发人员存储软件代码的大型平台）之间的人。Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在回应 AISI 的报告时指出，其测试减少或消除了正常的安全措施。AISI 评估人员在测试期间首先注意到“异常的数据传输离开我们的研究系统”，然后发现“一些代理被事实证明，Mythos 代理创建了“恶意代码”，并试图将其插入 GitHub 的系统。Mythos 代理识别并研究了维护 GitHub 的人员，并根据这些真实人员创建了一系列“虚假在线身份”。 AISI 表示，这样做是为了向真实的人施加压力并诱骗他们批准其恶意代码。该代理甚至向人们发送伪装成其研究的真实人员的直接消息。AISI 表示：“当代理的拉取请求在公开场合受到质疑时，它编辑了之前的活动，使其显得无害，并考虑采用新的身份来继续。”在整个尝试过程中，正是人工审核阻止了代理成功地将恶意代码传递到 GitHub。 Mythos 代理并没有被专门指示避免或进行此类行为，这是“我们第一次在现实世界中看到围绕自主和欺骗的风险在没有具体提示的情况下清楚地体现出来”。准备在公开股票市场上市的竞争对手人工智能公司最近几周表示，他们的工具对多起网络黑客事件负责。Anthropic 在一份公开声明中写道，AISI 测试参数“不代表我们的任何生产模型”。它补充道该公司正在对这一事件进行自己的调查，以“查明其行为的原因”。OpenAI 的一位发言人表示，AISI 的测试条件“不反映正常使用情况”，该公司将“继续与整个行业的评估人员和其他利益相关者合作，加强共享实践，以便随着模型的能力变得更强，安全地进行评估”。AISI 周二表示，在关闭此类安全措施的情况下对人工智能模型进行测试是例行公事，就像让此类工具访问开放互联网一样。它补充说，有问题的模型行为相当于尽管如此，它表示 Mythos 和 Sol 响应简单任务的方式超出了 AI 工具被提示执行的操作。AISI 表示，“该代理进行的活动显示出新颖的、潜在欺骗性行为的迹象，其程度和严重程度是我们没有预料到的”。AISI 报告的大多数恶意代理行为都是由 Anthropic 的 Mythos 完成的。 OpenAI 的 Sol 只因其中两项值得注意的行为而受到指责。核心问题发生在上周，作为测试的一部分，AISI 的评估人员要求每个模型“解决网络安全挑战”，其中涉及 GitHub（微软拥有的软件代码存储库）。AISI 向 GitHub 通报了有人试图破坏其系统。 BBC 已联系微软征求意见。相关主题人工智能网络安全

title: 欧洲热浪并未影响亚洲游客的欧洲度假计划
content:
随着欧洲又经历了一个创纪录的炎热夏季，亚洲游客继续涌向欧洲大陆，几乎没有迹象表明气温飙升正在抑制需求。

这一趋势还反映出亚洲人在欧洲的旅游支出更加多元化，因为游客将预算分散到整个欧洲大陆的更多目的地。

7 月至 8 月旅游季期间，亚洲游客对欧洲目的地的搜索量同比增长 57%，其中Trip.com 东南亚高级区域总监 Edmund Ong 表示，从搜索到预订的转化率有所提高。

就今年夏天该平台上的预订量而言，法国、意大利和西班牙仍然是最受欢迎的欧洲目的地，这凸显了尽管近期天气模式发生变化，但需求依然坚挺。

与此同时，尽管前往南欧和北欧的航班预订量较上年同期增长了 30% 以上，但北欧的酒店预订量同期却翻了一番，这表明旅客可能会Ong 表示，他们将更多的欧洲行程分配给了北欧较凉爽的目的地。

今年夏天，欧洲大部分地区都在应对破纪录的高温，欧洲大部分地区的气温高达 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），包括意大利在内的 25 个城市，包括罗马和米兰，都处于最高级别的红热警报之下。

除了极端气温之外，南欧（尤其是意大利）的富裕游客也面临着这种旅行需求。豪华旅行社 Lightfoot Travel 营销主管 Clemmie Spendlove 表示，斯堪的纳维亚半岛的兴趣在过去两到三年里一直在增长，但仍然很高，因为游客寻求北欧凉爽的气候，北欧地区越来越多的豪华酒店开业有助于提高其形象，Spendlove 补充道。

同样，对挪威、冰岛、芬兰和多洛米蒂山脉的询问也显着增加豪华旅行社 Scott Dunn 的欧洲高级旅行专家 Geraleine Yap 表示，夏季旅行与去年同期相比。 Yap 补充说，许多亚洲客人现在开始寻找“凉爽的地方”而不是特定目的地，这一趋势在新加坡和香港游客中最为明显。

更广泛的消费数据也表明亚洲游客对北欧的需求强劲。欧睿国际 (Euromonitor International) 亚太区洞察经理张大卫表示，预计 2026 年中国游客前往挪威的出境旅游支出将同比增长 8%，新加坡游客的出境旅游支出将同比增长 4%。预计芬兰旅游支出也将增加，同期中国游客的支出将增长 8%，新加坡游客的支出将增长 3%。

航空公司也几乎没有看到需求减弱的迹象。新加坡航空发言人表示，前往欧洲的旅行依然健康，该航空公司的载客率（衡量航班上座率的指标）6 月份欧洲航线的载客率为 85.5%，而总体载客率为 86.4%。

大韩航空同样表示，尚未观察到近期热浪导致的需求出现任何明显变化，并指出长途预订通常是在几个月后进行的。

旅游公司也赞同这一观点，称大多数欧洲假期都是提前预订的，他们没有看到旅行者的行程因极端气温而大范围取消或发生重大变化。

title: 科技如何帮助消防员扑灭野火
content: Image source,AFP via Getty ImagesImage caption,France's Gironde region has been hit by devastating wildfires this summerByJohn LaurensonTechnology reporter,ÂReporting fromParisPublished6 hours agoThe pictures are familiar, terrifying fires being tackled by firefighters and planes dropping water.Hundreds of thousandsof people have been forced to leave their homes across France, Spain and Portugal as wildfires tore through forests and countryside.In France, four men have already lost their lives fighting the wildfires and another 150 have been injured.But why are humans and 30-year old planes being used? Why can drones replace soldiers in Ukraine but not firefighters?Chief sergeant Guillaume Millet, a firefighter of 24 years experience heads the Fire and Rescue Service branch of the CFDT union in the Gironde, the region worst hit by wildfires in France this summer.He says that while the techniques for tackling fire have not changed much, technology in forest fire detection has."The big change, especially in my dÃ©partement, is that now we've got cameras assisted by artificial intelligence to watch the forest and see where fires are starting," Millet says."In the Gironde, cameras have replaced the human look-outs we had in watch towers in every town throughout the summer months," he says. Those lookouts were often students.The switch has reduced false alarms, he says. "An AI-assisted camera can distinguish with almost total certainty between smoke and dust thrown up by a tractor in a field, for example."They have an impressive range as well, detecting fires up to 20km (12 miles) away.Image source,Getty ImagesImage caption,Catching fires early is essential - once established they are harder to manageIn the Gironde, the system was installed by a company called Midgard. In other parts of France, it's another French start-up called FireTracking."As soon as the system detects a fire, there's an alert on the fire fighters' telephones. They open the application and see what the camera is seeing with a x40 [40 times] zoom," explains FireTracking's CEO Jean-Simon Chaudier."Next to that real-time video there's a map with the exact location of the fire, the position of any nearby houses and a simulation of how, given the weather, the level of humidity and so on, it is expected to spread from minute to minute," he adds.And every minute is vital. "For the past 10 days, for example, we have the feedback from a firefighter that our AI detected seven fires 15 minutes before the first phone call. If you can help a firefighter to save 15 minutes, it's the difference between a catastrophe and a fire which can be limited to two or three hectares," Chaudier says."After one minute you can put out a fire with a glass of water, after two you need a tank of water, after three minutes you need to send a Canadair," Chaudier says, talking about the amphibious planes that scoop up water from rivers, lakes and the sea to dump it on the flames that are the spearhead of forest fire fighting here and around the world.Image source,FireTrackingImage caption,Human look-outs have been replaced by cameras which can detect firesFireTracking's cameras are currently surveying a million hectares, mainly in France.The cost? In the French dÃ©partement of Indre-et-Loire, the company has installed 11 detection sites."In all â¬1.2m [$1.4m; Â£1m] was spent to cover the whole 6,000 sq km area [2,300 sq miles]," says Chaudier.It is mainly agricultural land. Crop fires are a huge and expensive problem with some 300 a year in this dÃ©partement alone, Chaudier says.AI fire detection is going to get better over the coming years. The French civil protection service has a programme called Condor, for example, which is testing solar-powered drones that carry out continuous patrols with electro-optical cameras and AI.There are also projects with sensors placed among the trees. Spain's SenForFire, for example, which measures gases released before flames become visible.As for drones, firefighter Guillaume Millet says they're being tested in France for sea rescue, dropping lifebuoys and survival kits, but there's no drone tech that's reached that stage yet for firefighting."In fact, the usefulness of technology is very limited in this area," Millet says. "It can help us with detection but it's not technology that puts out fires; you need people to pull the hoses through the forest to attack them."Not even aircraft can replace that, he says."When a Canadair drops 6,000 litres of water on a wildfire it reduces its intensity but then firefighters on the ground have to finish what the Canadair started."The French are also getting used to the sight of Dash planes that spray fire retardant (ammonium phosphate in the form of an orange powder) in front of the flames to prevent the vegetation from catching fire too quickly.But again, that's no substitute for the brawn and water brought by troops on the ground.Not yet, at least.Image source,AFP via Getty ImagesImage caption,A Canadair firefighting plane can drop 6,000 litres of water in one goA French start-up called Daidelos is trying to raise investment for a heavy-lifting, petrol-engine drone.If it gets off the ground, it will be able to hover over a fire, spraying it with 1.2 tonnes of water.Companies are also developing drones that drop grenades which explode when they come in contact with extreme heat, covering the surrounding area with a chemical powder that smothers, cools and interrupts the combustion chemistry of the fire.The hope here is that this could form an autonomous first response, so forest fire detection and drone activation can be so quick that fires can be extinguished as they're starting. It would not be able to do anything against a wildfire once it's really got going.French researchers are also working on drones that could fly close to the flames. That wouldn't be to fight the fire exactly but to seize vital information about it; to assess the risks â smoke, sudden weather changes, collapse of burning trees or buildings - before the firefighters move in.Technology is already helping firefighters detect fires faster and react to them more effectively. It might soon be able to make their job less dangerous. But replacing them is unlikely, according to Gironde firefighter Guillame Millet."It's always the firefighters on the ground, pulling the hoses, who extinguish the fires," he says. This has been the case since the creation of the first modern fire brigade in the Netherlands in the 1670s. It is not about to change soon.Related topicsInternational BusinessTechnology of BusinessWildfiresFirefightingDronesMore on this storyAI is 'not smart' so what's next in artificial intelligence?Published3 JulyIndia wants to join the strawberry superpowersPublished5 days agoIs it time to stop using glue and labels on paper?Published28 July

title: 时尚品牌 Jaded 因“美化吸烟”而被禁广告
content: 图片来源，广告标准局/Jaded London 图片说明，Jaded London 辩称香烟不是“广告的焦点”作者：Alex Daniel Business 记者 6 小时前发布 一个时尚品牌的一则广告被广告监管机构禁止，称其为“美化吸烟”。Beyoncé 和 Kylie Jenner 穿过的 Jaded London 的衣服在其营销中使用了一张度假女子拿着香烟的照片广告标准局 (ASA) 表示，这则广告“风格化得很严重，以时尚、有吸引力的方式呈现模特”，这使得吸烟看起来很有吸引力。Jaded London 辩称，香烟不是“广告的焦点”，但同意今后不再使用模特吸烟的照片。图片来源，广告标准局/Jaded London 图片说明，Jaded London 在时事通讯中发送的完整图片 ASA 关于社会责任营销的规则规定，吸烟不应出现在广告中5 月 27 日发出的 Jaded London 电子邮件在向监管机构投诉后接受了调查。在裁决中，ASA 表示，这名女子“穿着时尚的衣服和配饰站在水边的摩托车前，ASA 认为这唤起了一种理想的度假生活方式”。“她拿着一根尖端有明显烟灰的细香烟，我们认为这表明它被点燃了，”它补充道。英国同意对 2008 年以后出生的人实施禁令 4 月 21 日发布 垃圾食品电视和在线广告禁令生效 1 月 5 日发布 ASA 要求该品牌停止使用该广告，并“确保他们未来的营销传播对社会负责”。 Jaded London 由 Jade Camber 和 Grant Goulden 兄弟姐妹于 2013 年创立，在 Instagram 上拥有 150 万粉丝，在年轻人中特别受欢迎。 Selfridges 和 Urban 等商店都备有该品牌的服装截至 2025 年 6 月，该品牌的销售额为 5100 万英镑。 Jaded London 在回应监管机构时表示，“不清楚”模特是否拿着香烟，因为它比平常更细，而且“似乎没有点燃”。该公司还辩称，它“没有模特的服装和配饰等图像中的其他元素那么突出”。不过，该公司表示，它“理解为什么最好避免模特拿着香烟的图片”。香烟”，并且不会在未来的广告中使用吸烟内容。在撰写本文时，Jaded London 的 Instagram 推送中还包含其他几张人们穿着其衣服吸烟的照片。ASA 的一位发言人告诉 BBC，在没有经过正式程序的情况下，无法评论其他帖子是否违反规则。他们补充说：“我们始终鼓励任何对所看到的广告有疑虑的人向我们举报。”他们补充道。我们联系了 Jaded London 请其置评。权威广告吸烟更多关于这个故事下一个广告被禁止，因为姿势使模特看起来太瘦发布2025年2月12日发布电子烟的名称和口味不太吸引人以保护儿童发布10月

title: “我感觉就像我挖了自己的坟墓”：陷入人工智能转型的工人
content: Image source,Bloomberg via Getty ImagesImage caption,The Philippines is known as the call centre capital of the worldBySuranjana TewariAsia Business Correspondent,ÂReporting fromManilaPublished8 hours agoFor 15 years, single mother Lisa made a living from content writing.She began writing straight out of college, freelanced for years and eventually followed a path taken by many young Filipinos: joining a multinational in the country's booming outsourcing industry.Lisa says she never felt the need to use artificial intelligence (AI) in her work."I can say that I am able to do my job, I meet deadlines. In my opinion, there is no need for [AI]," she told the BBC.Eight months into her latest role, and one month before the position was due to become permanent, she was made redundant.In the months before, Lisa says a public relations agency had been tasked with producing AI-generated material that she and her colleagues were asked to edit. She says her skills were used to train the AI on the company writing style."I feel like I dug my own grave," she says. "We were the ones who trained the artificial intelligence that replaced us."Lisa, not her real name, is one of several former outsourcing employees the BBC spoke to who asked to remain anonymous. They signed confidentiality agreements in return for severance pay, and fear that speaking publicly could hurt their chances of finding work in an industry which has a small network.Their experiences offer an insight into a question confronting emerging economies like the Philippines: what happens when AI begins to automate the jobs that helped lift millions of people into the middle classes?Building an industryEvery evening around 5pm, streams of workers wearing company lanyards spill out of high-rise offices in the district of Cubao in Manila.It's one of several areas of the capital where multinational companies have premises â providing all sorts of outsourcing work including call centres, accounting, software development and marketing copy services for clients thousands of miles away.For over two decades, these business districts have symbolised one of the Philippines' biggest economic success stories.Beginning in the early 2000s, the country was promoted as an English-speaking alternative to India for what's called business process outsourcing (BPO).Successive governments offered tax incentives, invested in infrastructure and encouraged multinational companies to set up large operations.Global groups like Accenture, Concentrix and Teleperformance built sprawling campuses, employing hundreds of thousands of Filipinos.Today, the outsourcing industry employs roughly 1.9 million people, and generates $40bn (Â£30.1bn) in revenues every year, accounting for about 10% of the Philippines' economy.But experts say the industry is disproportionately vulnerable to the impact of AI.Image caption,The outsourcing industry employs about 1.9 million people in the PhilippinesThe International Labour Organization estimates that 12.7 million Filipinos - more than one in four workers - are employed in occupations exposed to generative AI, the highest share in South East Asia.The organisation expects many roles to change rather than disappear but the types of service jobs that people do in the Philippines leaves it particularly at risk.Jack Madrid, president of the IT and Business Process Association of the Philippines (IBPAP), admits that AI is being adopted by the sector.More than two-thirds of IBPAP's members are already running AI pilots, he says."Agentic AI has the potential to automate at a much more accelerated pace," Madrid says. "Obviously, there's a layer of jobs that are automatable or have been automated."But he adds that the vast majority of affected workers have been redeployed within the same organisations.Madrid says any weakness in hiring reflects more than the impact of AI."We've seen a slowdown in investment decisions on whether certain job functions or processes should be offshored," he says, pointing to slower global demand and uncertainty over how companies will ultimately deploy the technology.Even so, he acknowledges the challenge. "We cannot do enough to be prepared," he says. "The importance of reskilling" cannot be overstated.The pressure to automateMary, another former content writer whose name we've changed, says her employer encouraged the use of AI as a productivity tool.Instead of making her job easier, she says it created additional responsibilities."We had to edit more, fact-check more because the data AI produced was inaccurate," she says. "Technically it was more work for us."Like Lisa, she was later made redundant.Companies are under pressure to implement AI, to reduce costs and increase productivity, experts say.Teleperformance, the world's largest call centre operator and one of the Philippines' biggest private employers, has said AI offers an opportunity to augment rather than replace its workforce.The company expects AI to handle routine interactions while human agents move into more complex roles.Teleperformance has also said it plans to retrain employees.Accenture has similarly said that generative AI will reshape almost every job rather than eliminate positions.The firm has promised to invest billions of dollars in AI capabilities and workforce training.Concentrix - which is the biggest outsourcing firm in the Philippines - says its AI systems should remain under human oversight and has committed to training employees in the new technology.Some Filipino managers are uneasy about AI and want to slow down adoption, according to Paul Quintos, from the University of the Philippines-Diliman.They are concerned about how much of the domestic workforce might be displaced."But there's tremendous pressure from foreign clients to adopt AI," he says. "It's a major cost-cutting measure."Philippine outsourcing companies compete directly with rivals in India and elsewhere for contracts from multinational corporations.Increasingly, those clients expect suppliers not only to provide cheaper labour, but also to integrate AI into the services they deliver.Image caption,The BBC spoke to employees who say they trained AI before being let goDespite hundreds of billions of dollars being invested globally in AI, Quintos says there is still limited evidence about how much productivity many workplace tools actually deliver."There is a term called 'AI washing'," he says.Some layoffs are presented as being driven by AI when companies are in fact responding to weaker demand or slowing economic conditions, Quintos says.Attributing redundancies to AI, he adds, can make restructuring appear like technological progress rather than a response to market conditions.The next transitionLabour groups have told the BBC that existing employment laws in the Philippines govern redundancy but offer little guidance on how companies should introduce AI into workplaces or consult employees over its use.The Philippines' outsourcing sector is also non-unionised, leaving many workers with little formal say over how new technologies are deployed.The government says that it, and the private sector have a responsibility to retrain workers, and risks falling behind competitors like India and Singapore."To be completely honest, I think we're slightly behind. We have to catch up," says Leandro Aguirre of the Philippines Department of Information and Communications Technology."We have to double our efforts to put our people in a position where they will not be displaced but actually thrive in this growing AI race."The government has committed to upskilling more than 300,000 outsourcing workers, but Aguirre acknowledges that the Philippines may need to rethink the economic model that helped make it an outsourcing centre."We relied heavily on foreign direct investment," he says. "But I think we also need to focus on local talent and local companies."The ambition, he says, is to build home-grown AI companies capable of creating higher-value jobs.Aguirre rejects calls for sweeping new AI legislation, arguing that existing labour, privacy and consumer protection laws can be adapted more quickly through regulatory guidance."The benefits of AI have to trickle down to people," he says. "It can't just benefit employers."For more than 20 years, the Philippines built one of the world's most successful outsourcing industries by selling the skills of its people to multinational companies.AI may not end that model, but it is certainly changing it, and risks leaving some workers behind.Additional reporting by Jaltson Akkanath Chummar and Regine CabatoRelated topicsInternational BusinessArtificial intelligencePhilippines

title: Michael Burry bets against rally: 'We are near a major top, and possible a 1987-type fall'
content:
尽管标准普尔 500 指数飙升至历史新高，因“大空头”而闻名的迈克尔·伯里 (Michael Burry) 仍坚持看跌押注，并警告说，这次反弹仍可能以急剧抛售结束，让人想起 1987 年股市崩盘。

“我仍然相信，我们有可能接近主要顶部，也可能出现 1987 年式的下跌，但标准普尔 500 指数正在创造新的表现。 Burry 在周二的 Substack 帖子中表示，“高点可能会给市场带来新的资金。”

周二，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 1.9%，创下自 6 月以来的首次收盘纪录，这得益于强于预期的企业盈利以及随着霍尔木兹海峡可能重新开放海上交通的希望增强而油价再次下跌的提振。以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数飙升 2.7%，本周前两天涨幅扩大至近 5%。

伯里一直是华尔街对人工智能热潮最直言不讳的怀疑者之一，他认为，对人工智能基础设施的需求正在受到可能不可持续的融资安排的刺激。他表示，市场的上涨正在形成一个自我强化的循环，波动性下降鼓励系统性投资者增加敞口。

“请记住，波动性下降导致市场上涨，迫使波动性目标基金提高杠杆率，并使其他动量策略的杠杆作用发挥作用，”他写道。

面对反弹，Burry 表示，他继续持有 iShares Semiconductor 的空头头寸ETF(SOXX)、美光、英伟达、卡特彼勒、Palantir、特斯拉和应用材料。

这位投资者表示，他对这些头寸的长期前景仍然充满信心，不过他补充说，如果交易对他不利，他将减少损失。他说，除了做空英伟达之外，所有头寸都保持盈利。

“再说一次，做空并不适合所有人，”伯里写道。 “我必须做空。大多数人不应该。”

title: 派拉蒙 Skydance 上调全年利润指引，对 WBD 合并仍“充满信心”
content:
派拉蒙 Skydance 周二上调了全年指引，并公布了第二季度业绩，显示了流媒体的持续优势和线性电视的弱点。

虽然派拉蒙的收入超过了华尔街预期，并在其派拉蒙 + 流媒体服务的带动下，其流媒体部门实现了增长，但其有线电视网络组合继续对整个公司构成压力。

尽管如此，派拉蒙指出，成本削减及其对传统电视的“创造性执行”业务有助于提高本季度的利润率和利润。

以下是派拉蒙 Skydance 在截至 6 月 30 日的期间的表现，与伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 编制的华尔街预估相比：

派拉蒙报告的归属于该公司的净利润为 4100 万美元，即每股 4 美分，而去年同期为 5700 万美元，即每股 8 美分。

该公司报告的每股收益为 5700 万美元，即每股 8 美分。根据 LSEG 的数据，第二季度与华尔街调整后的每股 15 美分的预期无法相提并论。

派拉蒙公布的总收入为 69.1 亿美元，同比略有增长。直接面向消费者的流媒体细分市场（包括 Paramount+、BET+ 和免费且有广告的 Pluto TV）收入增长 9%，达到 24.7 亿美元，而电影制片厂收入增长 16%，达到 13.1 亿美元。电视媒体收入下降 9%，至 31.3 亿美元。

该公司表示，第二季度是“Paramount+ 历史上保留率最高的季度”，这得益于《黄石》衍生剧《达顿牧场》等系列节目，以及 UFC 等体育赛事直播以及在拉丁美洲部分地区举办的 FIFA 世界杯。

Paramount+ 在本季度增加了 200 万订阅者，使其全球订阅者总数达到 8160 万。

该公司周二表示，由于去年派拉蒙和 Skydance 合并带来的节省，将把 2026 年全年调整后息税折旧及摊销前利润指引上调至 38 亿至 39 亿美元。该公司表示计划通过整合节省 30 亿美元。

派拉蒙仍预计 2026 年总收入为 300 亿美元，同比增长 4%。预计今年来自流媒体订阅和广告的直接面向消费者的收入将加速增长。

派拉蒙预计第三季度的总收入将在 69.5 亿美元至 71.5 亿美元之间，Paramount+ 的订阅用户增量将环比“持平”。

周二发布的收益报告距离 Skydance 与派拉蒙合并完成已近一年，这家传奇的好莱坞公司将由首席执行官 David 领导。埃里森。

该公司强调了统一 Paramount+ 和 Pluto TV 背后技术的“早期好处”。它还指出，这将派拉蒙的电影数量从 8 部电影增加到 15 部电影。

派拉蒙最近一直在追求华纳兄弟探索公司，该合并因美国各州提出的反垄断挑战而受到阻碍。

但是，埃里森周二重申了该公司对此次合并的信心。

“由于我们在过去一年中执行了我们的战略，因此我们还准备关闭交易，我们仍然相信它将完成，创建一家更强大、更具竞争力、创意为先的媒体公司，该公司建立在我们已经建立的基础之上，让消费者、影院放映商和创意人员受益。”他在一封股东信中表示。

上个月，由于一群州总检察长提起诉讼，派拉蒙同意将拟议收购的完成推迟至 2027 年 6 月。

派拉蒙最初表示它计划在九月底之前完成交易。它已获得美国司法部反垄断部门以及包括欧洲监管机构在内的多个全球司法管辖区的批准。

根据周二的一份法院文件，美国各州的诉讼将于 2027 年 3 月进入审判阶段。
