content: 图片来源，盖蒂图片社 图片说明，派拉蒙影业作者弗朗西斯科·维拉斯克斯 (Francisco Velasquez) 商业记者，纽约报道 2026 年 8 月 4 日发布派拉蒙 Skydance 首席执行官大卫·埃里森 (David Ellison) 打破沉默，为公司以 1100 亿美元（860 亿英镑）收购华纳兄弟探索频道 (Warner Bros. Discovery) 进行辩护。 《纽约时报》发表的一篇专栏文章。在他对这笔交易的首次公开评论中，埃里森驳斥了有关合并后的媒体巨头将对市场施加过度控制或削弱新闻编辑室独立性的说法。公众干预之际，派拉蒙和华纳兄弟继续进行激烈的法律斗争，以完成最近被搁置的大规模交易。在谈到对派拉蒙旗下哥伦比亚广播公司和华纳旗下美国有线电视新闻网未来的担忧时，埃里森坚称新闻媒体将保持无党派立场，为了应对反垄断担忧，埃里森指出，合并后的派拉蒙-华纳将占美国电视观看时间的不到 20%，如果考虑到 YouTube，这一比例将降至 13% 左右，因为它与 Netflix、亚马逊和苹果等科技巨头竞争，后者的资源“使我们相形见绌”。他还强调了扩大传统制作的承诺，承诺推出 30 部院线电影和每年有超过 300 亿美元的内容投资支持 170 部电视剧。他认为，扩大内容投资对于维持创意工作者对抗由参与算法驱动的技术平台至关重要。即便如此，埃里森承认“没有人可以决定观众会喜欢什么。”7 月份，以加州罗布·邦塔为首的 12 名州检察长与美国作家协会一起提起反垄断诉讼，要求阻止合并，法律战升级。他们认为，此次合并将减少竞争并损害作家的机会，从而违反《克莱顿法案》。美国司法部和包括欧盟在内的国际监管机构已经批准了这项交易，但国内法律挑战实际上阻碍了美国的进展。联邦诉讼程序目前仍处于搁置状态，审判推迟至 2027 年 3 月 2 日。相关主题电影

title: Bessent says there may be deal Tuesday or Wednesday to open Strait of Hormuz with 'freedom of movement'
content:
“我们正在与伊朗人进行谈判，”贝森特告诉 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”节目。“我们有可能在今天或明天达成协议，开放该海峡，并在这一问题上采取更加正常化的立场。”冲突。”

“这将是行动自由，”当被问及是否允许伊朗收取通行费时，财政部长说道。

美国原油期货下跌近 6%，跌破每桶 76 美元。贝森特说，当数百艘滞留在波斯湾的船只能够离开时，价格应该会进一步下降。

“这不仅仅是能源。还有化肥、精炼产品、各种工业气体，”他说。 “随着价格下降，我们可能会看到大规模的救济贸易。”

国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，美国正在参与阿曼和伊朗之间关于如何在短期内让更多船只通过霍尔木兹海峡的谈判。

“这些谈判取得了进展，但尚未最终确定，”卢比奥在国务院对记者表示。 “我们希望这很快就会发生。”唐纳德·特朗普总统周六表示，他取消了对伊朗的重大袭击，以便就重新开放霍尔木兹海峡进行谈判。特朗普过去曾多次戏弄达成一项解决战争的协议，结果只是为了与德黑兰的战斗再次升级。

美国和伊朗于6月17日签署了一份重新开放海峡的谅解备忘录。由于华盛顿和德黑兰之间在船舶通过该海峡的路线上存在分歧，在交易破裂之前，通过霍尔木兹的船舶交通曾短暂反弹。

伊朗开始攻击在美国军事保护下沿阿曼海岸通过霍尔木兹的油轮。德黑兰希望船只在使用该海峡时能够通过其领海。华盛顿发动了十几波空袭，并重新对伊朗实施海上封锁作为报复。

title: Bessent 称霍尔木兹协议即将达成，标准普尔 500 指数创历史新高，道琼斯指数飙升 900 点：实时更新
content:
Stocks rose on Tuesday, fueled by strong quarterly results from companies such asPalantir TechnologiesandCaterpillar, as oil prices dropped amid optimism that a U.S.-Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuzcould be on the horizon.

TheS&P 500gained 1.5% and had hit a fresh all-time intraday high, while theNasdaq Compositepopped 2%, as Palantir rallied 27%. TheDow Jones Industrial Averageclimbed 916 points, or 1.7%, led by a 6% rise in Caterpillar. The 30-stock index also notched a new record high.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in an interview on CNBC's "Squawk Box" that "we are in talks with the Iranians." He then added, "There is a chance we may have a deal today or tomorrow to open the Strait and move towards a more normalized position in this conflict."

Oil prices moved lower following Bessent's comments, withWest Texas Intermediatefutures dropping 4% to around $76 per barrel.Brent crude, the international benchmark, declined 4% to roughly $80 a barrel.

The major stock averages surged in Monday's session,with the Dow closing at a record high, asAmazoneclipsed $3 trillion in market cap for the first time.Nvidiashares also ripped higher along withMeta Platforms. Google parentAlphabetandMicrosoftalso popped during the day.

"From watching the stock market zoom higher over the past three sessions, you wouldn't think there's anything wrong with the world," said Thierry Wizman, global FX & rates strategist at Macquarie Group. "After all, even the semiconductor makers have recovered from their big skid in July after some AI hyperscalers managed to quell analysts' fears about whether their data center investments are excessively eating into cash-flow. And so far, U.S. quarterly earnings reports haven't disappointed, in aggregate."

According to FactSet, more than 84% of S&P 500 companies that have reported earnings have beaten expectations.

Palantir postedblowout results for the second quarter, which CEO Alex Karp described as "otherworldly" as a result of artificial intelligence sovereignty demand. Notably, the company's commercial revenue jumped 149% to $764 million. Karp also said that the "sovereign AI revolution makes us very optimistic about the future."

Other tech names followed Palantir higher.Micron Technologygained 7%, whileMarvell Technologyadvanced 12%.

Caterpillar similarly reportedbetter-than-expected Q2 numbersas well as upped its revenue growth guidance, with the industrial giant noting strong demand for its equipment as the AI data center buildout ramps up across the country. The company also said its tariff costs outlook for the full year should come in at the lower end of its previously expected range.

Investors are closely watchingSpaceX, which is set to report its first quarterly earnings as a public company later. The rocket company's share price was up 3% during Tuesday's session.

Philadelphia Federal Reserve President Anna Paulson said Tuesday that she thinks the current level of interest rates is sufficient to keep inflation moving towards the central bank's goal.

In her first CNBC interview, the policymaker insisted she has an open mind about where monetary policy should go, but was confident in hervote last weekto keep the Fed's benchmark borrowing rate anchored at its current target level of 3.5%-3.75%.

"I think we need ... policy that's mildly restrictive, and I think policy has been mildly restrictive to get underlying inflation back down to 2% in an acceptable time period," Paulson told CNBC's Steve Liesman during a "Squawk Box" interview. "I need to see progress from here."

The level of restriction that the current policy level is having on the economy is a key debate point for Fed officials, who have held rates steady all year as inflation has stayed well above the 2% target.Read more.

McDonald'slatestearningsshould provide a near-term rebound for the beleaguered stock, according to Citi.

"The in-line US/IOM [international operated markets] comps should offer enough evidence to investors that the company's top-line efforts can work to cut through ongoing inflationary pressures on their core guest," analyst John Tower said in a note Tuesday. He has a buy rating on the stock.

However, the appointment of Skye Anderson to president of the U.S. business signals McDonald's isn't pleased with results in the business, he noted.

"[T]he brand may accelerate the cadence of top & bottom-line drivers for the segment (including potential asset reinvestment & McOpCo refranchising)," he wrote. "Shares are down ~13% and we think today's results/outlook (as well as upcoming management meetings with investors/sell-side in northeast) are enough for a NT [near-term] rebound."

However, Baird is among those neutral on the stock.

"With macro headwinds on MCD's core low-to-middle income consumer demographic clouding the near-term fundamental outlook and with questions related to the free cash flow outlook (given potential for material capex/investment cycle), we are inclined to stay patient with our Neutral rating at this stage," analyst David Tarantino said in a Tuesday note.

Shares were up more than 1% in late morning trading.

Job openings were little changed in June, though somewhat lower than expected, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Tuesday.

According to the BLS'Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, the level of available positions slipped to 7.36 million, off 178,000 from the downwardly revised May total and below the Dow Jones consensus for 7.6 million. The openings rate as a share of the labor force edged lower to 4.4% as a drop in healthcare-related fields accounted for much of the overall decline.

Hires, separations and quits all moved a bit higher during a month that saw nonfarm payrolls rise by just 57,000. The ratio of openings to the unemployed held just above 1 to 1.

The recent sell-off in chip stocks shouldn't dim Micron's longer-term prospects, even as margins eventually compress due to memory supply increases, Bank of America said Tuesday.

Analyst Vivek Arya at BofA likes the Micron's increasing customer contracts against the backdrop of expanding hyperscaler capex.

"Hyperscaler spending continues to rise despite higher component costs, suggesting semis/memory pricing power," he wrote in a Monday note to clients.

The S&P 500 reached a new all-time intraday high on Tuesday morning.

The broad market index rose 0.5%, while the Nasdaq Composite gained 0.9%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 772 points, or 1.4%.

Check out the companies making headlines before the bell:

The U.S. and Iran could reach a deal on Tuesday or Wednesday to reopen the Strait of Hormuz with freedom of movement for commercial ships, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in an interview.

"We are in talks with the Iranians," Bessent told CNBC's "Squawk Box." "There is a chance we may have a deal today or tomorrow to open the strait and move towards a more normalized position in this conflict."

"It would be freedom of movement," the Treasury Secretary said when asked whether Iran would be allowed to charge a toll.

U.S. crude oil futuresfell about 3% to trade below $78 per barrel after his remarks. Prices should fall further when hundreds of ships stuck in the Persian Gulf are able to exit, Bessent said.Read more.

Pfizerticked higher in the premarket after the pharma giant posted second-quarter results that beat the Street.

The company earned an adjusted 77 cents per share on revenue of $15.03 billion. Analysts expected a profit of 68 cents per share on revenue of $14.41 billion. Pfizer also increased the low end of its full-year revenue outlook.

Merckposted second-quarter results that beat the Street, sending the stock up more than 1% in the premarket.

The company lost an adjusted 13 cents per share on revenue of $16.61 billion. Analysts polled by LSEG expected a loss of 27 cents per share on revenue of $16.36 billion. The pharma giant also hiked its full-year revenue guidance.

Caterpillarshares surged 8% after the industrial giant posted second-quarter figures that beat analyst expectations.

The company earned an adjusted $8.17 per share on revenue of $20.54 billion. Analysts polled by LSEG expected a profit of $6.20 per share on revenue of $19.34 billion.

Caterpillar's jump gave a boost to Dow futures, which hit their highs of the day following the company's release.

West Texas Intermediatefutures were up 2.09% at $82.02 per barrel as of 4:53 a.m. ET.Brent crude, the international benchmark, was up 2.8% at $86.11 a barrel.

Treasury yieldsedged higher early Tuesday as investors mulled the ongoing uncertainty around the state of negotiations in the Middle East.

The yield on the10-year U.S. Treasurynote — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — was about 1 basis point higher at 4.7021%.

The2-year Treasury noteyield, which more closely tracks short-term Federal Reserve interest rate policy, was broadly flat at 4.2621%. The longer-dated30-year Treasury bondyield was last seen about 2 basis points higher at 5.2498%.

Asia-Pacific markets ended higher on Tuesday. South Korea'sKospirose 1.62%, ending the trading day at 6,358.95.

The small-cap Kosdaq Index jumped 5.8% to 780.72.

Japan'sNikkei 225rose 0.32% to close at 63,957.53, and the Topix was little changed at 3,961.78.

Australia'sS&P/ASX 200closed 1.4% higher at 9,145.8.

title: “婴儿iPhone”和苹果供应商泄密事件如何解释中国最近的供应链动向
content:
最近印度苹果供应商塔塔电子公司的网络漏洞已成为北京的宣传黄金，因为领导人竞相将国际公司锁定在中国的供应链中。

中国最大的电子产品市场华强北的 iPhone 维修专家马首华表示，“这样的事情在中国永远不会发生。”即将发布的 iPhone 18 Pro 机型是此次泄露后泄露的材料的一部分。

塔塔电子向 CNBC 证实了一起“网络安全事件”，但表示该事件“对我们各业务的运营没有影响”。该公司没有透露是否有任何材料或数据被盗。

路透社 6 月份报道称，黑客组织 World Leaks 声称对此次攻击负责，被盗数据包括苹果未发布的 iPhone 18 Pro 的零部件清单、供应商和照片。

苹果拒绝就此次泄密事件或其供应链计划发表评论。

随着地缘政治紧张局势的加剧，美国公司（包括苹果公司和其他公司）对中国的依赖变得更加危险。加大多元化力度。去年，苹果公司首次在印度生产其顶级设备——iPhone 17系列。

与印度在iPhone生产和其他制造业方面的竞争引起了中国当局的警惕。

共产党的《环球时报》在7月份警告称，“‘印度制造’存在系统性弱点”，并认为在其他国家复制供应链“不是一件容易的事”。

中国正在与成本较低的国家竞争，以保留所有供应链以创造就业机会并在全球范围内发挥影响力。其贸易伙伴。

美国美国商会在 5 月份与荣鼎集团合作的一份报告中写道，中国正在“利用法规和经济胁迫”来加强对关键供应链的控制。

报告称，“中国加强了对关键矿产和加工技术的控制，通过域外规则扩大了对下游产品的限制，并引入了新的法律文书，增加了寻求远离中国的企业和政府的成本。”

塔塔电子公司的泄密事件可能还没有严重到足以改变苹果公司的方针。其供应链的风险似乎比最初担心的要小。

在深圳华强北，旧 iPhone 买卖的地方，技术人员以翻新、维修和重建设备的能力而闻名。

在最近的一次访问中，CNBC 采访了几位技术人员，他们坚称重建 iPhone 18 Pro 几乎是不可能的，尽管中国社交媒体上对此进行了广泛的讨论。

“你不能真的做到这一点。”卖家郭友良说：“这些图纸最多可以做手机壳。”

华强北的技术人员虽然技术精湛，但他们表示他们拿不到 iPhone 的关键部件，主要是芯片或软件。

iPhone 维修专家王顺在市场摊位上修理模型时说道。

其中一个例子是售价 29 美元的“17 Pro”。迷你。”这款山寨机也被称为“Baby iPhone”，其独特的宇宙橙色与 iPhone 17 Pro 非常相似。然而它是由 Android 驱动的。

苹果在 iPhone 13 Mini 之后停止生产迷你尺寸版本。

人们普遍预计 iPhone 18 Pro 机型将于今年 9 月发布。

title: 杰夫·贝索斯 (Jeff Bezos) 刚刚申请以 40 亿美元出售亚马逊的股份。股价正在下跌
content:
杰夫·贝佐斯 (Jeff Bezos) 提交了出售约 1500 万股亚马逊股票的计划，价值约 41 亿美元，此前这家占主导地位的电子商务平台强于预期的盈利将亚马逊股票推至历史新高，推动其市值超过 3 万亿美元。

提交该文件后，亚马逊周二股价下跌超过 2%，该文件披露了根据 2025 年 11 月 14 日通过的 10b5-1 规则交易计划进行的出售计划。根据该文件，周一的销售是通过摩根士丹利进行的。

在提交该文件之前，亚马逊股价周一触及历史新高，延续了上周季度业绩引发的涨幅。在云计算业务增长强于预期的带动下，这家网络服务提供商公布了强劲的第二季度收益，增强了投资者对其人工智能投资正在转化为需求增长的信心。

亚马逊股价今年上涨了约 20%，远高于标准普尔 500 指数 12% 的涨幅。

向美国证券交易委员会提交的 144 表格显示，贝佐斯打算出售 1500 万股普通股根据周一收盘价计算，总市值约为 40.7 亿美元。文件指出，这些股票是在 1994 年作为创始人股票获得的。

贝佐沙近年来经常通过预先安排的交易计划出售亚马逊股票，同时继续跻身该公司最大股东之列。文件还指出，他 5 月份向非营利组织捐赠了 220,200 股股票，这些组织可能在前三个月内出售了这些股票。

title: 宝洁公司首席执行官告诉 CNBC，将以 38 亿美元收购补充剂品牌 Thorne
content:
宝洁公司首席执行官 Shailesh Jejurikar 在 CNBC 的“Squawk on the Street”节目中表示，宝洁公司以 38 亿美元收购补充剂品牌 Thorne。

这项收购定于周二宣布，旨在宝洁公司扩大其健康和保健部门。这家消费品巨头已经拥有其他几个补充剂品牌，如 Metamucil、Align Probiotic 和 New Chapter 维生素，这些品牌隶属于一个更广泛的医疗保健部门，其中包括 Oral-B 和 Vick's。

“我们对资产本身非常满意，”Jejurikar 告诉 CNBC 的 Sara Eisen。 “这是一家运营良好的公司，而且已经存在很长时间了。”

Thorne 成立于 1984 年，于 2021 年底上市，估值为 5.25 亿美元。随后，L Catterton 于 2023 年将该公司私有化，交易价值 6.8 亿美元。 Thorne 表示，到 2025 年，其年收入将超过 5 亿美元。

Thorne 首席执行官 Colin Watts 今年早些时候向 CNBC 表示，该品牌有潜力在未来几年内成为价值 10 亿美元的品牌。

Thorne 的大部分收入来自 40 岁以下的购物者。该补充剂品牌的直接面向消费者的销售额也出现了激增。

近年来，维生素和维生素随着消费者希望补充剂能够改善从睡眠到能量水平等各个方面的健康状况，补充剂越来越受欢迎。由卫生与公众服务部部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪领导的“让美国再次健康”运动也开始关注补充剂。肯尼迪本人曾说过，他服用了太多维生素，以至于他记不清了。

宝洁公司是最新一家收购一家热门新贵公司的消费巨头，以期从这一趋势中获利。今年早些时候，联合利华收购了软糖补充剂品牌 Grüns。

Thorne 将只是宝洁公司更广泛的产品组合中的一小部分，但这笔交易表明了该公司的更广泛目标，即拥有吸引年轻消费者的相关优质品牌。宝洁公司最近一个季度的销量持平，导致收入低于预期。从交易量来看，其医疗保健部门表现最差。

周二早盘，宝洁公司股价上涨不到 1%。

——CNBC 的 Gabrielle Fonrouge 对本报告作出了贡献

title: SpaceX 收益实时更新：首次公开募股以来的第一份报告在大规模股票解锁之前发布
content:
SpaceXreports fiscal second-quarter results after the bell on Tuesday, the company's debut earnings report following its recordIPOin June.

Here's what analysts are expecting, according to LSEG.

The company's reported earnings — or loss — per share may not be comparable to the consensus of analysts' estimates, as initial reports often contain unpredictable adjustments.

It's the first time forElon Musk'sreusable rocket maker to face Wall Street in this capacity, and investors are jittery. Since opening at $150 on June 12, SpaceX's stock has dropped by 24%, wiping out close to $500 billion in market cap. The shares are almost 50% blow their intraday peak reached on June 16.

SpaceX lost $4.9 billion last year, largely due to hefty investments inartificial intelligenceinfrastructure. The companymergedwith Musk's xAI in February, saying at the time that the vision was to build data centers in space. But even the launch business, which counts on large contracts from NASA, is losing money.

Most of SpaceX's revenue for the year, and its only source of profit, came from its connectivity segment, which consists of itsStarlinksatellite internet service. Starlink is sold directly to consumers, as well as to government and military agencies.

Here's what analysts expect in terms of revenue from SpaceX's three segments, according to StreetAccount:

SpaceX'sconference callto discuss results is scheduled to begin at 4:30 p.m. ET.

CNBC's reporters are covering SpaceX earnings from bureaus in San Francisco and Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey.

New Street Research partner and senior analyst James Ratzer told CNBC's "Squawk on the Street" that there are three parts to the success story for Starlink.

Ratzner said the first element is in broadband, and he expects capacity to grow 20 times what the company has today.

"Secondly, we think there's a path over the medium term to developing a direct-to-sell business with a slightly separate constellation that will be complementary, we think, to existing wireless offerings," he said.

The final piece, which is "potentially the biggest opportunity," is the development of orbital data centers with a separate set of AI constellation satellites, though Ratzner noted that is "going to take time to develop."

"We're maybe a little bit more conservative there than, I think, some of the more bullish analysts on the stock," he said. "We still think it's a huge opportunity, but that's something looking into the next decade."

SpaceX calls Starship the "key enabler" of its long-term growth strategy and says the rocket could unlock "entirely new categories of missions," including commercial space tourism.

During a 13th test flight of Starship in July, SpaceX had trouble reigniting the Raptor engines in the rocket's first stage.

"Any similar failure during landing at the launch site would no doubt cause severe damage to the launch pad," TMF's Farrar told CNBC at the time.

Ex-NASA engineers and aerospace researchershave also expressed concernabout the Starship thermal protection systems.

The space segment generated revenue of $619 million in the first quarter of 2026, after pulling in sales for all of last year of $4.09 billion. That was mostly from established Falcon 9 rockets delivering customers' payloads, including from SpaceX, into orbit.

SpaceX spent $3 billion on research and development last year, specifically on its Starship launch vehicle program.

SpaceX's first earnings report comes about two weeks after Tesla, Musk's other public company, failed to impress Wall Street with its second-quarter numbers.

While revenue beat estimates, free cash flow turned negative, expenses soared and Musk struck a cautious tone in discussing the company's Robotaxi efforts. The stock plunged 15% following the report and is now down 28% for the year, trailing all of its megacap peers.

SpaceX's slump has been a boon for short sellers betting against the stock. They were up up about $8.3 billion in paper profits as of Friday's close, according to data from S3 Partners.

One catalyst for a potentially deepening slide is the possibility that a flood of new shares will hit the market once lock-up restrictions start expiring this week.

Musk takes personal umbrage with short sellers, whether they're wagering against SpaceX or Tesla. He wrote in a post on X last month that, "The survival probability of firms who maintain a significant short position in SpaceX over time is very low."

SpaceX shares climbed about 6% higher at the start of trade, looking to build momentum after a rough stretch of losses.

After an initial surge when it began trading at $150 on June 12, the stock has slipped and is about 10% below its IPO price of $135.

Ron Epstein, senior aerospace & defense analyst at Bank of America, told CNBC's "Squawk Box" that he'll primarily be watching for progress on rocket science with Starship and the path to resusability.

"They had a public release, but they'll get some questions on it," he said. "You know, what, what do they think went well? What do they think went better than they thought? What didn't go as well as they thought?"

Epstein also noted that since this is the company's first earnings call as a public company, it will be interesting to see how it is structured and how CEO Elon Musk and/or COO and President Gwynne Shotwell are featured.

SpaceX told investors in its IPO prospectus that it would "prioritize growth and investment to capture significant opportunities in AI applications and compute infrastructure," for its relatively new AI business.

In merging with xAI, SpaceX brought in the company's data centers, Grok AI models and chatbot, and social network X, formerly known as Twitter.In June,SpaceX struck a deal to acquire Cursor AI for about $60 billion in a transaction expected to close in the third quarter.

SpaceX reported capital expenditures of $10.1 billion in the first three months of the year, with AI expenses counting for $7.7 billion of the total. Analysts on average expect capex of $13.2 billion for the second quarter, according to FactSet.

Analysts at Phillip Capital took the rare step of recommending investors sell SpaceX shares.

In a report on Friday, the firm set its price target for the stock at $75, which would be a drop of about 35% from Monday's closing price.

Of the more than three dozen analyst estimates on SpaceX tracked by FactSet, Phillip becomes just the second firm to rate the stock a sell. The other such rating was from Morningstar.

Phillip analysts cited the company's big losses and negative cash flows expected until at least 2030.

The slice of the SpaceX investor base most focused on fundamentals will be paying close attention to Starlink, which provides global high-speed internet coverage using a constellation of more than 10,200 satellites in low Earth orbit.

In itsprospectusin June, SpaceXsaid the connectivity unit generated $11.39 billion in revenue in 2025, accounting for 61% of total sales. It was SpaceX's only profitable business last year, generating income of $4.42 billion.

Also in June, the company raised prices for Starlink subscribers, initiating a $10 "monthly kit fee" to rent its terminals after also increasing rates for different subscription levels. SpaceX said in a post on X early that month that its Starlink subscriber count had surpassed 12 million.

Tim Farrar, a satellite services industry expert and president of TMF Associates, told CNBC that investors should watch for Starlink subscriber net adds and changes in average revenue per user.

title: 霍尔木兹海峡重新开放的希望导致油价下跌
content: 图片来源，Getty Images作者：Michael RaceBusiness 记者，纽约报道2026 年 8 月 4 日发布，英国夏令时间 15:58 更新于 49 分钟前 由于美国高级官员提出了与伊朗达成协议以重新开放霍尔木兹海峡关键航道的希望，油价周二跌至三周低点。美国国务卿马可·卢比奥和财政部长斯科特·贝森特均宣布谈判已取得进展，允许可能恢复运输就在本周。由于供应中断可能得到缓解的消息，全球油价基准布伦特原油的成本下跌近 5%，至 80 美元以下。但近几个月来，美国和伊朗之间的冲突未能缓和，导致石油市场波动，司机最终受到加油站燃油价格上涨的打击。周二，随着布伦特原油的下跌，美国西德克萨斯中质油价格下跌超过 5%，至本周。 76 美元一桶。两份合同均跌至7月13日以来的最低水平。美国国务卿卢比奥表示，与伊朗和阿曼就让更多船只通过该海峡的讨论取得了进展。他在国务院对记者表示：“这些谈判取得了进展，但尚未敲定。我们希望这很快就会发生。”贝森特表示，重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的协议最早可能在周二或周三达成。“我们有可能今天达成协议”当被问及是否允许伊朗对通过的船只收费时，他补充道，“这将是行动自由”。虽然美国政府高级官员宣布谈判正在取得进展，但尚未公布潜在协议的细节。霍尔木兹海峡一直是美国和伊朗之间谈判的中心点。在二月下旬冲突开始之前，这条水道处理了全球约五分之一的日常石油和液化天然气供应。这次中断导致世界各地的加油站价格上涨。根据 RAC 汽车集团的数据，在英国，汽油价格目前处于冲突开始时的水平，每升汽油的平均成本达到 1.60 英镑。根据 AAA 的数据，在美国，汽油价格平均高于每加仑 4 美元。柴油价格几乎为每加仑 5.40 美元。卡塔尔是华盛顿和德黑兰之间的主要调解者之一，该国表示正在继续与其他调解者努力，试图通过外交手段解决战争问题，但承认目前没有计划进行直接谈判。周一，唐纳德·特朗普总统警告伊朗面临着同意一项允许恢复海峡商业航运的协议的“最后机会”。他表示，他已经取消了为恢复谈判而对该国进行的“大规模”打击。表示不与美国谈判 - 也没有计划这样做 - 而是与阿曼谈判。相关主题燃料石油伊朗战争国际商业美国伊朗更多关于这个故事分析人士称中东油轮面临的威胁是伊朗战争开始以来最严重的威胁发布于1天前为什么霍尔木兹海峡在伊朗战争中如此重要发布于7月14日发布

title: 新泽西州以反垄断为由起诉亚马逊，指控其非法对送货承包商行使权力
content:
新泽西州总检察长詹妮弗·达文波特周二宣布，她以反垄断为由起诉亚马逊，指控该在线零售商滥用其对第三方送货承包商的权力，压制竞争并伤害工人。

亚马逊阻止送货工人成立工会，限制其送货网络中的承包商互相雇用司机，并限制对他们的劳动力的竞争，导致工资降低并导致员工“忍受比他们更恶劣的工作条件”达文波特办公室在一份新闻稿中表示，“正如我们的投诉所称，亚马逊建立了一家价值数万亿美元的公司，但由于其在劳动力市场上的压倒性影响力，亚马逊在其配送网络中人为地压低工资和惩罚性的工作条件。”达文波特在一份声明中表示。

亚马逊的代表没有立即回应置评请求。

自 2018 年以来，亚马逊一直在运营其配送服务合作伙伴计划，它依靠数千家小型承包公司的网络来处理从公司仓库到购物者家门口的包裹的最后一英里递送。

它使亚马逊能够减少对 UPS 和联邦快递等主要承运商的依赖，同时加快递送速度。

该模式受到了立法者、监管机构和劳工权益倡导者的越来越严格的审查，他们声称亚马逊使用第三方承包商标签来逃避责任并避免雇用其送货人员，同时仍然对其工资、时间表和制服等进行控制。亚马逊辩称，送货合作伙伴对其运营拥有完全控制权。

纽约市正在考虑立法，要求亚马逊直接使用 DSP 等措施。亚马逊表示，由于该法案，它将“考虑将送货业务搬迁到城外”，而一家科技行业组织则警告称，这可能会导致消费者的运输成本更高。

在向美国新泽西州地方法院提交的诉状中，达文波特指责亚马逊送货司机服务市场上的“垄断”。

垄断通常是指公司限制其对竞争对手或消费者的权力，垄断通常是指一家公司是某个劳动力市场上的唯一参与者，从而对就业条件产生巨大影响力。

投诉称，DSP“在经济上依赖亚马逊”，无法独立于该公司运营，“使他们无法通过提供更高的工资或更高的工资来竞争司机”。更好的工作条件，这使得亚马逊能够压低司机工资。”

——CNBC 的 Jim Forkin 对本文做出了贡献

title: Palantir 凭借“超凡脱俗”的商业收入跃升 27%——这就是推动需求的因素
content:
Palantirstock 周二股价飙升 27%，此前该公司公布了由客户对人工智能主权工具的需求推动的“超凡脱俗”的第二季度盈利。

这家企业软件巨头报告称，其总收入增长了 93%，达到 19.4 亿美元，高于一年前的约 10 亿美元，超出了 LSEG 预期的 18 亿美元。其商业收入增长 149%，达到 7.64 亿美元，政府收入增长 90%，达到 8.09 亿美元。

该公司预计全年收入在 81.5 亿美元至 8.158 美元之间，商业收入将超过 34.24 亿美元。 Palantir 在盘前交易中上涨了 16.3%。

Palantir 的联合创始人兼首席执行官 Alex Karp 将本季度描述为“超凡脱俗”，并补充说主权人工智能革命使他们“对未来非常乐观”。

“忘记共识，”Karp 在接受 CNBC 的 Seema Mody 独家采访时表示。 “据我所知，像我们这样规模的企业，没有一家公司的增长幅度能达到这么一半。”

Palantir 设计的系统帮助公司将人工智能与现有系统和数据集成，该公司将其井喷式收益归因于对人工智能主权不断增长的需求，因为公司寻求将数据保密，不让 OpenAI、Google、Anthropic 和 Meta 等前沿人工智能实验室知晓。

卡普在致股东的信中表示，“争取独立和人工智能主权的革命目前正在顺利进行”，并指出该业务具有“马克思主义”价值观。

“我们的客户拒绝成为语言实验室的附庸国，”卡普在信中说。 “世界上每个组织都开始意识到将语言模型的创建者交给其机构的钥匙、让模型在自己家里随意使用的风险。”

随着投资者对人工智能交易越来越谨慎，该公司的股价今年迄今已下跌 29%。

尽管如此，花旗分析师在周二的一份报告中表示，随着人工智能公司对数据隐私的需求，Palantir 的结果“进一步削弱了人工智能竞争加剧的悲观理由”让它与众不同。公司依靠 Palantir 的技术来集成他们的软件，同时也要求保护他们的数据不被人工智能模型获取。

“我们认为，这些结果巩固了 Palantir 作为企业人工智能采用最明显受益者之一的地位，商业需求的加速表明该公司正在受益于与市场上最快的人工智能原生公司类似的需求，”分析师在周一的一份报告中表示。

“鉴于人工智能的大幅反弹，我们预计股价将大幅上涨。美国的商业表现阻碍了增长放缓，”他们补充道。

title: 为什么特朗普媒体出售快速访问影响市场的社交帖子的做法引起争议
content: Figure caption,Why is Trump Media selling early access to Trump's Truth Social posts?ByMichael RaceBusiness reporter,ÂReporting fromNew YorkPublished4 August 2026, 10:40 BSTUpdated 2 hours agoWhen Donald Trump speaks, financial traders are among the keenest listeners.From trade wars to military wars, anything the US president says can shift markets, and so teams of traders - as well as a host of automated computer systems - monitor his statements to perform trades within seconds.Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG) now wants to charge for such market-moving information put out on its Truth Social platform. It has launched a paid service to give Wall Street firms and institutional investors the "fastest access" to the social media site's most influential accounts.TMTG has not directly said the service includes the account of the president himself, but with some 13 million followers - the most on the site - it's fair to say that his posts would be among, if not the, most influential.However, the move has prompted a series of legal questions and ethical musings, including whether it is right that a company - of which the president's family remains the majority shareholder - stands to profit from his own public statements.What is the service all about?The service launched by TMTG is called Truth API. It is a new data feed that provides real-time access to posts in "milliseconds" from the "highest-ranking Truth Social accounts".The service was anticipated to become available to institutional customers on 1 August.The Financial Times reported,externalthat customers could be charged as much as $100,000 a month for high-speed access, but TMTG has not confirmed the figure.TMTG says it expects it to create a steady source of new revenue for the firm, which is currently loss-making.While anyone can pay for the service, it is mainly designed for so-called high-frequency and algorithmic trading firms - those TMTG states are "most impacted by the cost of a delay in information".For these firms, financial trading is automated. Electronic systems using algorithms buy and sell much faster and at a greater scale than humans, according to Charles Schwab. It is a case of "blink, and you'll miss it", the investment bank says."Such systems are often designed to make just a tiny profit on each transaction, but through sheer speed and volume, they can generate large returns for their firms," it adds.Trump Media to sell instant access to 'market-moving' social postsPublished17 JulyIs it illegal, unethical or neither?Since Truth API was announced, some have raised the potential for insider trading to occur. The practice, which is illegal, involves people making market trades or bets based on information that is not available to the general public.Richard Painter, former chief ethics lawyer to President George W Bush, told the BBC even if Trump does not trade himself on US government information, there was the so-called "tipper-tippee liability" under insider trading laws."If I have information that belongs to the United States government that I'm not allowed to trade on, and instead of trading, I simply give the information to someone else who pays me for the information and they trade and I know they're likely to trade, then I am also guilty of insider trading and so are they," Painter says."This is the law that applies to the president and to everyone else," he adds.Painter says the law would only apply to certain subject matters and potential posts, such as what the president intends to do with tariffs, wars or other US policy."If I were commissioner of the SEC, I would threaten to resign unless they put a stop to this plan or promise that no posts... that have to do with US government business [will be included]," he says.Political opponents of the president have criticised the service. Democratic Senators Elizabeth Warren and Adam Schiff have written to the US securities regulator to ask if it will investigate whether Truth API breaks the law.The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has confirmed receipt of the letter, but has declined to comment on whether it will investigate.A spokesperson for TMTG said in response to the letter sent to the SEC that Senate Democrats "continue to mischaracterise Truth API either out of ideological opposition to free markets or a failure to grasp the distinction between public and non-public information - or, quite possibly, both".TMTG has also said "the Senators must have invented a new theory of 'insider trading' based on publicly available information".Joe Saluzzi, co-founder of Themis Trading, though, points out that many other data providers, news organisations and stock exchanges currently operate similar services, suggesting that provides a "precedent" for TMTG.However, he adds: "There's a different story when it comes to ethics."Trump, who owns about 41% of Trump Media through a trust his children oversee, does stand to profit from the service."This appears to be an outrageous abuse of the President's office for his personal benefit that undermines everyday investors and the integrity of our markets, while enriching Wall Street and other wealthy insiders," Warren and Schiff said in their letter to SEC.Who has signed up?There has been a wall of silence in terms of who has signed up to the service so far.TMTG says it had customers register in advance of the launch date, but has not revealed how many.Saluzzi from Themis Trading told the BBC that Truth API was "worthless" to trading firms, including his own, which did not have the complex systems already set up to perform transactions at "nanosecond level fast".He suggests high-frequency trading firms (HFTs) would be among the most likely to sign up, not only because of the money-making potential, but also because they'll be thinking "if I don't do it, somebody else will"."This is not for retail [investors], this is not even for sophisticated institutional investors," he says. "This data feed is for high-speed traders who have the systems in place and have spent millions and millions of dollars building the systems."The BBC contacted some of the major US investment banks and high-frequency trading firms, from Goldman Sachs and JP Morgan to Citadel Securities and Jane Street to ask if they had, or planned to, sign up.All either declined to comment or did not respond. The White House also did not respond to a request for comment."Nobody wants to talk about this stuff," says Saluzzi.Related topicsDonald TrumpSocial mediaCompanies

title: 活动人士对盖特威克机场扩建提出上诉被驳回
content: Image source,Getty ImagesImage caption,The Â£2.2bn expansion will see the West Sussex airport move its emergency runway 12m (39ft) northPublished4 August 2026, 12:09 BSTUpdated 3 hours agoCampaigners have lost a bid to take their legal fight against the government over plans for a two-runway operation at Gatwick Airport to the Court of Appeal.Peter Barclay and campaign group Communities Against Gatwick Noise Emissions (Cagne) previouslytook legal action against the Department for Transport over the decision to approve the plans,including over claims that the government did not properly assess the climate impact of the scheme.Cagne and Barclaytold a hearing in January the scheme was unlawful,claiming climate impact was not properly assessed.The Â£2.2bn expansion will see the West Sussex airport move its emergency runway 12m (39ft) north to allow 100,000 more flights a year.Image source,GATWICK AIRPORTImage caption,The plans were approved by Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander in SeptemberMr Justice Mould dismissed the challenges to the airport's expansion in June, finding that it was "neither illogical nor contradictory" for Alexander not to refuse the proposed development "on the basis that it would have a material impact on the ability of Government to meet its carbon reduction targets".He also rejected an argument about the need for the expansion at Gatwick, given the proximity to Heathrow.Last month, Barclay and Cagne asked the Court of Appeal to allow them to challenge the ruling, claiming that the judge was wrong.But in a ruling on Tuesday, Lord Justice Holgate and Lord Justice Dove dismissed the appeal bids.'Immensely proud'In a 29-page ruling, they said: "We conclude that each of the grounds of appeal raised by each appellant is unarguable."Neither appeal has a real prospect of success. We also consider that there are no other compelling reasons for either appeal to be heard."The two senior judges also said that the previous ruling was "detailed and thorough".Gatwick is the UK's second busiest airport and one of the busiest single-runway airports in the world.The expansion will allow the site to be used for the departures of narrow-bodied planes such as Airbus A320s and Boeing 737s.Following the decision, Barclay said: "We are very disappointed with the Court's decision. We took this challenge as far as we could because we believed that the decision to allow Gatwick to expand was fundamentally flawed."It was not supported by government policy, would only serve to line the pockets of the airport and airlines, and would do so at the expense of local residents and the climate."Cagne said: "Residents should be immensely proud of what they have achieved in holding Gatwick Airport's shareholders to account."This proposed new runway will come at a significant cost to both the taxpayer and the planet."Need To KnowGreenlight for Gatwick expansionListen on SoundsPierre-Hugues Schmit, chief executive of London Gatwick, said the decision to approve the plans "was taken properly and lawfully".He added: "We are also very pleased that this ruling, from senior Court of Appeal Judges, brings to an end an eight-year planning and legal process which has carefully tested and scrutinised every aspect of our expansion plans on multiple occasions."This final ruling means that we can now press on with the important job of bringing this exciting project to life and move forward into the design and delivery phase."Schmit said the Northern Runway project was expected to deliver 14,000 new jobs and a Â£1bn boost to the economy every year.Follow BBC Sussex onFacebook,,externalX,,externalandInstagram,,externaland listen to BBC Radio Sussexon Sounds.Send your story ideas to southeasttoday@bbc.co.uk or WhatsApp us on 08081 002250.Related topicsGatwick AirportMore on this storyCampaigners ask to appeal Gatwick expansion decisionPublished30 JuneCampaigners consider appeal after Gatwick bids failPublished23 JuneNew Gatwick runway 'profoundly concerning', court toldPublished20 JanuaryGatwick expansion will see cheaper holidays - ReevesRelated internet linksGatwick Airport

title: 苹果对英国访问私人用户数据的命令提出新挑战
content: Image source,Getty ImagesByChris Vallance,ÂSenior technology reporterÂandÂLiv McMahon,ÂTechnology reporterPublished5 hours agoApple has confirmed it has launched a new legal complaint against the UK government at a court that deals with objections to the use of covert surveillance powers.The tech giant has not told BBC News what the complaint relates to butthe Financial Times,externalhas reported it is another challenge to a Home Office demand for so-called "backdoor" access to highly encrypted Apple user data.The row, which centres on the government's desire to be able to see material protected by an advanced data protection system - which currently even Apple itself cannot access - has beenrumbling on since early 2025.The government said it would not comment on legal proceedings or what it called "operational matters".But it added in a statement: "The UK supports strong encryption and robust privacy protections, but it is also vital that law enforcement can access communications when necessary and proportionate to protect the public from terrorism, serious crime, and child sexual abuse."Apple has meanwhile referred reporters to a statement given last year, afterits initial challenge to the UK government's request.This said it was "gravely disappointed" it could still not offer its Advanced Data Protection feature to new UK users, following its decision to withdraw it in February 2025."As we have said many times before, we have never built a backdoor or master key to any of our products or services and we never will," the company added.Image source,AppleImage caption,Since last February, UK iPhone users have been met with a notice on the Advanced Data Protection settings page which says the tool cannot be enabled.Advanced Data Protection is an opt-in feature that allows users to turn on a higher level of protection for data stored in iCloud, such as back-ups, Drive storage, photos and voice memos.It is secured using end-to-end encryption - meaning not even Apple would be able to see its contents.The government's requests for Apple to permit it access to data held under this system were issued under the Investigatory Powers Act (IPA).It includes powers allowing the government to issue secret notices - called technical capability notices - which can secretly force companies to provide UK security services with ways to access customer data.The government had fought unsuccessfully to keep legal challenges to its first notice to Apple secret.Its noticewas later withdrawnafter angering US politicians, who were concerned it would affect their own citizen's data.But the government issued a new request in Octoberwhich did not apply to US users.Privacy groups whichpreviously campaigned against its secret orderswelcomed Apple's new legal complaint."We are happy to learn that Apple is once again challenging the UK's regime of secret orders," said Privacy International."While we don't know the substance of Apple's claim, if it relates to the previously reported orders aimed at undermining the security of Apple's iCloud storage, then Apple's claim, alongside side ours and Liberty's, is crucially important to preserving all of our privacy and security."Ruth Ehrlich, director of external relations at Liberty, said the case was "hugely important" and has "far-reaching implications for the public's privacy rights well into the future"."End-to-end encryption is an essential security tool that protects our personal data, including our bank details, health information, private conversations and images," she said."Opening a backdoor to all of that information carries a wide range of risks to our personal data. It is critical that the Government listens to the many concerns and commits to protecting our privacy rights."But Sir Brian Leveson, the Investigatory Powers Commissioner, who provides independent oversight of the use of surveillance powers, has previouslycriticised media use of the term "backdoor",external.He said notices such as those concerned in this case would only be issued "if the Secretary of State deems it necessary and proportionate, and this decision is independently reviewed and approved by a Judicial Commissioner".He added requests for data would also require separate authorisation under the IPA and these would be subject to independent oversight.Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletterto follow the world's top tech stories and trends.Outside the UK? Sign up here.Related topicsApplePrivacyHome OfficeCyber-securityEnd-to-end encryptionUK governmentMore on this storyWhat Apple pulling Advanced Data Protection means for youPublished26 February 2025US politicians furious at UK demand for encrypted Apple dataPublished14 February 2025Court documents shed new light on UK-Apple row over user dataPublished29 August 2025

title: 伊朗战争推高油价 BP利润创2022年以来最高57亿美元
content: 图片来源，Getty Images作者Emer Moreau商业记者发布2026年8月4日英国夏令时间10:04更新6小时前中东战争推高油价后，英国石油公司的利润飙升至2022年以来的最高水平。这家石油巨头公布的4月至6月期间利润为57.3亿美元（42.6亿英镑）。这是去年同期 23.5 亿美元的两倍多，是自 2022 年俄罗斯-乌克兰战争爆发以来的最高季度利润。自今年早些时候伊朗战争爆发以来，由于霍尔木兹海峡的全球石油和天然气供应受到严重干扰，原油价格大幅上涨。环境和贫困活动人士抨击英国石油公司利用飙升的油价“牟取暴利”。中东冲突爆发后，原油价格飙升反过来推高了全球汽油和柴油价格以及国内能源成本。BP表示，全球油价基准布伦特原油在4月至6月季度的平均价格为每桶103.85美元，高于去年同期的67.88美元。油价上涨使所有能源公司受益，而不仅仅是BP，竞争对手壳牌上周也报告季度利润翻了一番。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，美国石油公司埃克森美孚和雪佛龙“赚了太多钱”。他对记者说：“我不喜欢这样，我应该是最后一个这么说的，因为我是一个自由企业大佬。他们应该将其中一些回馈给公众，他们最好降低零售价，即消费者价格。”分析人士称，中东油轮面临的威胁是自伊朗战争开始以来最严重的。务实对待北海石油 5天前发布 尽管利润大幅上涨，英国石油公司首席执行官梅格·奥尼尔表示，该公司尚未充分发挥其潜力。英国石油公司在英国拥有近14,000名员工，该公司确认了进一步远离清洁能源的计划，透露计划出售其美国可再生天然气业务Archaea。奥尼尔表示，这是她优先考虑“价值，而不是情绪或历史”的计划的一部分。“我们必须专注于最强劲的资产”上周，英国石油公司 (BP) 宣布将出售其北海业务，此举将结束该公司在该地区 60 年的生产业务。 AJ Bell 投资总监拉斯·莫尔德 (Russ Mould) 表示，出售的目的是使业务更加精简。“奥尼尔将意识到，她不能无限期地依赖石油和天然气价格保持在如此高的水平，”他说。“她需要确保该业务能够繁荣，即使“石油公司公布的巨额利润引发了竞选团体的愤怒反应。环保组织绿色和平组织的安格哈拉德·霍普金森表示，英国石油公司的业绩显示“企业收益已经完全脱离公共利益”。她说，“我们同意英国石油公司的一点是，它决定出售其北海业务。”通过试图从北海挤出最后几滴昂贵的石油来延长这种寄生关系是纯粹的霍普金森说：“这太愚蠢了。”消除燃料贫困联盟协调员西蒙·弗朗西斯表示，石油公司“从这场给数百万家庭带来真正困难的危机中存入了更多数十亿美元”。他说：“教训不是向每个季度利润数十亿美元的行业提供更多税收减免，而是利用暴利税收入来清除家庭在危机期间积累的创纪录的能源债务。”利润税 - 于 2022 年推出。但是，该税仅适用于在英国开采石油和天然气所获得的利润。相关主题OilBPCompanies石油和天然气行业

title: 特朗普抨击大型石油公司“赚太多钱”，英国石油公司利润翻倍多
content:
英国石油公司周二公布第二季度利润大幅上升，因美国和伊朗之间的敌对状态，能源巨头从化石燃料价格上涨中获得巨额利润。

这家石油巨头公布的 4 月至 6 月期间的潜在重置成本利润（用作净利润的代表）为 57 亿美元。根据伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 编制的共识，这一数字轻松超出了分析师 50 亿美元的预期。

去年同期，BP 净利润为 23.5 亿美元，2026 年前三个月净利润为 32 亿美元。

这一业绩公布之际，正值中东冲突不断蔓延之际，石油和天然气价格飙升。战斗严重扰乱了具有重要战略意义的霍尔木兹海峡的航运，霍尔木兹海峡是一个狭窄的海上咽喉要道，通常输送世界上约五分之一的石油和天然气。

美国唐纳德·特朗普总统周一猛烈抨击美国石油巨头埃克森美孚和雪佛龙在伊朗战争期间从较高的燃油价格中赚了“太多钱”，并重申了他对降低油价的要求。

特朗普在白宫对记者说：“他们因短缺而赚了太多钱。” “我不喜欢这样。”

埃克森美孚第二季度利润较去年同期增长一倍多，达到 145 亿美元，而雪佛龙的盈利则飙升近 400%，达到 120 亿美元，而去年同期为 25 亿美元。 CNBC 已联系埃克森美孚和雪佛龙征求意见。

英国石油公司首席执行官梅格·奥尼尔表示，第二季度的业绩得益于整个集团的强劲表现，并回应了特朗普对石油巨头的批评。

“听着，我理解普通家庭在进入加油站加油并查看价格时感受到的压力。现实情况是，我们生产一种全球商品，我们销售的产品价格与全球商品价格挂钩。”奥尼尔周二在 CNBC 的“Squawk Box Europe”节目中表示。

“BP 正在做的是确保我们专注于我们能做的事情，以帮助解决这一问题。我们正在努力提高可靠性，无论是生产这些石油的上游资产，还是精炼这些石油的炼油资产。”

奥尼尔表示，该公司已对公司炼油业务的设置方式进行了调整，以最大限度地提高消费者最需要的产品的可用性。任何时间点，以喷气燃料和柴油为例。

英国石油公司周二表示，它已启动了对古菌能源公司进行潜在销售的营销流程。该公司在 2022 年斥资 41 亿美元收购了美国沼气业务，以寻求扩大其可再生能源业务，但该战略于 2025 年初废弃。

BP 一直在推进其简化工作，加倍加强其石油和天然气核心业务模式，并剥离非核心资产以减少债务。

该公司周一表示，已完成盖尔森基兴炼油厂的出售。以及相关业务与投资公司 Klesch Group 的交易，预计该交易将使这家石油巨头的基本运营支出减少约 10 亿美元。

在经历了高管更替的动荡时期后，BP 也在寻求稳定其管理团队。这家伦敦上市公司的董事长阿尔伯特·马尼福德(Albert Manifold)在上任仅八个月后就突然被免职。董事会指出了与治理标准、监督和行为相关的“严重担忧”，而 Manifold 对这些指控提出了异议。

周二上午，BP 股价上涨 0.5%。今年迄今，该股已上涨 27% 以上。

title: 美国各州提起诉讼，要求阻止特朗普对数十个国家征收关税
content: 图片来源，法新社来自 Getty Images 作者：Osmond Chia 商业记者发布 2026 年 8 月 4 日，英国夏令时 03:00 更新于 55 分钟前 周一，有 25 个州起诉唐纳德·特朗普总统政府，指控其对数十个国家征收一波关税。美国表示，征收 10% 至 12.5% 的关税是由于包括英国、中国和欧盟在内的贸易伙伴未能在英国广播公司(BBC)看到的一份法律文件中，民主党各州联盟表示，这一决定“任意、反复无常且违反法律。”对此，白宫发言人库什·德赛表示：“美国正在利用其合法权力”来解决给美国企业带来负担的做法。德赛补充说，任何外国未能处理强迫劳动生产的商品的进口问题都是“不合理的”，必须得到解决。7月生效的新关税是根据1974 年美国贸易法第 301 条，旨在针对使用强迫劳动的国家。根据美国贸易代表办公室 (USTR) 的数据，这些关税涵盖了 99.4% 的美国进口产品。该诉讼称，特朗普政府“不能以强迫劳动为借口，继续其非法关税计划。”纽约州州长凯西·霍楚尔 (Kathy Hochul) 表示，“特朗普总统的非法关税只不过是对辛勤工作的家庭征税。”俄勒冈州总检察长丹·雷菲尔德 (Dan Rayfield) 在一份声明中表示，“尽管每一步都失败了，但特朗普仍试图对工薪家庭和俄勒冈州本土企业造成更多混乱。”他补充道，“为这些非法关税付出代价的是我们所有人，而不是外国政府。”贸易伙伴对新关税表示失望，巴西和日本政府分别称这些措施“不合理”。中国外交部发言人毛宁称这些关税是“政治操纵的借口”。华盛顿和北京陷入了一场针锋相对的关税战，目前该战已暂停。一些分析人士还质疑各国如何能够证明他们已经妥善解决了强迫劳动指控。新加坡国立大学商业讲师亚历克斯·卡普里告诉英国广播公司，这起诉讼将对特朗普的征税构成“巨大挑战”。他还表示，也缺乏可靠的证据来支持有关国家通过违反强迫劳动规则损害美国公司的说法。卡普里补充说，他预计“分拆和撤回将逐步消除这些关税的影响”。这标志着特朗普自 2025 年 1 月重新上任以来推出的一系列贸易政策中的最新举措。去年 4 月，特朗普在所谓的“解放日”关税中对全球贸易伙伴征收的许多广泛关税均被美国最高法院驳回。“最高法院已明确表示，本届政府不能忽视法律，霍赫尔说。法院的裁决促使已缴纳关税的公司获得数百亿美元的退款。总统长期以来一直认为关税可以保护美国工人并促进美国经济。取消的关税被对所有全球进口产品临时征收 10% 的关税所取代。这些关税已于 7 月到期。随着美国目前正在对 16 个国家的制造业产能过剩指控进行调查，更多关税也可能即将出台。相关主题国际商业唐纳德·特朗普全球贸易更多有关此报道的费萨尔·伊斯兰：英国的特朗普贸易协议看起来不再是世界一流的 7 月 24 日发布 特朗普推出了哪些关税以及为什么？7 月 24 日发布

title: 特朗普警告伊朗谈判是结束战争的“最后机会”——德黑兰否认谈判，油价上涨
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普警告说，与伊朗的最新一轮谈判是结束长达五个月冲突的“最后机会”。

特朗普周一晚间在椭圆形办公室对记者表示，应伊朗、沙特阿拉伯、阿拉伯联合酋长国、卡塔尔等国的要求，谈判“正在进行中”。

然而，德黑兰继续否认正在与美国进行任何直接谈判据官方媒体报道，伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安周二表示，德黑兰将继续保卫其边界，但坚称不会寻求扩大冲突。

特朗普表示，“这是他们签署一份好文件的最后机会。”

周一早些时候，特朗普在《真相社会》帖子中称伊朗领导人“令人难以置信”伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴格哈伊再次对与美国直接谈判的想法泼了一盆冷水。

巴格哈伊在周一的新闻发布会上表示，目前没有立即与美国进行谈判的计划，并重申德黑兰目前只与阿曼就海峡问题进行谈判。霍尔木兹。

总统决定取消对伊朗的“大规模袭击”，以便进行他所说的将于周一开始的谈判。

这一决定提振了市场情绪，油价应声下跌。

周二早盘油价小幅反弹，因为交易商对外交解决冲突的信心减弱，这场冲突已经颠覆了能源市场。

西德克萨斯中质原油期货上涨截至美国东部时间凌晨 1:35，国际基准布伦特原油上涨 1.29%，至每桶 81.38 美元。

美国中央司令部周一表示，作为持续封锁霍尔木兹海峡的一部分，它已经改变了 44 艘商船的航线，其中两艘商船瘫痪并登上了两艘。

与此同时，伊拉克亲民兵组织 Naya 周一晚间报道科威特夜间发生爆炸，巴士拉省也能听到爆炸声。

title: CNBC 每日开盘：披着欧元外衣的美元干预
content:
您好，我是惠杰，从新加坡给您写信。欢迎收看 CNBC 每日开盘的另一期节目。

美国上周为提振日元而进行的干预可能比表面上看起来更具全球意义，因为有报道称，华盛顿出售欧元来为此次干预提供资金，以避免对敏感的国债市场产生任何负面影响。

全球范围内的财报也很丰富，亚马逊、汇丰银行和沙特阿美等大牌公司今天都发布了财报。

而不是出售美元来帮助日本支撑经济与之前的干预措施一样，日元升值后，据报道，美国出售欧元，转而为货币购买行动提供资金，从而削弱了美元兑欧元的汇率。原因可能是什么？一种可能性是华盛顿希望避免破坏敏感的国债市场的稳定。业内资深人士告诉 CNBC，华盛顿最大的担忧之一是避免出现日本需要抛售大量美国国债来为单边干预提供资金的情况。

欧元兑美元周一走强至 1.1558 高位，触及近两个月来的最高水平。

在美国，亚马逊周一创下历史新高，其市值首次突破 3 万亿美元大关。上周的盈利报告好于预期。

但这可能会被其持有的 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等人工智能公司所扭曲。得益于 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的股份，微软、亚马逊和 Alphabet 在最近一个季度取得了可观的投资收益，其中还包括 SpaceX。

Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在私募市场的估值都在飙升，在持续的人工智能热潮中，各自的估值都在 1 万亿美元左右。

欧洲第二大银行资产汇丰银行 (HSBC) 报告业绩好于预期，第二季度税前利润为周二，由于银行净利息收入和其他费用增长强劲，增长强劲，超出了分析师的预期。第二季度税前利润同比增长 60%，该公司表示，这也得益于 26 亿美元的显着项目的净有利影响。中东石油巨头沙特阿美公司周二报告称，在经历了霍尔木兹海峡一段时期的严重混乱之后，第二季度利润大幅增长，超出预期。

石油巨头受益于美国和伊朗之间的敌对状态，化石燃料价格上涨，季度利润呈井喷式增长。— Lim Hui Jie

Hugging Face 首席执行官表示，中国正在赢得人工智能竞赛，并在开放模型领域占据主导地位

Hugging Face 首席执行官 Clément Delangue 表示，中国正在凭借开放重量模型赢得人工智能竞赛，并可能很快赶上美国模型制造商周一，他对 CNBC 的“Squawk on the Street”节目表示：“他们现在显然在开放模型领域占据主导地位，如果他们在今年年底或明年开始以进展速度在前沿占据主导地位，我不会感到惊讶。”

推动这场革命的是中国的开放协作和共享生态系统，而美国的模型制造商正在“孤岛建设”，并有落后的风险。说。

title: 伊朗战争挤压石油供应 沙特阿美第二季度利润跃升33%
content:
沙特阿美周二公布第二季度利润大幅增长，此前，中东冲突蔓延，霍尔木兹海峡经历了一段时期的严重中断。

这家全球最大的石油公司公布 4 月至 6 月期间调整后净利润为 1,252 亿沙特里亚尔（334 亿美元），同比增长 33%，超出分析师预期的 31.59 美元

这一结果公布之际，石油巨头报告了井喷式季度利润，受益于美国和伊朗之间的敌对状态，化石燃料价格上涨。

持续五个多月的冲突已经超出了其主要战线，最近几天已经卷入了中东的更多国家，特别是伊拉克和埃及等国家。

沙特阿美利用其自身优势来应对伊朗战争。 1,200 公里（746 英里）的东西向管道绕过霍尔木兹海峡通往红海，以维持每天 700 万桶的最大出口能力。

“尽管霍尔木兹海峡的供应出现前所未有的中断，但我们继续展示我们通过利用我们多样化的资产基础和数十年规划（包括东西向管道等战略基础设施、储存能力和出口）来保持业务连续性的能力沙特阿美总裁兼首席执行官 Amin H. Nasser 在一份声明中表示。

他补充道：“尽管地区环境充满挑战，这使我们能够维持生产和出口，同时推进关键项目。”

沙特阿美董事会表示，将在未来三个月内支付 219 亿美元的第二季度基本股息。

这家石油巨头表示，第二季度收入大幅增长主要是由于炼油和化工产品价格上涨。

在美国，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一猛烈抨击美国石油巨头埃克森美孚和雪佛龙在伊朗战争期间从较高的燃油价格中赚了“太多钱”，并重申了他对降低油价的要求。

“他们因短缺而赚了太多钱，”特朗普在白宫对记者表示。 “我不喜欢这样。”

埃克森美孚第二季度利润较去年同期增长一倍以上，达到 145 亿美元，而雪佛龙的盈利则飙升近 400%，达到 120 亿美元，而去年同期为 25 亿美元。 CNBC 已联系埃克森美孚和雪佛龙征求意见。

title: 首席财务官表示，随着公司提高预测，人工智能正在帮助 Grab 将产品发货速度提高 30% 以上
content:
东南亚领先的网约车和送货公司 Grab 周二上调了全年预期，报告了创纪录的第二季度业绩，尽管宏观经济不利，但该地区的消费者需求依然坚挺。

这家纳斯达克上市公司的股价在盘后交易中上涨了 4.86%。

“人工智能现已融入 Grab 的生活方式，无论是在我们的产品中，还是在我们的方式中。 Grab 首席财务官 Peter Oey 告诉 CNBC 的“Squawk Box Asia”节目，并补充说，该技术帮助公司的产品发货速度提高了 30% 以上，从而转化为更好的利润和更高效的成本结构。

Oey 表示，公司第二季度的乘车次数同比增长了 28%。 “这是我们见过的最高水平之一。”

该公司的收入同比增长 22%，达到 9.97 亿美元，截至 6 月份的季度营业利润为 1900 万美元，增长 186%。

Grab 将全年收入预期从之前的 40.4 亿美元上调至 41.5 亿美元，并上调了预期EBITDA 预计为 7.2 亿至 7.4 亿美元，从 7 亿至 7.2 亿美元不等。

“我们看到 7 月份的业务需求继续非常强劲，我们的金融服务继续扩大规模，并且今天正处于拐点，”Oey 表示，对业务前景充满信心。

关于 Grab 同意收购 Delivery Hero 在台湾的 foodpanda 业务，Oey 表示该公司正在与监管机构密切合作，尚未完成交易，并希望在今年下半年完成交易。

“东南亚社区日复一日地看到和使用的许多产品，我们也希望带到台湾市场，”他说。

更正：在公司发言人澄清了首席财务官的言论后，该报道已更新，将出货量的增长修正为 30%。

title: 铁路旅行半价扩大到18岁
content: 图片来源，Getty Images 作者：Jennifer Meierhans 商业记者 8 小时前发布 交通部 (DfT) 宣布，当本月晚些时候铁路卡规则发生变化时，18 岁的年轻人将能够购买大多数服务的半价火车票。这是 16-17 Saver 铁路卡的延期，目前持有者年满 18 岁时就会过期。从 8 月 17 日起，它们的有效期为自 16-17 Saver 铁路卡之日起一整年。这意味着 17 岁的学生可以在 18 岁前一天购买铁路卡，使其有效期到 19 岁前一天。英国交通部表示，现有规则意味着每年有超过 70,000 名学生的收入比同一学年尚未过完 18 岁生日的学生平均低 175 英镑。16-17 Saver Railcard 每年费用为 35 英镑，持有者可享受大多数火车票价 50% 的折扣。铁路部长亨迪勋爵声称，这一“常识性变化”“正是乘客对铁路的期望”。他表示，这一变化将“降低青少年在关键时刻的旅行成本，无论他们是寻求继续教育、职业道路还是在就业市场立足”。行业机构铁路运输集团首席执行官杰奎琳·斯塔尔表示，这一变化表明该行业致力于“提供全国学生联合会负责继续教育的副主席凯纳特·艾哈迈德 (Kaynat Ahmad) 表示，该铁路卡“对于依靠火车上大学、工作或接受培训的年轻人来说至关重要”。18 岁的年轻人已经有权获得 16-25 小时的铁路卡，但这只能让他们享受三分之一的旅行费用折扣。在政府表示将削减英格兰大多数单程巴士票价上限之后，宣布了这一消息。明年从 3 英镑到 2 英镑。联系方式您 18 岁时会使用 16-17 铁路卡吗？它会为您节省多少钱？联系表相关主题铁路旅行交通

title: 代币经济学：为什么让人工智能付费很棘手
content: Image source,Getty ImagesImage caption,The big AI firms sell paid-for versions of their techByJoe FayTechnology ReporterPublished8 hours agoIf you have used a free version of an ChatGPT or its AI rivals, then you are obviously getting a good deal.Firms like Microsoft, Google and Anthropic have invested hundreds of billions of dollars in developing Large Language Models (LLMs) the tech behind those services.So getting, ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to help with your speech or holiday plans is a bargain.But, naturally, those firms want to recoup their investment, so they offer paid-for versions of their AI, which have extra features for tasks like coding or billing.Meanwhile, third party firms are building and selling services based on AI agents, usually based on an LLM, which are trained to do specific tasks.But setting a price for those services is surprisingly difficult."Trying to tie someone into a cost model for the next 12 months, two years, three years, it doesn't make any sense, honestly, because we don't know," says Simon Gooch at Saviynt, an identity management company which is incorporating agentic AI into its services.Image source,SaviyntImage caption,Setting prices for AI services is difficult says Simon GoochThat's because of rapidly changing economics around tokens, the building blocks of LLMs and agentic AI.When a user asks an LLM, like ChatGPT or Anthropic's Claude to answer a question, generate software code, or automate a process, that prompt is broken down into mathematical chunks called tokens, which can be processed by the model.The LLM's response also comes in the form of tokens, which are converted back into text, software code, or a set of commands to automate a process.The problem is this process is not entirely predictable.Subtle variations in the prompt can produce different answers. The same prompt will not always produce the same answer. Different models will produce different answers.Meanwhile, in agentic systems, businesses use multiple AI agents together to make decisions and take actions, further increasing both token use and unpredictability.While the cost of individual tokens â or the credits used to pay for them - has plummeted in recent years, according to analysis by Goldman Sachs, the number of tokens consumed by businesses, and consumers, has skyrocketed.The bank forecasts that,externaltoken consumption will increase 24 times between 2026 and 2030 to 120 quadrillion tokens a month, as companies shift from to use AI agents.But companies, and individuals, using AI systems often have a tenuous grasp on just how many tokens they are burning through â until they either run out or get their monthly bill.Even Microsofthas reportedly reined back,externalits engineers' use of some third party coding tools, while Uberapparently tore through,externalits AI coding token budget for a year in a matter of months earlier this year.Image source,LSEImage caption,Firms are struggling to manage their AI costs says Will VentersWill Venters, Associate Professor of Digital Innovation and Information Systems at the London School of Economics, said companies can be caught out as they experiment with or implement AI internally, as staff burn through tokens."People are finding it really hard to manage that costâ¦ it's a non-deterministic output, so it's a non-deterministic value," he said.Companies are finding ways to work around this.Oliver King-Smith, founder of engineering software firm smartR AI, says smaller organizations can "can fly under the radar and use [flat fee] personal accounts which I am sure the big vendors don't like."But, he says, "This has to end at some point in time, because the big guys are taking a bath on those accounts."Once the big AI platforms start facing pressure from shareholders to show a profit, he predicts: "They will start clamping down."King-Smith says companies should also think more carefully about what AI models to use.Companies also needed to be much more precise with their prompts, says Rob Steele, CFO at UK accounting software firm iplicit."You wouldn't send someone in your family out to get the weekly shop without any kind of detailed instructions as to what you expect in that shopping basket, right?"The situation can become difficult to control when companies build AI into a product that could be rolled out to thousands of users, Venters points out.AI costs could start to balloon. For example, managers may realise they need tokens not just for core software development, but for other tasks such as testing, security, or for implementing guard rails."It's particularly hard when you're looking at agentic processes," Ventners says.Employing more AI agents can be done with the click of a button, whereas expanding the human workforce would involve careful discussions over headcount and hiring, he says.Venters points out, while token costs might be unpredictable, it might be that the company is ultimately getting more value from their token use with AI."It's not quite the same as a calculator," he says. "The more you give it, the more expensive it is, but the better the result may be."But companies still need to pass those costs onto their own customers."Nobody's really figured it out," says Bill Peterson, senior director of product marketing, at Sumo Logic.The software firm is previewing new security services based on agentic AI, he explains, but is in discussion with corporate customers about how to charge for them."We're still having some fun conversations about this internally," he says drily.Options could include simply raising prices across the board, he says, paying by results, or charging for "bundles" of incidents.But whatever price structure it chooses could be upended if and when the large language model providers change their own pricing strategies."You get into variable pricing, and it's changing every couple of months" he says. "Customers don't like that. That's not how anybody builds a budget."Related topicsInternational BusinessTechnology of BusinessArtificial intelligenceSoftwareMore Technology of BusinessIndia's 'blue gold' starts a new drinks industryPublished12 JuneThe ancient trick making food waste useful and tastyPublished5 JuneCould humanoid robots be heading for the battlefield?Published9 June

title: CNBC 的 The China Connection 时事通讯：人工智能的胜利伴随着老投资者的风险
content:
Hi, this is Evelyn, writing to you from Beijing. Welcome to the latest edition of The China Connection — a snapshot of what I'm seeing and hearing from local businesses.

China's tech advances may rile Washington and worry Wall Street about U.S. tech stocks. But when it comes to Chinese alternatives, foreign investors remain selective. Beijing's recent moves reveal a reason why.

Emerging market risks aside, it's the state of policy communication that gives foreign investors pause.

Just take arecently announced probeinto Fang Xinghai, former vice chair of China's securities regulator. Stanford-educated Fang, whose term coincided with thesudden suspension of Ant's giant IPO, was particularly well-known among Wall Street investors in China — unlike many other targets of China's anti-corruption investigations.

In the days since the probe into Fang was announced without much detail, discourse in China has focused onhis support for algorithm-driven quantitative trading— which has frequently drawn public andregulatoryire formarket losses, despite national AI champion DeepSeek emerging from quant hedge fund High-Flyer.

"This is exactly where communication can be better," said Liqian Ren, a quantitative manager at U.S.-based fund manager WisdomTree.

"Right now for China the number one thing is tech competition," she said, "not yet financial market competition."

Parsing Fed statementson policy direction has been a key U.S. investment skill since the days of Alan Greenspan in the 1990s. UBS even said the Fed's forward guidance, which is now under review, hasdecreased market volatilityover the last two decades.

China, in contrast, only launched its stock markets just over three decades ago, and has not had a reputation for transparency. From a surprise yuan devaluation in 2015 to crackdowns in recent years onafter-school tutoringandcross-border stock trading, many of Beijing's policy moves appear abrupt to outsiders.

Market volatility isn't due to quantitative trading, but sometimes "totally unexpected" policy information disclosure, Ren said, noting China's market swings are "way higher" than in Europe or Japan — two overseas markets popular with U.S. investors.

Shares of Trip.com, whose top investors include BlackRock, plunged nearly 20% in one day in January after China said it was investigating the online booking company for alleged monopolistic practices.

Futu shares dropped by more than 27% on May 22 after China's renewed crackdown on services that enabled people in mainland China to trade overseas stocks. UP Fintech shares fell by more than 25% that day.

More strikingly, just days after the SoftBank-backed Didi IPO in the U.S. in June 2021, the ride-hailing company faced a cybersecurity probe and app suspension in China, leading to amonths-long stock declineand ultimately, delisting. Didi has yet to relist in Hong Kong despite announcing plans to.

While analysts note in retrospect that warning signs were clear, investors did not necessarily grasp them until after the fact.

Ren noted how China stocks climbed early last year after the DeepSeek R1 release, and in recent days after the Kimi K3 model launch in mid-July. "The more good headlines come out, then it will kind of neutralize some of the Chinese government regulations or abrupt regulations," she said.

Chinese stocks overall have yet to generate returns that exceed U.S. stocks and bonds enough to attract significant amounts of capital willing to overlook the risks.

BlackRock Investment Institute has kept a neutral view on Chinese stocks and views AI-related opportunities asstock-specific, rather than regional, plays.

And alternative chip plays such as CXMT — a state-backed memory chip company that surged nearly 470% in its debut last week — listed in Shanghai, making it difficult for most foreign investors to access.

Global stock index giant MSCI quickly announced, however, that CXMT would beadded to the MSCI China All Shares Indexon Aug. 10, paving the way for foreign funds tracking the index to buy exposure.

As former Goldman Sachs banker Fred Hu, now chairman of Primavera Capital, told my colleague Anniek Bao in Singapore recently,finance, not AI, is Beijing's biggest challenge. And it's finance that requires the most communication and trust.

China's reported chip breakthrough comes with some big caveats

It is currently unclear whether a Chinese manufacturer using the homegrown DUV machine will deliver a chip yield close to or above that of a machinefrom ASML.If the yield is not close to what ASMLmachines can provide, that might hamper the adoption of China's machine.

The U.S. wants Asia to use its AI — but China dominates cheaper models

The U.S. has launched an export program and other initiatives to bolster American AI in Asia. But between the first APEC AI meeting and the second, the U.S. has grownnoticeably quieter.

China threatens retaliation against U.S. humanoid robot ban, says it 'severely damages' relations

As the FCC escalates restrictions on Chinese goods, it "severely damages China-U.S. economic and trade stability," China's commerce ministry said via a CNBC translation of an online statement Thursday. The ministry urged the U.S. to withdraw the decision, andthreatened countermeasuresif it failed to do so.

title: Jim Cramer 表示，市场已经对大型科技公司的人工智能支出有所升温。这就是打开开关的原因
content:
CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramers) 周一表示，亚马逊首席执行官安迪·贾西 (Andy Jassy) 的财报电话会议改变了华尔街对大规模人工智能投资的看法。

“在贾西发表讲话之前，市场似乎对这些大型科技公司的花钱方式持高度怀疑态度，”《Mad Money》主持人表示。 “情况已不再是这样了。” 几个月来，投资者一直质疑超大规模企业在人工智能建设上的巨额支出能否转化为有意义的回报。克莱默表示，贾西对亚马逊财报电话会议的解释最终让华尔街有了了解这些投资将如何获得回报所需的“视线”。

“正是贾西冷静、深思熟虑的演讲使他能够将资本支出预算从 2000 亿美元提高到 2200 亿美元，并且亚马逊的股价仍然飙升至十多年来的最大单日涨幅，”克莱默说。

克莱默说。 Jassywon 的投资者不仅解释了亚马逊的支出金额，还解释了这些支出将如何转化为数十年的现金流。贾西表示，前期投资将用于建设数据中心并为其配备服务器和网络设备。然而，一旦这些设施上线，它们几乎立即开始产生收入，并且可以在几十年内货币化。

“一旦数据中心在插入服务器的情况下投入使用，”贾西说，“我们立即开始产生可观的收入，然后可以在 30 多年的时间里通过这些数据中心货币化，而无需再次花费启动资金。”

克莱默认为，与亚马逊的一些同行的对比是不可能的。更清晰。

Alphabet 还提高了资本支出指引，但他表示，在管理层未能充分解释这些投资将如何转化为未来回报后，该公司股价下跌。 Cramer 表示：“我相信，相同的数字以不同的方式解释会使股价走高，而不是走低。”Cramer 表示，与此同时，微软避免了大部分怀疑，因为该公司仍保持正向自由现金流，并且已经通过其 Azure 云服务和更多的 AI 助手 Copilot 订阅将其 AI 投资货币化。

Metadrew 是 Cramer 最尖锐的批评。尽管该公司继续积极扩展其人工智能基础设施，但他表示，管理层对计划如何从这些支出中获得回报几乎没有提供任何解释，特别是不清楚该公司是否会出租多余的计算能力。

“我对 Meta 似乎没有计划感到震惊和失望，”他说。

title: 大型科技公司的 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 股份正在扭曲企业盈利状况
content:
科技公司的风险投资组合使企业利润看起来比实际情况要强得多。

微软、亚马逊和 Alphabet 在最近一个季度获得了可观的投资收益，这要归功于 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的股份，其中一个例子是 SpaceX。

Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在私人市场上的估值都在飙升，在持续的人工智能热潮中，它们的估值都接近 1 万亿美元。微软和亚马逊是这些公司的私人股东，而谷歌则拥有 Anthropic 的股份。因此，他们需要在季度损益表中考虑其股份价值的增加。但这并不反映销售软件或其他服务所产生的利润。

根据 LSEG 的数据，少数公司的私人投资收益已经对整体盈利增长产生了巨大影响。

根据 LSEG 的盈利和股票研究主管 Tajinder Dhillon 的说法，标准普尔 500 指数最近一个季度的盈利增长比一年前增长了约 48%。 Dhillon 指出，在调整以撤回私营人工智能公司的投资收益时，增长要温和得多。

Dhillon 表示，如果不考虑 Alphabet 和亚马逊私营公司股权带来的收益，总盈利增长将约为 29%。这与分析师的预测非常接近。该季度的共识是 24% 的增长。

“OpenAI、Anthropic 和 SpaceX 的股票收益大幅夸大了整体盈利数据”，D.A. 董事总经理兼技术研究主管 Gil Luria 说道。戴维森告诉 CNBC。 “话虽如此，这些类型的变动往往会随着时间的推移而趋于平衡，这就是为什么我们通常将它们排除在非公认会计原则观点和预测之外。”

大多数分析师在他们的估计中排除了这些一次性项目。但在短期内，它带来了更多的盈利上行惊喜。据 LSEG 称，本季度各公司的盈利比预期高出 7%。相比之下，长期平均水平比共识高出 4.4%。

由于大型科技股的影响，盈利动态更加重要，这些股票在市场中的权重已经过大。据 LSEG 称，所谓的七大巨头的收入约占标准普尔 500 指数第二季度收入的 35%。在过去一年左右的时间里，这组科技股约占整个大盘股指数的三分之一。

这些投资收益往往被归入“其他收入”，因此科技公司之间的报告方式有很大不同。

亚马逊是 OpenAI 的主要支持者，并在 2 月底向 ChatGPT 制造商承诺投资 500 亿美元。它也是 Anthropic 的早期投资者。亚马逊的盈利较一年前增长了 240% 以上。但如果没有这些投资收益，这一数字接近 17%。本季度，它“主要来自”Anthropic 投资，获得了 534 亿美元的收益。

Alphabet 也看到了类似的动态，这主要归功于 SpaceX。谷歌母公司拥有埃隆·马斯克的火箭公司约 5% 的股份。 Alphabet 的净利润增长了近 300%。如果没有 SpaceX 和 Anthropic 的收益，增幅将接近 23%。

微软的影响要小一些。由于对 Anthropic 的投资收益，该公司的盈利增长仍增加了约 10 个百分点，净利润增长了 32 亿美元，据称大部分来自 Anthropic。微软报告称，其 OpenAI 股份获得了 4.8 亿美元的收益。

这一动态凸显了这些人工智能公司与大型科技公司的紧密联系。甚至在他们自己进入公开市场之前。 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 均已向 SEC 秘密提交文件，预计将在明年上市。

Luria 指出，这种盈利动态可能会与更大的波动性相平衡。它是双向的。例如，SpaceX 的股价较首次公开募股后的高点下跌了约 50%。

“具体来说，根据 SpaceX 目前的交易情况，GOOGL 在报告 9 月份季度报告时，其市价可能会发生重大逆转，”他说。 “Anthropic 9 月份成功的 IPO 可能会抵消这一影响，但现在下结论还为时过早。” KKM Financial 创始人兼首席执行官杰夫·基尔伯格 (Jeff Kilburg) 称，在本已强劲的财报季之上，科技巨头带来的“巨额”利润“洒满”。即使不包括私人资产，基尔伯格也称企业盈利的跃升“令人瞠目结舌”。

——CNBC 的罗伯特·汉姆 (Robert Hum) 报道。

title: Palantir井喷式季度飙升12%，美国商业收入飙升近150%
content:
Palantir 周一超出了第二季度盈利预期，并表示商业收入比一年前增长了一倍多。数据公布后，该公司股价飙升 12%。

该公司的业绩与 LSEG 的预期相比如下：

收入比一年前的约 10 亿美元增长了 93%。 Palantir 公布的净利润为 10.7 亿美元，即每股 41 美分，而去年同期的净利润约为 3.29 亿美元，即每股 13 美分。

“忘记共识，”首席执行官 Alex Karp 在接受 CNBC 的 Seema Mody 独家采访时表示。 “据我所知，像我们这样规模的企业还没有增长过如此之多。”

Palantir 的美国政府收入比一年前增长了 90%，达到 8.09 亿美元。该公司因向美国政府和军方销售软件而闻名，但其商业收入正在加速增长。

美国商业收入较一年前飙升 149%，达到 7.64 亿美元，考虑到复利，自 2024 年以来已跃升 380%。Palantir 目前预计 2026 年美国商业收入将“超过”34.2 亿美元，高于先前指导的 32.2 亿美元。

该公司表示，其剩余的美国商业交易价值较一年前增加了一倍多， 62.4 亿美元。

由于人们越来越担心人工智能软件贸易正在失去动力，增长可能放缓，Palantir 股价今年下跌了 29%。

这家人工智能软件公司将全年收入指引从之前的 76.5 亿美元至 76.6 亿美元提高至 81.5 亿美元至 81.6 亿美元。

Karp 告诉 CNBC，强劲的增长“看起来像这样”至少还要持续 18 个月。”

这位首席执行官一直是开放权重模型的主要支持者，并减少对前沿实验室代币模型的依赖，特别是在中国工具已迅速缩小差距的情况下。

上个月，在他在 CNBC 上发表的病毒式言论引发了更广泛的争论后，卡普和 Palantir 与科技重量级人物一起写了一封信，敦促政府不要限制开放权重卡普说：“如果我们要让模型公司保持诚实，我们就需要竞争，这与企业软件是一样的。”

他补充说，“我们在美国获胜的方式就是竞争，我们的开放模型必须变得与中国的开放模型一样好。”

title: 二十五个州就最新的全球关税起诉特朗普政府
content:
周一，由 25 个民主党领导的州组成的联盟起诉特朗普政府，称唐纳德·特朗普总统对来自 60 个美国贸易伙伴的商品征收全面关税，超出了他的权力。

该诉讼向美国国际贸易法院提起，对从受影响经济体进口的大多数商品提出了 10% 或 12.5% 的关税，这些商品加起来占 99.4%据各州称，各州要求法院停止征收关税，宣布其非法，并下令退还已缴纳的关税。

“在最高法院败诉后，政府再次试图通过新一轮关税非法提高家庭和企业的税收，”纽约总检察长利蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯在一份声明中表示。

本案的核心是政府的努力。为了维护特朗普的广泛关税制度，法庭驳回了根据不同法律实施的两个早期版本。各州辩称，官员们以 1974 年《贸易法》第 301 条和强迫劳动问题为借口，迅速重新制定几乎相同的全球义务。

白宫驳回了这一论点。

“美国正在利用其合法权力来消除给美国商业带来负担的不合理行为、政策和做法，”白宫发言人库什·德赛 (Kush Desai) 在一份声明中表示。 “外国未能对强迫劳动生产的商品实施进口禁令，这是不合理的，会给包括美国工人在内的美国商业带来负担，必须得到解决。”

“事实证明，自总统第一任期以来，301 条款关税在法律上是持久的工具，现在仍然如此，”德赛补充道。

美国政府在指责这些国家和欧盟未能阻止这些商品的进口后，征收了这些关税。

但各州的投诉称，美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔对 60 个经济体进行了匆忙调查，绕过了所需的针对具体国家的磋商，并且未能解释为什么几乎统一的关税税率适合政策差异很大的经济体。

“国际供应链中所谓的强迫劳动问题与美国贸易代表办公室征收的全面全球关税之间没有合理的契合，”投诉

各州辩称，只有在对特定国家的不公平行为进行调查后，301 条款才允许采取贸易行动，并要求针对结束这种行为而调整由此产生的关税。

美国贸易官员在大约两个半月内完成了 60 项调查，并将经济体分为四个关税类别，两个主要税率之间只有 2.5 个百分点。

投诉还称，美国贸易代表办公室认为每个经济体的税率与受强迫劳动污染的商品盛行率之间没有任何联系。它还声称贸易代表没有制定各国可以达到的取消关税的基准。

该文件指出，各州称豁免破坏了政府的理由。美国贸易代表办公室将来自巴西的冷冻牛肉列为与强迫劳动有关的三个商品之一，但对该产品免除了关税。

纽约州州长凯西·霍楚尔(Kathy Hochul)在一份声明中表示，关税是“对勤劳家庭的征税”，称它们将推高食品杂货、家庭必需品、建筑材料和其他日常用品的成本。

该诉讼还指出了征收关税的时间。美国贸易代表办公室于 7 月 23 日宣布了这些关税，即根据《贸易法》第 122 条征收的临时关税到期的前一天，允许特朗普的关税制度不间断地继续下去。

最高法院此前曾裁定，《国际紧急经济权力法》并未授权特朗普之前的关税。贸易法庭后来驳回了政府对第 122 条的使用，尽管该裁决在上诉期间已暂停。

各州引用政府声明作为证据，证明第 301 条的结果是预先确定的。最高法院裁决后，格里尔表示，官员们将加快使用替代贸易当局的方式，以“确保连续性”。起诉书称，财政部长斯科特·贝森莱特表示，关税税率将恢复到“原来的水平”。

此案至少是对新关税的第二个法律挑战。一群小企业此前曾起诉政府，提出类似的论点，即特朗普不能利用新的法律权力重新制定被最高法院无效的关税。

title: 特朗普称埃克森美孚和雪佛龙在伊朗冲突期间从高油价中赚了“太多钱”：“我不喜欢这样”
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一表示，由于伊朗战争导致原油价格上涨，埃克森美孚和雪佛龙赚了太多钱。

“他们因短缺而赚了太多钱，”特朗普在白宫对记者表示。 “我不喜欢这样。”

埃克森美孚和雪佛龙周五报告了第二季度的意外利润。雪佛龙的盈利飙升近 400%，达到 120 亿美元，而去年同期为 25 亿美元。埃克森美孚的利润比去年同期的 71 亿美元增长了一倍多，达到 145 亿美元。

“雪佛龙，太多钱了。埃克森美孚，太多钱了，”特朗普说。 “他们将把其中的一部分返还给公众，他们最好降低零售价和消费者价格。”

美国4 月至 6 月，原油价格平均收盘价约为 92.45 美元，比第一季度上涨约 27%。
